tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i las 'grigs bltas chog tu gsal ba 'od dkarasnang byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/

ra khya// na mo gu ru ye/ lang gro lotsa'i sku yi nar 'dzin zhing / rgyal ba mchog dbyangs gsung gi bdud rtsi thon/ khye'u chung lo tsa'i thugs kyi rnam sprul rje/ grub dbang gter chen bla mar phyag bgyi'o/ nge gsang gdam pa'i yang zhun rmad byung ba/ snyigs 'gro'i rgud tshogs mtha' dag skyobs pa'i mgon/ pa d+ma'i rnam 'phrul 'dzam gling rgyal po yi/ sgrub pa mchog gi phyag bzhes ma nor dgod/ de la'adir bsham bkod mchod dzos rnams mthong brgyud ltar du bya zhing bdag bskyed pad+ma ka ra'i las byang tshogs lhag ma yan grub rjes su/ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol sgrub bya ba la/ zog mar dug byung la byin rlabs dang dug byung las/ /sa mi shāshākyar dza/ rje sogs macardod bar ba byung ni/ /sa kha 'babs chu/ sogs shā bar spos byu ni/ /satrīḥ gleng gi gling mchog sogs shā gzhi btang bsod nams dpal bskyed las/ 31 swā sti sogs gadregalaḥbar/ sgrub pa'i gnad dbab dgos 'dod lhun grub ni/ na moḥ mchog gsum cigaḥ bar lan gsum/ na mo rat+na sogs lan bdun gtor ma byin rlabs dgra bgegs dpung 'jom las/ gtor snye da lcags khang sogasabastim 37 na moḥ rig 'dzin sdo/ba thob sogs cig bar lan gsum bstim zhig sogs zlas par gyuraḥ sngags drug phyag drug rang nyid sogs la bar/ zab sgrub mtha' dmag 'jom

ra༅tsho pa'i tho lum las/ ma ma hā shubye ta sogs gzhi dbyings ka dag sogs bstim dgo sa gsol las/ ho dbye ngas su gache la sogs che: bsdu g.ya' dzaX sogs pheX bso spyi dpon sogs phernyi bar/ zab sgrub las spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ mkha' 'gros gleng dbus dza dzaX rten 'dzug bsam 'phe la dbang ga rgyal po ni/ hūṃ hṝ: stong chen chos dbyings sogs ge sar dgra bla'i tshogs la rten du 'bul: rnga de ltar bkyag nas/ sa ma yuḥ bar/ zab sgrub las bzhugs gsol ni/ /hrī ren chen sna bdun sogs lhanaX mnga' gsol ma rig gdul dka' las/ hūṃ hrīḥ ka ma las 'tshogangs bdud dgra'i bshagad mar mdzad par mnga' gardzu la ma : rnga de ltar bkyag nas/ bzhes su gsol bar/ zab sgrub las phyag 'tshal ni ka hrīḥ bsgrangs yas sogs sha ya hoX zab sgrub las mchod pa na/ hūṃ hrīḥ teng 'jin las byung sogs phrin las mdzodaX bdud rtsi skyems mchod phrin las char 'beb las yin ā hūṃ rgyal dgongs sogs sa ma yā: rnga rab 'gags med rdo rje'i rol mo na bas bsgo bsgo chos dbyengs ste ba sogs gyur cig: du ga mchod pa grags stong rol mo ni baX

bswo be+eḍūr+ya yi sogs cig: dar rab dpa' bo' dgyes mchod ni/ bswo tshos dbyings mi 'gyur sogs sa ma yā: ṭa ma ru dang dril bu'i mchod pa kun bzang rol mo las/ bas chos dbyings hoḥ thod rnga'i mchod pa ni bas bsto bas ka dag chos sku'i sogs āḥ/: rkang rab/ mnga' dar dpal gyi dga' ston las/ bzhwa tshe mda' bkra shis sogs lamaḥ shing rtsi bya rigs 'bul ba thugs dam dgyes bskyed ni/ hūṃ hrī rnga yab gleng nas sogs 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las grub mdzod cigaX rnga de ltar bkyag nas/ 'tsho bar mdzod/ phye mar rin chen spung pa las/ ba—1 lha yi mar la sogs rgyal 31༷ bas gsol bdud rtsi'i sprin phu las/ na 31 rat+na dra lhun grub mdzod: rlung rta 'bul ba dab thang dpal bskyed las/ kye dade/ngasangal dpe 11gas mdzod cigaḥ lam lha gnyer bcol bsam don lhun grub las/ hūṃ hūṃ rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i sogs par mdzodaḥ chos skyongs bskang gsol phrin las lhun grub las/ bas 〉〉mngon nam mkha'i sa ma yā: dgra bla gnyer bcol phrin las lhun grub las/ hūṃ hrī rnga yab shes rgyan cigaḥ yon 'bul bum pa bzang po las/ rnga kher brdung byas la/ bzhwa dzadas dbyings nam mkha'

༄༅༅// sogs phyin regagaḥ zab sgrub las sngags mchod na/ ces ma hā gu ru ka ma sogs hiḥ dgongs gsol yid bzhin dbang rgyal las baX rgya ja phud kyi lha rgyal ma ཿ gnyer gtad ratā' 'phreng mdzes las/ hūṃ hrī rnga yab srin gling dam tshig canaḥ bar/ kher brdung bya srung 'dzug rdo rje'i go khrab las/ bswoX lha min grong khyer sogs rgyal lo dgra bla la gtor ma byin rlabs dang / bskang gsol yid bzhin dpa la ster las/ hūṃ dza gleng gi gling mabyedag sogs rgyal ma ༷ dgra bla'i gsol bsdus ni bsde baX : gnam bab lha las sogs bar mdzodaḥgator 'bul lam la gnyer bcol yid dbang gi rgyal ngo las/ ba31ཿ chos dbyings nam mkha' sogs mdzod cigaḥ lam lhas gsol bsdus ni bathe ge sar dgra bla'i sogs rgyas par mdzodaḥ g.yang blan dngos grub gter gyi bum bza las/ khyen swā bha wa sogs nya: rtenang pa'i ngang las rin chen sogs bzlas dmigs/ bzlas pa brgya rtsa 'am skabs da bstun g.yang 'gugs dbang gi lcags kyu na/ ba(1: 'dzam bu gling gi sogs maṅga le/ bar/ grang bsogs mthar gter gyi bum bzang las rten bzhugs ni/ bsde rigs gadza/ma sogs leḥ bar/ rten snyang gsum/ gzhan

bkra shis ca rigs brjod/ zab sgrub las bstod pa na/ hūṃ trīḥ khams ga༄ ma dbang bsdud sogs 11gas mdzodaḥ bzlas dmigs ni/ rang pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs 'bod pa brgya stong ci 'grub skabs dang bstun/ de nas gtor rdzas byin rlabs byas nas/ gsol mchod bstan dgra'i dpung mdzoms ni/ (hrī rnga yab dpal sogs sa ma yāḥ bar lan gsum/ gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub ni kye 'dza da dza na kun sbyo/bas sogs grangasaci mang gtong/ mthar gzugs bskang lha min g.yul 'joms na/ hūṃ hrī: rnga yab gling nas sogs mdzod cig ༷ bar grangs bsogasamathar/ za ngu bstan dgra'i dpung 'joms las / dzaḥ 'dzam gling skyes bu sogs sa ma yāḥ grangs bsogs mthar/ zab sgrub las mchod bstod ni hūṃ hrīḥ ting 'dzin las byung sogs grogs mdzodaḥ phran las bcol ba ni/ kye bshasar dgra bla'i sogs malnga/da rten bzhugs na snyen su sti sogs dzha rten snying dbyangs gsal lan bdun bzlas/ rang lugs kyi rgyun gsol gang dgos sde mchod 'khrugs bskang za ngu sogs grub mthar/ dus kyi rgud pa zha ba'i phrin bcol ni/ bas ཿ mkha' spyo da sa sprod sogs ba 4mdzod cig b.rapad+ma'i rang lugs rgyal dbang pad+ma'i sangs rgyas ()bstan pa sogs thang gcig 'ur chen sum phab bzhag

ra༅bya rog /de nas tshogs la thog mar nyams chags bshags sbyangs bya ba ni/ hoḥ rtsa gsum dam can sogs gnang bar stsolaḥ yig brgya/ rdzas bskang na/ yin āḥ(ཿ dbyings rig sogs gyur cig tshogs bsdus bsod nams spran 'khrigs las/ ram̐ ye khaṃ/ o āḥ(/ hūṃ hrī rnga yab mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i mngon gyur shog 37 badz+ra sa twa hūṃ grangasabasogs mthar/ rje btsun bla sogs sa twa brgya rtsa yig brgya bcas/ dam tshig nyams chags nam mkha'i mthar thugs tshogs mchod bsod nams gter sprin las/ yin sarba bha hāX hūṃ 3 sa nyid hūṃ nam mkha' mdzod sngags/spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ hrī rnga yab zangs mdog sogs dza dzaḥ tshogs phud ni/ hoḥ 'dod yon lha mo sogs hiḥ bskang rdzas byin rlabs bdud tsho rgya mtsho las/ oṃ āḥ/ stong chen chos dbyings sogs nam mkha' mdzod/ sngags rten snying bcas spel la/ dgyes bskang pad+ma'i phreng ba las/ hūṃ trīḥ gling gi mchog sogs dpal 'bar regagaḥ bar bshags ni/ ho blo chung sogs ā:yig brgya tshogs 'gugs lan gsum mam gcig bsgral ba ni hūṃ smo: thog mar bdag sogs phaṭaḥ drags sngags so lnga sham bcas bstab pa ni/ hūṃ ji: 31sanyid sogs hiḥ gnas yul mkha' 'gro'i

bskang ba ni bh+yoḥ'og min gnas dang sogs stsolaḥtshogs la rol ba ni kye hoḥston pa rdo rje sogasal ho:bsam lhun gang spro brjod mthar/horu ka dpal sogasashog ga ma byin rlabs dang /tshogs gzhung las/phenichos nyid dag pa'i sogs khā hi drag sgrub gnam lcags thog ngar las/skad cig /demadun du sogs bstim mo bar/bde brjod zur gsal las/na sna rgyal ba dgongasapa'i ho:bar lan bdun drag sgrub las/badz+ra maṇ+ḍal e sogasabastim mo:spyan 'dren ni/hūṃ trī 'jigs rung dur khrod sogs nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mgopa bstod pa phrin bcol bcas sa ma yā nyin dang po spro na bsgral las bsdus pa ni mtshon las sbu gri'i 'khor lo las bskul ba ni/ba11 :namangon dzams sogasakha bsgyur thams cad la ge sar bsgyur nas gzhung ltar bcol gtad mjug ya phaṭaḥbar/gtor 'gugs byin rlabs rnams dgra bgegs dpung mjoms ltar du bya/ dgra bgegs dpu 'joms las/rang nyid pad+ma 'a snang gnas sogasadamigs laḥshā dza rnga yab dpal ri tshom rgyal phrin las mdzod0 spu gra'i 'bor lo las bzlog pa na dza smo stong gsum stong gi sogasapar mdzodaX bh+yo/gdab ni/bye zangs kyib dan sogs bzogaX

ra༅༅// gtor 'gugs byin rlabs sngar ltar byas la gtor bskul na gzhung las/ sbyo ma g.yel ma 'phang sogs phrin las mdzod: chad mdo byin rlabs dang / hūṃ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe spyi dpal sogs mdzod: bstan ma byin rūbs da / bh+yoḥ slob dpon pad+ma sogs bro 'gugs lan gsum/ bro sngags gsum gcig rta bro ni/ sa e nyid stong pa'i nanaḥ gtor snod bteg nyu: dngos su 'byor dang sogs sngags mchod rgyas pa ra 'bul/ trī: ma bcos (1sa bral sogs lo ka dang / ge sar las byang bum pa gnyis kyi bstod pa gang rung mthar/ bka' rgyud bla ma sogs ba—1da par 'os pa sogs/tshogs gzhung las/ hoḥ gnyis 'dzin semabaka sogs ā: yig brgya lan gsum hoḥ 'do/sa dang 'do/sa ma lan gsum/ byasaḥ 'dir ni rten dang ā: lha snang spros bral: phuṭa: rtsa sngags/rten snying da / na mo chos dbyings spros bral sogs shog ston pa 'jig rten bstan pa'i gnas 'dir nyin mo 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni rgyal ba deng 'dir rnal 441ra pa dza yā de lcar du cig nyin gnyis pa drag sgrub mjug bar sngar ltar la/ ༈ smad las ni/ gtor 'gugs byan rlabs rnams dgra bgegs dpu 'joms ltar la drag bskul rdo rje'i gad mo ni/ smo dza:

'og min chos dbyings sogs rbad rbad thun zor byin rlabs ni/ mdun du dur khrod sogs ci lasab dang / dgra bla'i dpa' chas sogasacig rten snying lan bdun dang / ā+o su pra ltatsho sogs brjod/ mtshon las lha man grong khyer 'joms pa'i thog mda' las/ gser skyems ni/ re yi khaṃ gser skyems gtor ma sogs /: shā trī: 'di phyi'i re 41sa sogs yā byin rlabs dang gzu dpung ni/ kye sangasargyasatshos dang sogs yā: byin rlabs dang mkhyen dpang ni/ kye 'gro ba'i don 'dzad mdzodaḥ e bskyed na/ bdag bskyed phar sogs bsam moX dgra chos dug gi sbu gri'i las/ snyes pā bha wa sogs bstim moḥ bas dug mkhar sogs baṃ hoḥ ches 11na gyi dam tshog sogs bstod pa'i 'jug bar/ mtshon las las 'gugs pa ni na 53 rig 'dzin sogasahoX lan dgu/ ldeb shar 'gugs 'grung ni/ na mo: mtshog gsum sogs bstim bar lan brgya 'am nyer gcig brjod/ ki rab chos dbyings stong khyab ni/ hūṃ bh+yo chos dbyingabasaskye ba sogs mdzad du gsolaX dgra bgegs gnod byed sogs sngags brgya rtsa 'am nyer gcig ci 'gyub brjod mthar/ mthu chen dgra blo'i sogs cigaḥ mtshon las nas las drug ni/ dzaḥ thams cad 'gags byed

ra khya sogs nas lha dbye 'jug yan bya sngags rnams brgya 'am nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub brjod/ 'tshams rnams su zab sgrub las rbad pa'i bsnyen dmigs ni rang 11ga sngags phreng las 11sa sogs sngags brgya 'am nyer gcig brjod/ bswo rabs 'brug stong ra sgra las/ bswo mi mngon nam mkha'i sogs sa ma yā: mtshon las nas gso ba gsum ni/ hūṃ bdag ni khrag 'thung sogs nas hūṃ phaṭaḥbar tshan gsum bya/ cha rab dpal gyi rdzong chen las/ hūṃ dza: skyid rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i sogs sa ma yā: bar rgyugs byang rlu nag 'chas ma las/ hūṃ bye dgongs shig bla ma sogs brin las mdzod: dgra chos dug gi sbu gri las rgyugs bskul ni/ bas: mngon spyod las la sogs sngags ci 'grub brjod/ dmag 'gyed rdo rje'i tha tshag las/ baX mi mngon nam mkha'i sogs phrin las mdzod/ dmag rgyug rgyogs rdo ra ma las/ bsto: sangs rgyas chos kyi sogs sa ma yāX zab sgrub las bsad dmigs ni/ bdag mdun thams cad sogs rbadaX bsad sngags brgya 'am nyer gcig brjod la/ mtshon las nas phur gdab naḥ ( hūṃ nga ni pad+ma sogs phaṭaḥ gri thun nas g.yo brdung 'jug bar phyi 'gros su bya/ bstab pa ni hūṃ bh+yo dgra bla'i rgyal po sogs hi cha rab mtha'i

dam nyams pa'i sogs khā hi bum pa'i bstod bsdus/ yig brgya/ gtor ma rgyan rlabs ni/ āḥlabasabharnya yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba'i 'dod yon zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum drag bzlog mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog las/ hūṃ :3 mimangon tshas dbyings sogs bzlog bzlog bzlog pa lha min g.yul 'joms las/ hūṃ (1 rngam brjed rnga yab sogs grangs 'dzan mthar khyung rtsang rnams bya/ gtor 'gugs byin rlabs bskul ba chad bstan sogs sngar ltar bya/ ga nyin rjes ma la sgrub pa'i gnad dbab gtor 'gugs byan rlabs/ bskyed chog dgong gsol/ spyan 'dren/ rten 'dzug bzhugs gsol/ mnga' gsol/ phyag 'tshal mchod pa/ bdud rtsi skyems mchod/ dar rab/ mnga' dar/ shing rtsi/ phye mar/ bsang/ lam lha gnyer bcol/ chos skyongs/ bskang gsol/ dgra bla gnyer bcol/ yon 'bul/ gzhung gi sngags mchod/ dgongs gsol/ mchor rab/ gnyer gtad/ dgra bla/ gtor 'bul bcas lam lha g.yang blan g.yang 'gugs bcas sngar ltarazab sgrub bstod pa bzlas dmigs/ byin rlabs gsol mchod che chung ci 'grub/ 'khrugs bskang/ za mu mchod bstod phrin bcol/ rten bzhugs tshogs/ drag sgrub yongs rdzogs sngar ltar/ gtor 'gugs byin rlabs dang rgyugs

ra༅༅ byang rlu nag 'tshub ma/ mtshon las las gser skyems nas ye bskyed mjug bar/ dgra chos dug gi spu gri sngar lta ra bstod mjug bar/ mtshon las nas 'gugs pa lan gsum/ zur gsal 'gugs thung ca 'grub/ ki rab da / lajug bla 'gugs sngags ci grub mthar/ mtshon las nas las drug shad phud/ zab sgrub bsnyen dmigs rbad sngags ci 'grub/ ki rab mjug gi mthu chen dgra bla'i sogs shākyags cigaḥ mtshon las nas gso ba gsum/ dgra chos rgyugs bskul dmag rgyug zab sgrub bsnyen dmigs bsad sngags ci 'grub mtshon las phur gdab nas bzung thun gtun brdu bstab pa/ yig brgya gtor ma byin rlabs/ bzlog pa che chung khyung rtsang yan bya/ de nas glud rab la 'dre'i mgu bskyed 'a sa/ na mo mchog gsum sku gsum sogs baṃ ho bar lan bdun brjod/ rin chen ming dang sogs ha hrīḥ sngags drug phyag drug gi spel la rmang rabs na/ kye 'jig rten srid pa'i sogs cig saṃ bha ra'i sngags bdun gyis bsngo ba bya'o/ bsrung spyan 'dren ni bsrung 'dzug rdo rje'i go khrab las/ bas lha min grong khyer sogs ldan par mdzod/ bsrung bkod ni/ bswo de rang bkra shis sogs nas bang mdzod mjug bar/ dkar nag dbye bsal la dung rdo bstod pa dab ga bsam ljon shing nas/ bswo chos skyongs dgra bla sogs lha rgyal lo: rdo nag ni/ kyi/

ngam gyi rdo nag sogs bkra shis regagaḥ shā gzha 'gyed pa lha min g.yul 'joms nas/ bsaḥ bcu gsum dgongs sogs lha rgyal lo 'dre shā ni/ kye lha zhal mi la sogs loḥ sra mda' bstod pa dpag bsam ljon shing las/ bswo: nam mkha' yangasapa'i sogs bde legs mdzod/ rkun thag ni kyi nyon mongs las las sogs mdzodaḥ smas bsgyur ni bswo mthu chen dgra bla'i sogs mdzod gri bdud phab pa ma mthun g.yul 'joms las/ bas chos skyongs sogs dza: lan bdun rmang rab ni bswo snyed rgyan pad+ma sogs bya: 'og gi rgyal rab ni/ bswo smon lam las 'khrungs sogs hi hi gong gi mtshon rab ni/ bsamathu chen dgra bla'i sogs ya phaṭaḥ yid rab lasagapa' mkhar phab pa ni/ bswo phyogs bzhi'i bdud sde sogs ya phaṭaḥ dgra dpung bcag pa rgyogs rdo ngar ma las/ bswo chosaskyongs dgra bla'i sogs be hoḥ bar lan bdun bas mi mngon nam mkha'i sogs ya nan dgra bla bstod pa ni bas sku yi dgra bla sogasabs glud rab las lam bstan/ kye 'byung po'i tshogs rnams sogs gartsaḥ / bzhi'i sngags kyi sprad bsrung gur ni (ཿ rig 'dzin pad+ma sogs hūṃḥ bsrung 'dzug las dgra bla dpang

༄༅༅/ / bstod na/ baX be+eḍār+ya yangs pa'i sogs regagaḥ dgra bla kha 'dzin ni/ baX mkha' la nyi zla sogs rgyal lo: g.yang 'bod ci rigs brjod/ glud rab 'jug gi bkra shis ni/ na 31 phan bde'i 'do/nga gnas sogs gadregal gzhan bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ de na sreg blugs bya ba rna me hom thig rdzas bkod sogs zhal shes ltar grub nas/ las bum kha chab bsregs blugs nyon mo sa g.yul 'joms las jos byin rlabs na/ lasabum las sngags sbyangs sngags rjes rin chen mjes pa'i sogs shākyaraX nam mkha' mdzod sngags mthar ma ra ya sogs hoḥ bar lan bdun me sbar na/ hūṃ hrī me byung chos sogs ram̐ḥ rlung ni/ (ཿ mkha' la sogs hāḥ thab bskyed ni/ e tsūḥ stong pa chen po sogs bstimaḥ sbyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ hrī: rnga yab mkha' 'gro sogasadza: bzhug gsol ni kaka ka sha 'di nai sogs nas phya mchod sngags mjug yan na mchod sngags/ gsang mchod sngags byon skyems ni/ hūṃ hrīḥ bhasto yangs pa'i sogs rtsa sngags sham bcas bdun res 'tshams su mchod rol bsdus pa rjes ma la mchod rol rgyas pa khyon nyer gcig yam shing nas bzung rtsang dmar nag yan gyi bdun res 'chams su 'dod gsol mchod rol bsdus — rjes ma la mchod rol rgyas pa re byed/ bsdu na

sngagasabadun res 'tshams su mchod rol bsdus pa re dang rjes ma la 'dod gsol mchod rol rgyas pa re byed/ thams cad kun la 'dod gsol ni 'og gi ( trī: ge sar dgra bla'i sogs swā hā: bar thams cad kun la sbyar/ rdzasa'adus 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī smon lam thugs bskyed sogs mdzod rtsa sngags sham bcas nyer lnga'i 'tshamagasu 'dod gsol ni/ hoḥ mngon spyod drag po'i sogs mdzod cig: drag rol/ de ltar lan bzha 'bul zab sgrub bstod pa bya/ bshags pa nas bzung tshogs lhag ma yan sngar ltar rnga chog bya spro na za ngu 'khrugs bskang 'don ma 'don kyang chog de nas gtang rag la/ gzhung las/ hūṃ trīḥ ting 'dzin dpal las sogs ta khā hi: rdzas 'dus 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī 'dzam gling nor bu: sogs sngags bdun re'i 'tshams su 'dod gsol 'am nyer gcig 'tshams su gong gi 'dod gsol tshig bcad la bdud rtsi bsregs blugs zhes pa bdud rtsi gtang rag zhes bsgyur/ dngos grub ni snyes yi (ཿ 31thasadabyings sogs hrīḥ bsreg gtor 'bul ba ni rin chen sbyo da du sogs sngags nyer gcig 'dod gsol gsum bstod pa niḥ 1 hrīḥ nya gang zla ba'i sogs bstodaḥ bzod gsol ni hoḥ mkhyen dang brtse sogs ā yag brgya lan gsum lhag ma tshan gnyis bsngo smon las gsum bsdu rim ni hūṃ hrīḥ skye med dbyings

ra༅༅/ / sogs bshegs dam tshig pa sogs bsdu'oḥ bkra shis ni/ na mo byin rlabs char 'bebs sogs shog gzhan bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ nang sgo dbye ba ni/ mtshon las nas dzaḥ zhi ba lhun gyiba'o sogs phaṭa: bzhe sa zhu thugs rje'i nyi ma las/ hūṃ dzaḥ bzhengs shig pad+ma sogs mdzodaḥ daro sa grub ni snye āḥ/ rnga yab dpal ri sogs sirnyi trī0 hrīḥ'ajigs pa brgyad skyobs sogasamatshon las nas phya sgo dbye ba ni/ kyi: shar phyogs rgyal po sogs ma ye swā hā: sngags mchod: bstod bsdus/ yig brgya zor sngags rtsa sngags mthar zor sngags btags pa nyer gcig gtor la btegs gtor 'gugs lan gsum gtor ma byin rlabs dgra bgegs dpu 'joms las/ rang nyid pad+ma sogs dmigs la hūṃ dza rnga yab dpal 2pa sogasaphrin las mdzodaḥ gzhung gi bskul ba ni/ sbyo ma g.yel ma 'phang sogs mdzodaḥ thun zor byan rlabs ni/ mdun du dur khrod sogs sngags ci rags da / dgra bla'i dpa' chadra'o sogs gyur cig rten snyi lan bdun da / oṃ su pra tidzi sogs swā hā chad mdo byin rlabs dang / gzhung gi chad mdo ni hūṃ sbyoḥ sngon tshe spyi dpa' sogs mdzodaḥ mtshon las nas zor bskul ni/ hūṃ

rkuḥ tshogs brgyanaḥ dgra 'dul dbang phyug mda' dar gter bum 'dzin rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan cang shes rkya rgod bcibasaḥ gser sga bal stan rat+na du mas spudaḥdapa' bo phyed 'gye rdzu 'phrul gar gyis rolaḥ du sman bco brgyad wa klu mi mo'i tshulaḥ yid 'ong mdzes sdug blta bas mi ngoms paḥ lang tsho'i dpal 'byor 'khyud bzhin bkur sti 'bulaḥ de rgyab 'khor lo rtsib bcur dgra bdud kharaḥ saja sa rgyas bstan srungs sems can phan bde'i gzhi skye bu don grub dgra bla'i bka' sdod pa: bco lnga'i zla zhal dpa' 'bum rgya tsha dngaX spug po mchong zhal 'bri ba chos skyongs rje dmar po slog 'khyugs bdud gcod dme ru rtse sngon po be+eḍūr 'dan ma bsam 'grub rtsal: ser po gser mdog tshangs pa'i bu yag dngaḥ bltar mi bzod pa khra tsha glog 'khyugs rgyal0 dung gi ri bo stag la khra dkar dngaḥ rgya mtsho'i zhal bzang g.yu lha thog rgod rtsal: sngags pa phur thog spri dpon khro thung rgyal 'gong po dam sri zil gnon rgu ru rnamasaḥ dgra bla'i dpa' chas thams cad sku la rdzogasaḥ rdzu 'phrul 'phur rtsal ldan pa'i chibs rnams

bcibasaḥ dgra 'dul mdung mo bsam gcod ral gri dngaḥ bdud btul dgra stu 'phrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin me rlung 'tshubs bzhin dpa' rgod khros nyams bcasaḥ mtha' mi kla sgo'i gnya' gnon byed por sharaḥ de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs drug dgra bdud kharaḥ zhi ba'i las mdzad thar ba rgyal mtshan dang rgyas pa'i dpal ldan a nu dpa' sang rjeX dbang gi las mdzad ma ṇi ka ra dngaḥ drag po'i mthu ldan dpa' lha mi spyang dkar0 sna tshogs las byedagayu 'od 'bum mirje phrin las thog 'bebs a stag phag mo rnams brtsan pa'i 'khor gsum dgra bla'i dpa' chas klubs rno mtshon gdul dka' gzhoms pa'i phyag mtshan bsnams rdzu 'phrul cing shes 'phur rtsal ldan pa bcibasaḥ mtha' mi kla klo 'dul ba'i gshed por sharaḥ de rgyab sgo bzhi skyongs ba'i pho nya ni snying rje zhi las gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pa dung zla'i mdangs 'bar zhal dkar ldem pa dang byams pa'i dpal mnga' be ru'i sras po rgyalaX dga' ba'i 'dzum gsal 'om bu dar lu dang btang stoms g.yo med lha rgod 'bum me rnams rnam bzhi'i phrin las thog pa

rkaḥ med par sgrubasaḥ gdul dka' 'dul phyir dpa' chas sku la rdzogasaḥ rdzu 'phrul thog med cing shes rlung gaX ga bcibasaḥ thog 'brug ser ba mtshon cha'i tsha tsha 'phroḥ phywa g.yang gter dang mdzod kyi dpal 'dzin paḥ lha sras dbang phyug dgra lha rtse rgyal dang dge mtshan bkra shis lhun grub dpa' bo dngaḥ ga dar sngon po gsod gcod las la bsngagasaX mi thung dpa' brjid a nu'i rnal 'byor baḥ g.yang rta nor bu'i rwa can chibs su bcibasaX 'dzam lha'i gter zog 'dod yon du mas phyuraḥ dar chas rat+na dung khrab rmog ber gsolaX sangs rgyas bstan srungs sems can phan bde spel gzhan yang grub pa'i dab phyugs dpa' btul rnams mkha' la 'ja' 'khrugs bar snang sprin phung 'khrigs sa gzhi dug rlang me yi 'od zer bcasaX ma 'dres yongs rdzogs tal gong phyur bzhin gsalaḥ gnas gsum 'od zer thugs sgog lcags kyu yis mkha' spyod sa spyod rigs ldan sham bha laḥ dpal gyi ri nas spyan drangs dbyer med bstimasaḥ spos bsregs rol mo'i sgras bskul mad dar g.yab snyan pa' glu la dra sa te spyan 'dren ni 〉 hrīḥ mkha'

'gro'i gling dbus zangs mdog dpal gyi riḥbade chen pad+ma 'od 'bar byang phyogs kyiX g.yu mkhar be+eḍūr kha bad mdzes pa nas pad+ma'i phrin las mdzamagling seng chen rgyal mtha' mi kla 1 'dul phyir spyan 'dren gshegasaXmakha' spyod sa spyod sham bha la gnas nasaḥzhi rgyas dbang drag las la mnga' brtes paḥdagra bla dpa' btul che drag rtsal 'dzoms pa phyogs bcu'i ru 'dren dpung bcas gshegs su gsol:rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang gnas yul dur khrod nasaḥ'agro drug g.yang sa nyon mongs bdud 'joms pa'i dgra bla mi 'phan dpa' rtsal ldan pa drugaḥdus kyi ru 'dzing 'joms phyir gshegs su gsolaḥphan dgongs tshad med rnam bzhi'i brin las can sde bzhi'i bdud kyi dpung gi kha lo bsgyur sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sa srungs tha tshig canaḥsgo skyongs las kyi pho nya spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ'adzam gling dpal spel skye dgu'i kha 'dzin mkhan phyu g.yang nor gyi gter mdzod phyag na 'changaḥdabul phongs rmad pa 'jom pa'i gnyen gcig puXstes chen gter bdag 'khor bcas smran 'dren gshegasaX 'phags yul grub palidabang phyug

rkaḥ brgyad cu po bod khams chos kyi gzhi ma rje 'bangs tshulaḥ rdzong khag bco brgyad lde'u mig dpa' btul rjeḥ 'phags pa 'gro ba'i mgon du spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ lha klu gnyan dmag dgra bla wer ma'i tshogasaḥ thugs bskyed dag pa bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i dpalaḥ skyes bu don grub bka' blon g.yog 'khor bcas bstan pa srungs phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ nad kyi rgud pa zhi byed sman gyi gsosaḥ mtshon gyis 'jigs pa mtha' nas mtha' ru bstungaḥ mu ges dbul ba bsod nams gter gyis gsos ༷ rdzogs ldan gsar du 'khrung ba'i bka' drin stsolaḥ ma kā ma thā ma ra tsa na sa pā ri wa ra badro sa ma yā dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol ni hūṃ hrīḥ rin chen sna bdun pho brang 'od re gsalaḥ mdos dang srog 'khor gtor ma brjid dang ldan0 pad nyi ro gdan bsnol ba bag re droḥ 'di la dpa' btul dgra bla'i dmag tshogs bzhugasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya steX sa ma yā tiṣ+ṭha lanaḥ phyag 'tshal ni na moX bsgangs yas gong nas thugs bskyed zla med paḥ 'jig rten skye dgu skyobs pa'i phrin las canaḥ dgra bla dpa' btul grub chen

brgyad cu la rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas phyir gus phyag 'tshal0 sa ma yā na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni tshu niḥ rtang 'dzen las byung dpa' bo dgyes bskyed sprinaḥ dbang lnga'i me tog tshil gsur bdug pa sposaḥ rnam shes mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab dngaX sha rus zhal zas rkang gi gling bu yis ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po gtso 'khor bcasaḥ gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥ rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i a mṛ taX nyon mongs chags pa bsgral ba'i dmar chen po brtan g.yo'i dpal rdzogs ma hā bā ling taḥbaza' bca' btung ba ldag zhib tshogs ston bcas dgra bla ge sar dpa' btul g.yog 'khor rnams gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥ dar tshon sna lnga smyug ma tshig bcu gsumaḥ phyar dar g.yab dar dgra bla'i rten dar bcasaḥ thugs lcags 'bar ba ru mtshon mdung zhags paX bkra shis rdzas rtags nye ba'i rin chen bdun ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnamasaḥ gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstod rin chen sna tshogs khrab rmog ber tshem phubaḥ dar ber gos rgyan yo byad sna tshogs paḥ

rkaḥ nor bu mu min g.yu byir mchong in+d+ra be+eḍūr pad+ma rā ga rdo yi snyingaX ge sar dgra bla'i dmag tshogs rnams la 'bulaḥ gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥ rin chen brdar ba'i gser skyems g.yu skyems dang khrag skyems rgya ja 'o ma'i phud dang niḥ lha yi phye la klu yi zhun sbyar baX gling bzhi mar gyi them skas bkod mdzes pa ge sar dgra bla'i dmags tshogs rnams la 'bulaḥ gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥrdo rje phur pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ru mtshon dngaḥ ḍā ma ru dang dngul dkar dril bu dngaḥ ting ting cha lang rnga chen phag rdob pa ༷ sil snyan kha grags yi waṃ gling bu rnamasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i dmags tshogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥ sha sna snying sna khrag sna mang po dngaX lga dang sgog pa spod kyi rigs sna tshogasaḥ lan tshwa rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru dzaḥ ka ra bu ram̐ sbrang rtsi kha mngar rigasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i dmags tshogs rnams la 'bulaḥ gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥ dza ti sed+ngha a gar sgon shing dang tsan dan dkar dmar na gu ar sngag poX gla

rtsi sman spos dri bzang sna tshogs pa ge sar dgra bla'i dmags tshogs rnams la 'bul gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥ.a bar skyur gsum bzang po drug dang niḥ 'bras gsum zho sha'i rigs dang sman gyi sde dri ro nus pa'i spyang ku ma gtogs paX thugs mthun la dang sdum rigs me tog tshogs ge sar dgra bla'i dpung 'khor bcas la 'bulaX gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥ stag gzig dom dred g.yu spyang 'phar ba waḥ rta mchog glang po ma he 'dod 'jo ba g.yag lug ra gsum khyung dang shang shang dang khyim bya khra glags rgod dang ngang ngur sogs ge sar dgra bla'i dmags tshogs rnams la 'bulaX gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥgayu 'brug chu srin dung dang nya bo cheḥ chu rta chu lugs chu ra chu glang sogs 'dab chags sder chag rmig chag kha breg tshogs lha klu mi yi nor sna mtha' yas paX ge sar dgra bla'i dpung 'khor bcas la 'bulaX gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥlha bsang g.yang bsang zas sna phye mar bsangaḥ gro 'bras khre nas so ba yung dkar dngaḥ

kaiḥ til dang sran ma 'bru yi rigs sna tshogasaḥ dar zab lhab lhub bla bre 'phan yab sogs ge sar dgra bla'i dpung 'khor 'acas la 'bulaX gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaX mi dang dgra bla ma bral kha 'dzin mdzodaḥ kha yi zas 'dod bcud can zas dang sprodaḥ lag pa'i nor 'dod g.yang can nor dang spyor rgyab gyi gos 'dod brjid can gos rgyan sprodaḥ snying gi chos 'dod dam pa'i chos la sbyoraḥ don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ ma ma hā gu ru kā ma thā la rā tsa sa pā ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bī shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ uṅga te spra ra ṇa e māṃ ga ga na khaṃ gh+rat+na dī bha ling ta khā nyiḥ pa ñtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta khā nyi bstod pa ni sne hrīX khams gsum dbang bsdud pad+ma rgyal po'i 'dzumaḥ srid gsum zil gnon blo ldan mchog sred tshul sde brgyad dam 'dogs pad+ma'i phrin las gar: phyogs bzhi'i bdud 'dul ge sar rgyal la bstodaḥ dgongs pa 'od gsal snang ba mtha' yas thugasaḥ rjes chags gzigs pa rta mgrin rlul po'i gar ༷ che ba'i dbang phyag pada'i phrin las rje ༷ 'dzam bu ging gi skabs

mgon de la bstodaX dung sman bco brgyad dga' bzhi'i zlos gar bsgyuraX dpa' btul sum bcus rdzongs chen lde mig mdzadaX grub thob brgyad cus sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs dus kyi rgud pa gso mdzad khyed la bstodaḥ dpa' 'bum rgya tsha dung zla'i gzi byin 'baraḥ 'bri ba chos skyong nus mthu thog las ngaraḥ bdud gcod shan pas dgra bdud chom la 'bebs rtsal thob 'dan ma be+eḍūr mdangs la bstodaX gser ba'i bu yag 'dzam gling srid kyi g.yangaḥ khra tsha glog 'khyugs btsan phyug 'phan dar rje grub pa mchog thob stag lha khri dkar rgyal g.yu lha thog rgod rdzu 'phrul ldan la bstodaḥ bde stong dbang phyugs sngags mkhan khro thung rgyalaḥ 'gong po spun dgu zil gnon rgu ru dang zhi ba'i las mdzad thar ba rgyal mtshan dpal rgyas byed a nu dpa' bo rnams la bstodaḥ rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra mkhyen brtse'i gter: dpa' la mi spyang bdud dgra'i gnya' gnon paX mda' yi rtsal thob g.yu 'od 'bum me dang a stag dpa' ngar rdo rje phag mor bstodaX dung gi sgo mongs zhal dkar ldem pa dang lho phyogs gser gyi sgo mongs be ru'i srasaḥ

rkuḥ bde stong sgo srungs 'om bu'i dar lu rjeḥ drag po'i las mdzad lha rgod 'bum mer bstod gter gyi mdzod 'dzin dgra lha rtse rgyal rjeḥ dge mtshan dpal spel lhun grub dpa' bo dngaḥ phyi nang g.yang sdud ga dar sngon po dngaḥ mi thung khro rgyal rnal 'byor tshogs la bstodaḥ dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams mngon spyod sgrol la dgyesaḥ dpa' mo rnams ni bde stong 'dzum la rolaḥ las byed tshogs rnams mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlogaḥ rdo rje'i srog ldan las dmag tshogs la bstod bdag ne+e rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin la spro mthu dang dpung grogs dgra bla'i dmag tshogs sbranaḥ snyigs dus rgud tshogs gdung bas mi mnar b.raḥ dpa' bo khyed kyi thugs bzhed 'grub pa dngaḥ bzang ngan las kyi 'brel ba'i skye bo kun rnga yab dpal rir sun ma lam grogs mdzodaḥ bzlas dmags ni rang pad+ma 'byung gnas su gsal ba' thugs ga'i 'od zer gyisaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po bskulaḥ sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes rjes su dgongs bzhin zhi rgyas dbang drag gi mdzad pa du masaX nad mug 'khrug rtsod dus kyi rgud pa sna tshogs zhi zhing stong

par mdzad pa dang mtha' bzhi'i dmag gi dpung mang kha lo bsgyur nasaḥ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang sems can gyi phan bde rab tu dar zhing rgyas par dmigs laḥ 37 kā ma tha la rā tsa na sarba sa ma yā pho dzaX dgongs pa ting nge 'dzan gyi gcun bzlas pa dbug gi rta la drangs spro bsdus phrin las 'od zer 'gyed gang 'dod yan bzhin 'byung bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ sgrub 'dzab na rang 17ga sngagasaphreng las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bskul de las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis dgra bla dpa' btul thams cad mngon spyod drag po'i las la bskulaḥ gang la gzas pa'i yul mtha' dmag 'khrug rtsod dus kyi rgud pa thams cad zhi ba'i dgongs spyod la zhugs par dmigs laḥ 37 kwa ma thā la rā tsa na sarba sa ma yāḥ gnod byed dgra bgeg zhesabasgyur mtha' dmag dus 'a(1ga la la mā ra ya rbad dmigs pa ting 'dzin gzer lngan pas bzlas pa dbug gi rta le drangs rnam bzhe'i phrin las thog med 'grub mtha' bzha'i dmag ga dpung pha ma 'gyuraḥ sa ma māḥ las 'dzab niḥ bdag mdun thams cad kyis drag po'i 'dzab sngags ti ri ri bsgags pasaX lha dmag bu yug bzhin tu 'tshub

rkuḥ gnyan dmag thog ser bzhin du kholaḥ klu dmag rgya mtsho bzhin du phyur nas rno mtshon la ngar chu bludaX kai bswo dang cha sgra bsgragasaX sbyor sgrol gyi dgongs spyod la gnasaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par dmigs laḥ bla kwa ma thā la rā tsa na sa ma ya cho cho rgyugs rgyugasaḥ mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad rdul du rlog cigaX sod cigaX thul zhigaḥ mā ra ya sodaḥ drag sngags me yi 'khor lo bskor byad ma mtha' dmag rdul du rlogaḥ mngon spyod phran las lhun gyis grub bden rdzun lag tu longs da gsal sa ma yā e maḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud 'di dus kya rgud pa skyobs pa 'a phyir gangs dkar te se'i brag la sbasaX snyigs ma lnga yi dus skabs su sprul da mi gzhan pa nusaldan dpal gyi rdo rje dang 'phrad nas dus kyi 'ari gas gzeng gzhomaḥbaka' 'ad sngags kyi bdag mos srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhig thugs sras skal bzang dpal du shog sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim dziḥ zhes pa 'ang tshogs smon las 'dzoms byams chos dang 'gyur rdor gnyis kyi thugs 'dun 'grub phyar kho bo nusaldan dpal gyi rdo rjes dbyi sa sna ma kha' 'gro'i brdo mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lu zin shrī tras bkyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo le/

〈rte dam chos thugs kyi yang snying lasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dgangs gsol yid bzhin dbang rgyal bzhugasaḥsgo na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye rgyatsha/ga ja cha skyems sna bcu gsum bshams sha thud zas sna bcu gsurma spu sa rgun 'brum shi — tog bcu gsum bsags sngags da phyag rgyas ra tu spe' gsal ti 'dzan brtan po yis ho dgengs su gsol loḥ gsan du gsel loḥ a rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gli dbusaḥ rak+ka srin po'i grongs rtseḥ ra yab bde sto 'od glingaḥ zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal yas pad+ma 'od gyi da laḥ bya phyogs g.yu mkhar ldems paḥ rin chen bse lcags khri kharaḥ rtog bral baṃ ro'i ste nas rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rjeḥ gu ru pad+ma'i phrin las ya seng 'phrul gyi lde migaX ma se nor bu dgra 'dulaX seng chen dgra bla'i rgyal po 'jam bu'i gli gi skyes gcigaḥ mgo nag mi yi rje bo: phyogs bzhi'i bdud dpung gnya' gnon mtha' yi dmag gi dpung 'jomasaḥ rju 'phrul stebs kyi mnga' bdagaḥ myur 'gyags rlung gi shug ldan: snyigs dus skyobs pa'i ded dngo/naḥ du

ru'i dpung tshogs 'joms pa'iḥ dgra bla mthu chen dbang phyug rnal 'byor kun gyi grogs po rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shingasaḥ dpa' bo bdud dgra 'dul mdzadaḥ sngon gyi thugs dam bzhin du gdung ba'i glu yis bskul loX dam tshig snyan gsan dbab 0po rol mo'i sgra dbyangs sbir la dga' ston sna tshogs stobs bzhinaḥ 'du ba tshogs la byon cig: ka ma tha la ra dza sa ma yā pho pheX rol mo' sgras bskul la bswo bswo g.ya' sdon be+eḍūr dkyil nasaḥ 'ja' tshon 'od kyi drwa guraḥ dri bzang sman bsung 'thul ba'iḥdapa' bo ḍāk+ki'i gral nasaḥ gnam sman lha yi rgyal mo ༷ sring lcam tha le 'od dkaraḥ kong za me tog lha mdzesaḥ nas chung bsod nams dpal skyidaX seng lcam 'brug gi rgyal moX mes mo chos kyi 'bum skyid lha mo me tog chos mtsho ja ma dung sman sum cu rgyal ba'i dgyes bskyed pho nyaX bde stong dpal gyi dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pasaḥsmad cig nyid la byon cigaḥ dzā na ḍakri e a ra li tring hring pheX phe: bswo bswo sgri dpon stobs kyi rgyal poḥ dpa' 'bum gro tsha zhal dkaraḥ 'dan sras

sgo ༷ rin chen bsam 'grubaḥ shan pa thogs rgod dme rtsa dga' bde chos skyong ber nag rtsal chen g.yu la thogs 'gyuraḥ dung skyong stag lha khri dkaraX lha bu g.yu yi ldems paḥ 'om bu'i a nu dpal sangaḥ dpa' bo sang stag ya medaḥ stag rung gzigs 'phan rgyal poḥ sras chung dgra lha rtse rgyalaḥ sngags mkhan khro thung rgyal poX mda' mkhan a stag klu moX dpa' thul dam pa'i mi bdunaḥ ya thul skyes bu rnam lnga mthu ldan dam pa sum cuX pho nya yang g.yog bcas paḥ rtse gcig mos pas bskul ma ཿ nya gang zhal bza ston laḥ dgra dpung cham la phab phyir dga' ston mchod pa bzhes shi ཿ rnam mang phrin las sgrubs shigaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya phe phernyi bas bswo rgya ja phud kyi dwangs maḥdza gad rin chen gser skyemasaḥ bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgya mtshoḥ bza' ba sha yi dga' stonaḥ zla phrum thud kyi ri boḥ mngar gsum ro bcud ldan paX 'dod yon lnga yi dga' stonaḥbaza' ba'i zad med mchod sprinaX phyi nang gas ba'i pu dzaḥ ti nge 'dzin gyi dkor noraḥ lha klu mi yi dpal 'byoraX nam mkha' rab 'byams rgyan mchod seng chen dgra bla'i

kaiḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i bdud rtsi skyems mchod phrin las char 'bebs bzhugs soḥrkuḥ na mo gu nag pad+ma ka ra ye po /che/115711shāmi gser skyems khrag skyems g.yu skyems bshams sngags da phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel ge sar dgra bla'i dmag tshogs gsal dza gad skyems kyi bskangs pa ni ma āḥ(ཿ rgyal dgongs brda snyan shog ser tshig brgyud kyiḥ bla ma kun dngos pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaX bdud rtsi dza gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaḥ lhan skyes don dam rtogs pa'i rang ngo sprodaḥ snying rjes gzhi las ma g.yos spyan ras gzigasaḥ rjes chags bzhad pa'i sku can rta mchog rgyalaḥ bdud rtsi dza gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaḥ dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal 'bar ba'i grogs mdzod cigaḥ thugs bskyed dam bca' mi nyams zhal bzhes ltaraḥ mngon spyod drag pos las la mnga' brtes pasaḥ bdud rtsi dza gad phud kyi mchod pa rol spyor sgrol mdzad pa ston pa'i phrin las bcolaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po dbang gi skuḥ srid na ya mtshan bdud kyi gnya' gnon paḥ bdud rtsi dza gad phud kyi
