rkuḥ klu gnyan dmag 'phroḥdung khyung dkar po klu phrug 'ad ldan 'gyed bdud rtsi dza gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaḥkhams gsum/ mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥzhing bcu'i dgra la drag rtsal khyad chos stonaḥskal ldan rnams la brtse bas zur mig g.yoḥbadud rtsi dza gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaḥzhi drag mdzad pa 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥdago sa pa chos dbyings gter la mnga' brnyes pa'iḥrnam rol gdul bya'i wag ma skyongs mjad paḥbadud rtsi ༄ gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaXdon gnyis 'bad med 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥmagon khyod zangs mdog dpal rir rtagags bzhugs kyangaḥbrin las mi mjed zhing du chags thogs bralaḥbadud rtsi dza gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaḥgang la gang 'dul phrin las nub med mdzod smon log mtha' mi kla kle'i rgol ba laḥkhyed nyid sbran cing rbad pas tshar gcod 'gyuraḥbadud rtsi dza gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaḥnus mthu gnam lcags thog ltar bstan du gsolaḥ nam zhig mtha' mi'i bstan pas kun gdung tsheḥrigs ldan dpa' nge khyed kyi drung nas 'byinaḥ bdud rtsi dza

gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaḥ tshom bu 'bum phrag rig 'dzin sar 'god mdzodaḥ gdul bya'i khams ni tshad med ma stong paraX sbyor sgol thabs mang phrin las ston mdzad pa bdud rtsi dza gad phud kyi mchod pa rolaX byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod skyel ma gyisaḥ rnam mang phrin las rgya mtsho char du bsnyil bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: gtor skyems gtsang sar phul bar bya phrin las gang bcol sgogs med 'grubaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham lhaḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin grags pa'i dpal dang 'gyur med rdo rje gnyas kyi bskul ba dang slob bu dhe wa'i shog gu'i mthun rkyen bcas te bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'dul bsgob nusaldan 'dusapa rtsa'angagyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ye ge pa las ldan 'gyur rdor gyi bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga 40/

rkeḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ dgra bla'i dgyes bskyed rnga rabs 'gags med rdo rje'i rol mo bzhugs so:rkaX na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ rte/satrītsakhri bswo bsho bas chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i rngaX be+eḍūr+ya yi 'od kyis 'byudaḥ 'od gsal ye shes thabs kyis brdungaḥ'akhrul ba'i 'khor lo chos skur gzhigaX snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang bde stong 'gags pa med pa'i rngaX rang gsal sgrib bral 'od kyis 'khyudaḥ shes rab rang byung thabs kyis brdung drwa ba'i rlung khams longs skur sangasaḥ pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ snang stong gnyis su med pa'i rnga rang bzhin mnyam pa'i 'od kyis 'khyud0 gsal sgrib med pa rig pas rnga rlung sems thugs rjes rol par sadaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥme longs ye shes rol ba'i rnga gsal dag chen po'i thabs kyis brdung dpa' 'bum rgya tsha'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ zhe sdang 'byul ba rang grol shogaḥ mnyam nyid ye shes rol ba'i rngaX dngos zhen rnam par dag pas brdung gser rje'i

bu yag thugs dam bskangasaX nga rgyal 'khrul ba grol gyur cigaḥ sor rtogs ye shes rol ba'i rnga bde ba chen po'i thabs kyis brdungaḥ shan pa me ri'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ'adod chags zhen pa dag gyur cigaḥ bya grub ye shes rol ba'i rngaX dag nyams rtogs pa mchog gis brngungaḥ 'bru ba chos skyongs thugs dam bskangasaḥ 'phrag dog 'khrul snang stong gyur cigaḥ chos dbyings ye shesarol ba'i rnga mi rtog rnam par dag pas bzungaḥ 'dan ma rin chen thugs dam bskangasaḥ gti mug 'brul 'khor sangs gyur cigaX stong pa 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i rnga dag pa rlung gis bskul te brngungaX khra tsha glog 'khyugs thugs dam bskangasaḥ rang mtshan gol ba grol gyur cigaX sto pa chen po'i rang bzhin rnga mchog tu dga' bas bskul te brngu ཿ dung skyongs khri dkar thugs dam bskangasaḥ chags sems 'khrul ba dag gyur cigaḥ thams cad stong pa nyid kyi rnga khyad par dga' bas thabs kyi brdungaX g.yu lha thog rgod thugs dam bskangasaḥ zhen 'dzin rang sar grol gyur cigaḥ shin tu stong pa nyid kyi rngardu lan gcig skyes dga'i thabs kyis brdungaḥ khro

rkuḥ thung rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥthad ga'i rtog pa sangs gyur cig rnam kun mchog ldan rol ba'i rnga 'od gsal bsam mtha' yas pas brngung khra khyung nor bu'i thugs dam bska saḥ gnyis su med par rtogs gyur cigaḥ gtong sems rnam par dag pa'i rnga sbyin pa chen po'i thabs kyis brdungaḥ a yag thar ba'i thugs dam bskangasaḥser sna'i 'dzin zhen grol gyur cig0 khrims nyid rnam par dag pa'i rnga tshul khrims phar phyin thabs kyis brdungaḥ.a nu dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskangasaX'achal ba'i dri ma dag gyur cig byams pa mtha' ru phyin pa'i rnga bzod pa chen po'i thabs kyi brdungaḥ ma ṇi ka ra'i thugs dam bskangs khong khro'i 'khrul ba dag gyur cigaḥ brtson pa mtha' ru phyin pa'i rnga brtson 'grus phar phyin thabs kyis brdungaḥ dpa' la mi spyang thugs dam bskangs le lo'i rgud pa zhi gyur cigaḥ ti 'dzin rnam par dag pa'i rnga bsam gtan chen po'i thabs kyis brdungaḥgayu 'od 'bum me'i thugs dam bskangs g.yeng ba'i phyogs lhung sangs gyur cigaḥ ma rig ka nas dag pa'i rnga shes rab phar

phyin thabs kyi brdung a stag phag mo'i thugs dam bskangs rmongs pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig chos nyid zhi ba chen po'i rnga thabs kyi phar phyin dag pas brdungaḥ zhal dkar ldems pa'i thugs dam bskangasaX 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi gyur cigaX 'gags med 'od gsal rgyas pa'i rnga stobs kyi phar phyin dag pas brdungaX sras mchog rat+na'i thugs dam bskangasaX 'byor drug bsod nams rgyas gyur cigaḥ bde ba chen po'i dbang gi rngaX smon lam phar byin thabs kyis brdungaḥ rnal 'byor dar li'i thugs dam bskangs mos bzhi dbang du 'du gyur cigaḥ khrag 'thung khro bo rol ba'i rnga: ye shes phar phyin thabs kyis brdung rgyal sras lha rgod thugs dam bskangs mngon spyod mtha' ru phyin gyur cigaḥ dung la nor bu gdong drug rnga byams pa chen po'i thabs kyis brdungaḥ dgra lha rtse rgyal thugs dam bskangs g.yang gi bang mdzod rgyas gyur cigaḥ gser gyi 'brug seng kha sprod rnga snying rje chen po'i thabs kyis brdung ga dar phying sngon thugs dam bskangasaḥ g.yang gi ra ba mer gyur cig byu ru'i stag khyung zung 'jug rnga dga' ba chen po'i thabs

rku kyis brdung mi thung khro rgyal thugs dam bskangs g.yang gi rgya mtsho 'khyil gyur cigaḥmar gad glang po rma bya'i rngaX btang snyoms chen po'i thabs kyi brdungaḥdapa' bo lhun grub thugs dam bskangasaḥphyu g.yang lhun po rgyas gyur cigaḥdangul rnga chos sgra stong khyab kyisaḥchung rgyud rig 'dzin thugs dam bskangasaḥgaser rnga khrims srung dar bo che'i che rgyud gser shogs thugs dam bskangasaX zangs rnga bde stong rang 'bar sgras 'bring rgyud dpa' sde'i thugs dam bskangasaḥgayu rnga brin las lhun grub sgras blon sde sdo ga bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs be+eḍūr 'od kyi rnga sgra yisaḥsteng gi lha dmag thugs dam bskangasaḥ'aja' tshon bkrag 'bar rnga sgra yisaḥbar ma gnyan dmag thugs dam bskangasaḥ.in+d+ra'i mdangs 'bar rnga sgra yis 'og ma klu dmag thugs dam bska sa thabs shes gnyis med rnga sgra yisaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangasaḥbade stong zung 'jug rnga sgra yis ja ma dung sman thugs dam bskangasaḥ'akhrul pa ru bzlog rnga sgra yis grub thob brgyad cu' thugs dam bskangasaḥmadzad pa mi nub rnga

sgra yis snyigs ma'i gdul bya skyobs gyur cigaḥ sbyor dang sgrol ba'i rnga sgra yisaḥ mtha' mi'i kha lo bsgyur gyur cigaḥ sngon gyi thugs dam dus la babasaḥ rjes chags phrin las rnga yis bskulaX rig 'dzin pad+ma'i phrin las 'grub dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dbu 'phang bstodaX chos bstan dar ba nam mkhar mnyamaḥ 'dus sde smin pa skar ltar bkraḥ bshad pa'i me tog tshal du dngaraḥ rang sems 'dul ba'i gzhi tshug mdzod sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs lhung bralaX 'ja' lus chos sku'i sa la sbyor don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phyiraḥ ye shes rol ba'i rnga brdung ngoḥ mdzad pa mtha' ru phyin pa dang wa mi dpal gsum 'dzom gyur cig de ltar rnga rabs phul ba yis bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing las nyon 'khrul ba'i bag chags bya ཿ don dam rtogs pa 'bar bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma rwa ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs ba da 'daḥ ga sa dkar ti se'i brag la sbas dus kyi snyigs mar gyur ba na las can rig 'dzan gcig gis rted gdul bya'i lhag ma de yas skyongs 'brel tshad rnga yab dpal rir 'god bka' 'di dam can rgya mtsho' srung 'dod sred can la ma shor cig sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'a lung zin

rkuḥ 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskul ba da las ldan 'gyur rdor nas thabs shes mtshon pa 'i lha regs rin chen sna ga shogs dri bral dkar yol bcas nas bskul ngo ra/kha bo nusaldan dpal gyi rdo rjesadabyang snang mkha' 'gro'i ban mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ye ge pa ni 'gyur rdor nas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba mthe le/

kaiḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dgyes bskang dung gi mchod pa grags stong rol mo bzhugs soḥrkaḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye ri shā bsre bswo be+eḍār+ya yi 'od khyims lasaḥ bdud rtsi sbrang char dbab pa'i rgyunaḥ in+d+ra'i rang bzhin rgya mtsho laḥ brten nas 'khrungs pa bkra shis dung: kha tog dkar po dri ma med zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i rtagasaḥ bkrag mdangs 'bar ba 'od kyis 'khyudaḥ rgyas pa'i brin las grub pa'i rtagasaḥgrags pa snyan pa bsam mtha' yasaḥ dbang gi mdzad pa 'byung ba'i rtagasaX mjug ma ring la dbyibs mjes paḥ drag po mngon spyod grub pa'i rtagasaḥ kha grags dang pos mchod pa niḥ bka' rgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dngaḥ gdul bya thabs kyis zin par shogaX kha grags gnyis pas mchod pa niX yi dam lhag pa'i lha la 'bulaḥ mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dngaX skal ldan pho mo smin gyur cigaḥ kha grags gsum pas mchod pa niḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bulaḥ bde stong rgyun

chad med pa dang:rnal 'byor rtsa mdud grol gyur cigaḥkha grags bzhi ba'i mchod pa niX ge sar dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bul mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog pa dngaḥsangs rgyas bstan pa dar gyur cigaX kha grags lnga pa'i mchod pa niḥdapa' btul grub chen rnams la 'bulaḥthugs dam las la bskul ba dang phrin las rab 'byams sgrub tu gsolaḥkha grags drug pa'i mchod pa niḥ nga ma dung sman rnams la 'bul thabs kyi phyag rgyar bskul ba dngaḥbade stong rtogs pa 'bar gyur cigaḥkha grags bdun pa'i mchod pa niḥbaka' 'khor pho nya rnams la 'bulaḥmatha' bzhi'i dmag dpung 'dul ba dngaḥchos bstan dar zhing rgyas par mdzod kha grags brgyad pa'i mchod pa niḥdapal mgon dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bulaḥkha 'dzin sdong grogs rgyab rten dngaḥrtags par 'tsho rdzi ma g.yel zhigaḥkha grags dgu pa'i mchod pa niḥskyes bu lam wa'i tshogs la 'bulaḥphyogs bcu gar 'gro'i don 'byung zhingaḥdagra jag rkyen las rgyal bar mdzodaḥkha grags bcu pa'i mchod pa niḥgayang lha gter bdag rnams la 'bulaḥbasod

)ཿ nams longs spyod rgyas pa dang dngos grub char ltar dbab tu gsol kha grags bcu gcig mchod pa niḥ zung skyobs byed pa'i lha la 'bulaḥ lus dang grib ltar 'grogs pa dang lus ngag yid gsum skyabs tu gsolaḥ kha grags bcu gnyis mchod pa ni dkar phyogs che/ngas ba rnams la 'bulaḥ nad mug 'tshon 'khrugs zhi ba dngaḥ 'jigs pa kun las dbugs dbyung mdzodaḥ kha grags bcu gsum mchod pa niḥ rtse 'dzin gnam la dkar por 'bulaḥ dgra bla mi dang ma bral cigaX phrin las rab 'byams 'grub par mdzodaḥ kai yis pho nya las la bskulaḥ bsgo yis mtha' dmag dpa' rkongs shingaḥ yis bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phelaḥ don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa dngaX phywa g.yang rab tu rgyas par mdzodaX zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel b.raḥ gnyer bcol phrin las 'byung gyur cigaḥ de ltar dung rabs phul ba yis grags pa rgyas shing snyan pa 'bar bsod nams longs spyod phel ba sogs yon tan bsam mi khub pa 'byungaḥ sa ma yuḥye maḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud 'de gangs dkar ti se'i brag la sbas dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na nga sprul las can bu yis rted

sbyi mthun las kyis ma bkags na bstan 'gro'i rgud pa skyobs par byed bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshosasrungs 'dod sred can la ma shor cigaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥlhaḥ zhes pa'ang lun zin 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shisadage ba'i skyes du mar bcas rte bskul ba dang / las smon 'phro 'dzoms 'gyur rdor nas thabs shes mtshon pa'i lha regs rin chen snag shog dri bral dkar yol gyi skyes bcas bskul ngor/kho bo sbasapa'irnal 'gar nus ldan dpal gyi rdo rjes dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni 'gyur med rdo rjes bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

kaiḥ bka' rgya gnad yi lde mig lasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dar rabasadapa' bo'i dgyes mchod bzhugs dre kaiḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye sgodza//161 mdung la dar btags mkha' la basbre sa dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bul ba ni bswo chos dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha'i klong dkyil nasaḥ rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi rjeḥ o rgyan chen po pad+ma rgyal po yiX phrin las 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rin po cheḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ 'dir byon dar la bzhugs shing mthu ma chungaḥ dgra bla brten la brten no skyabs ma zhanaX bswo be+eḍūr yangs pa'igazhiraḥ nyi zla skar tshogs bkraḥ chos dbyings nam mkha'i dar lha ngo bstod phyir bsgrengasaḥ dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogasaḥ dgra bla ge sar bcas: dpa' bo rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chung: srung ma rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhanaḥ dkar po rin chen dungaḥ 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'byud ༷ 'od gsal lha yi dar: bar snang mdzes pa'i rgyanaḥ grub thob rig 'dzin tshogasaḥ ka ne kum pa mchodaX

dgra bla rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chungaḥ dpal mgon rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhanaḥ bsaḥ kai lang rin chen gseraḥ 'dzam bu chu bcad sbyaraḥ rin chen sna bdun 'dzomasaḥ yon tan rgyas pa'i daraḥ gser shog dpa' btul mchodaX gser zhal bdag la ngomasaḥ dpa' btul rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chungaḥ che rgyud rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhanaḥ bswo dmar ser ngur kha ba mchal gyi thig le laX bcu drug dga' bdes 'khyudaḥ dbab thang dpal gyi daraX 'om bu'i dpa' btul mchodaX be+eḍūr zhal bzang ngoms dpa' btul rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chungaḥ 'bring rgyud rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhanaḥ bas rgya mtsho 'khyugs pa'i gzhiraḥ klu yi dga' ston dpalaḥ rin chen du ma'i sprin phrin las thog med daraḥ dmu phyang dpa' sde mchodaḥ bde stong zhal bzang ngomasaḥ dpa' btul rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chung chung rgyud rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhanaḥ bswoḥ dar tshon sna lnga'i gzhiraḥ stag seng khyung 'brug bkraḥ gnam bcu dbang dang ldanaḥ che ba phun tshogs dar blon chen sde bzhi mchod phrin las zhal

kaiḥ bzang ngomasaX dpa' btul rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chung blon sde rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhan bsto chu 'dzin srungs pa'i dar: dbang thang dpal mdzod bkra: rta mchog rin chen brgyanaḥ 'dod 'byung nor bu khuraX thugs dang mthun pa'i rdzasaḥ dung sman tshogs la 'bulaḥ dga' bzhi'i zur mig g.yosaḥ'o chu 'dzin rgyas thob sgyu lus zag pa zadaḥ bde ba'i sku ru sminaḥ ma rgyud rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chungaḥ mkha' 'gro rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhanaḥbaswo dar nag yangs pa'i gzhiraX thog 'brug glog gsum bkraḥ seja stag dom gsum 'gyeb sa gling bzhi'i dpal gyis spudaX chos skyong tshogs la 'bul lus dang grib bzhin 'grogasaḥ chos skyong rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chungaḥ bsru ma rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhanaḥ bswo rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i don kha g.yang tshig gi brdaraḥ snyan pa'i glu yis bskulaX bkra shis yon mchog daraX bstod bsngags me tog bcasaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i tshogasaḥ dgongs pa'i dbyings nas bskyedaX phywa g.yang gter sgo phyesaḥ zas kyi char ba phobaḥ

gos bzang lho sprin spungasaḥ rgyan gyi me tog 'thor gtam gyi khu phyug sgrogasaḥ grags pa'i dbyar rnga ldiraḥ dpa' rtags rgyal rnga brdungaḥ mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgrings zhi bsil gser gdugs kub skyid pa'i pad 'dab stengaḥ rtsibs stong lag la 'byoraḥ kha grags dpal gyis bskul phrin las dpal be'u'i klong0 gdul bya dbang du bsdusaḥ bum bzang bdud rtsi'i rgyunaX gser mig tshal la dbabaḥ gshog pa'i rtsal drug 'dzomasaḥ mkha' spyod zhing la 'phur rig 'dzin rgyal po dgyesaX dpa' mo 'dzum pas 'khyudaḥmakha' 'gro'i thal glus bstodaX pad+ma'i phrin las grub dus kyi ru 'dzing zhiX skye rgu bde skyid ldan 'dzam gling chos kyis phyug de ring bsam don 'byungaX dgra bla'i thugs dam bskangs mi dang ma bral cigaḥ dgra bla rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chungaḥ lha bsrung rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma yinaḥ rnal 'byer bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥzhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yer sa ma yāḥ de ltar dar rabs phul ba yis dgra bla'i dbu 'phang dgongs la reg mi yi tshe 'a rog skyobs byed bsod nams dbang thang rgyas par 'gyuraḥs ma yuḥmimaḥrgyal dbang

mo/ཿ pad+ma saṃ bha pha' thugs kyi yang bcud man — ga 'di gangs dkar ti se'i brag la sbas dus rkya snyigs mar gyur pa na nga sprul las can bu yis rnyed spyo mthun las gyi ma bkag na snyigs ma' rgud pa cha shesaskyobs byin rlabs rno nus bsam mtha' yas bka' 'ad dam can rgya mtshos srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhig sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim 3 ཿ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po 'gyur me da rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskul ba dang / a khyung mi rje dam pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bkra shis pa'i dar chen bcas te bskul ba dang / las ldan 'gyur rdor nas thabs shes mtshon pa'i 7 regs rin chen snag shogs dri bral dkar yol bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ kho bo sbasapa'i rnal 'byor bdud 'dul dpal gya rdo rjesadabyings sna mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa na las ldan 'gyur rdor gyas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

rkeḥ bka' rgya gnad gyi lde mig lasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dgyes bskyed ṭā ma ru dang dril bu'i mchod pa kun bzang rol mo bzhugs soḥrkaḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye ziri/snakhoX snang sto rdo rje dril bu yi dgyes ma chod 'bul ba 'di lta steḥbs chos dbyings stong pa de bzhin nyidaḥ rnam kun mchog ldan yum byi mkha'aX rdo rjegasum gyi dbyings rdzogs dalaḥ rnam par mi rtog ye shes ngangaḥ grags stong chos kyi sgra snyan sgrogasaḥ ngo mchar mchod rdzas ya mtshan can ༷ sna ba thabs kyi rdo rje dngaḥ stong pa shes rab dril bu'i gzugs ༷ zung 'jug bde stong mchod pa/ yisaḥ bka' brgyud bla ma gsol zhing mchod don dam chos sku'i rang zhal stonaḥ yi dam lha tshogs snyan la 'bulaḥ stong nyid chos kyi rang sgra sgrogasaḥ ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bulaḥ shu bde mchog tu 'bar bar mdzodaḥ bka' sdod dam can las la sbranaḥ phrin las rnam bzhi rtag tu sgrubasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po 'i thugs dam bskangs: bdud bzhi cham la phab tu gsolaḥ dpa' btul sum cu'i dgyes pa bskyedaḥ bstan 'gro'i don du

mdzad phrin bskulaX ma sring dung sman tshogs la 'bulaX phywa g.yang dngos grub char ltar bsnyil grub thob brgyad cu'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ don gnyis 'bad med 'byung bar mdzodaḥ khams gsum chos kyi sgra yis khyabaX gdul bya'i blo gros pad+mo rgyas rmad byung gu ru'i mdzad pa 'grubaḥ 'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cigaḥsnyen badz+ra gharnye dharmā hūṃ āḥ ma hā pu dza hoḥ thod rnga' mchod pa ni bsto bsto bzhwa ka dag chos sku'i pho brang nasaḥ dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma rnamasaḥ bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskulaḥ te dang te ke bhan+ta rngaX rang bzhin 'od gsal pho brang nasaX yi dam rgyud dang sgrub sde'i lhaX bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskul te gang te ke bhan+ta rnga bde stong zung 'jug pho brang nas mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogasaḥ bcu drug ltar sprod zod rngas bskulaḥ te gang te gang bhan+ta rnga rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas reg 'jin rgyal po sgod phreng rtsal bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskulaḥ te gang te gang bhasto rngaX o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dbus nasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po yangaḥ bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskul te gang te gang bhan+ta

rka rnga mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nasaḥ dpa' btul grub chen sum cu po bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskul te gang te ga bhan+ta rnga nam mkha' 'ja' yi gur khang nas ja ma dug sman rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskulaḥ te gang te gang bhan+ta rnga 'od gsal thig le bkra ba'i klongaḥ gnam gong sman gyi rgyal mo yang bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskulaX te gang te dang bhan+ta rnga bsil ldan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sring lcam tha le 'od dkar maX bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskul te gang te gang bhan+ta rnga sa bla mngon par mtho ba nasaX lja bu dung gtsug lha dmag 'bumaḥbacu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskulaḥ te ga te gang bhan+ta rngaX bar snang yangs pa'i slong dkyil nasaX a bo ker mdzod gnyan dmag 'bum bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskulaḥ te dang te gang bhan+ta rngaX sa 'og rgya mtsho'i klong dkyil nasaḥ gtsug na rin chen klu dmag 'bumaḥ bka' 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcasaḥ bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskulaḥ te dang te dang bhan+ta rngaX phrin las lhun grub pho brang nasaḥdapa' btul

dgra bla'i dmags tshogasarnamasaḥ bcu drug ltag sprod thod rngas bskul te gang te gang bhan+ta rnga gsang sngags bstan pa dar ba dngaḥ bshad sgrub 'dzad phrin rab rgyas teḥ rgyal khams bde skyid chos kyis 'tshoX don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa dang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem gyur cigaḥ o badz+ra shasta pra tits+tsha āḥdhūX de ltar thod rnga dril bu yi dgyes bskyed mchod pa 'di spros pas dam tshag nyams chagasanyes lhung dag chos sgras gdul dka' 'dul bar nges sa ma yuḥ sa ma rgyal dbang pad+ma bha wa'i thugs kyi yang bcud man ngag 'di gangs dkar ti se'i brag la sbasaḥ dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa naḥ sprul las can bu yis rded spyi mthun las kyis ma bkags na dus kyi ru 'dza nyams pa ra 'gyur bde skyid dpal gyi dga' ston sbyin bka' 'ad dam can rgya mtshos srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor cigaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thim snyiḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskul ba dngaḥ a khyung mi rje bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos mdzes pa'i yol chen bcas te bskul ba dang / las ldan 'gyur rdor nas thabs shes mtshon pa'i lha regs rin chen snag shog dri bral dkar yol bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ kho po sbasapa'i rnal 'byor bdud 'dulakhyung drag rol ba rtsal gyisadabyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda
rku ཿ ma dzod las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa ni 'gyur rdor gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'aze la/ sarba maṅga la/

kaiḥ bka' rgya gnas kyi lde mig lasaX dgra bla'i rgyal po ge sar skyes bu don grub rtsal gyi dgyes skyed rkang gling mchod pa bzhugasaḥkaiḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ tsamangoskos dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa yis gri rkang glang bu' mchod pa ni bsto mchog chen dpa' po snying stobs can shin tu 'brugs pa'i zhe sdang gis gdug rtsub mtshon cha 'gyed pa'i tshe dpa' ngar gra so ma nyams par am gtsig man bsdam mig zung bsgradaḥ tsit+ta'i sbub nas rnams shes 'phar rten 'byung lus la 'brel ba can de yi rkang gling mchog tu bshad dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rdzas su bsngags dbang phyug bdag gi phyag mthil bkod ting 'dzin sngags kyis byin rlabs teḥ dang po lan gcig 'bud tsa naḥ zhe sar dgra bla'i rgyal po de mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings nas bskulaḥ dgra bla'i dpa' chas klubs bzhin duḥ cang shes rkyang rgod 'phur shes bcibs 'od gsal sbrang char 'ja' zer 'khrigs mgo nag mi yi skyabs su pheb de nas lan gnyis 'bud tsa naX ja ma dung sman mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥ o rgyan

mkha' spyod zhing nas bskulaX sku yi gar bsgyur ldem rtsal g.yoḥ gsung dbyangs snyan pa'i me tog 'thor thugs ni bde stong 'od gsal 'baraḥ dgra bla'i rgyal pos dgyes pa skongs rnam mang phrin las bskul ma byed rdzong chen bco brgyad lde'u mig rnamasaḥ thugs dam dgyes bskangs dngos grub char skal ldan sgrub pa po la zhu de nas lan gsum 'bud tsa na dpa' btul dgra bla'i dmag tshogasarnams dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings las bskulaḥ kai bas cha sgras stong gsum g.yo lha klu gnyan dmag bu yug 'tshubs bdud kyi dmag tshogs 'dar zhing sngangs dregs pa can gyis bu yug 'tshubasaḥ dgongs spyod dam tshig rnam dag pas bsgral 'dren las la thog med paraḥ gzes pos rnam shes dbyings su sboraḥ 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo chos skur sangs dpa' rtags ya mtshan srid na spa dpa' btul rnams kyi thugasadam bskangs mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod de nas lan bzhi 'bud tsa naḥ dgra bla'i dmag tshogs las la bskulaX ru dar sna tshogs nam mkhar mnyamaḥ go khrab sna tshogs rgyun thag bsdams mda' mdung mtshon

rkuX cha'i rno ngar brdaraḥ rta rgyugs ldog sgra thags thag g.yoḥ me rlung dug gi zi ra 'tshubasaX thog 'brug glog dang ser ba kholaḥ kai yi lha 'bod di ri ri gnyan gyi bswo sgra 'u ru na/ klu yi cha sgra sangs se sang0 dug gsum gdon gyi kha lo bsgyuraḥ khams gsum 'khor ba rmings nas bshigasaX sku gsum klong du dgongs rgyas 'debasaḥ dpa' bo'i dmags tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥ mngon spyod phrin las mthar phyin mdzod: de nas lan lnga 'bud tsa naX thub pa'i bstan pa rin po cheḥ spong klog nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam spel 'bras bu nang rgyud yo ga gsumaḥ bshad sgrub bstan pa'i pad tshal dngar mos bzhi dbang du bsgyur ba dngaḥ dam pa chos kyi lam la sbyoraḥ nyams dang rtogs pa'i sgron me sboraḥ tshe dang mdzad phrin bsam yas 'phelaḥ dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i ngo so mthoḥ nag phyogs gdug pa cham la phab nad mug dus kyi rgud pa zhiḥ phywa g.yang longs spyod char ltar brnyil skye dgu thams cad bde la 'god yangs ba'i rgyal khams skyid kyis 'tshoḥ o rgyan pa d+ma'i mdzad phrin grubaḥ dal rten rin chen chos dang ldan skyid kyi nyi

ma phyogs lhung bral bde stong dung gi zla ba tshes bcu drug dga' bde'i skar tshogs bkraḥ 'od gsal 'ja' lnga'i rgyal mtshan btsugs chu 'dzin dar dkar yol ba bkrams zhi bsil rma bya'i gdugasakhang phub nor bu'i dgos 'dod char ba 'bebasaḥ khams gsum dge ba'i bkra shis dpalaḥ rnam pa kun tu 'bar gyur cigaX kai bas cha'o lha rgyal loḥbacol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ de ltar rkang gling phul ba'i rabs rnal 'byor lam gyi cha rkyen de gsang sngagasadzos brten daro sa grub nye sngagasapa'i brten na mchog tu bsngagasaḥ sam yuḥ ye maḥ rgyalaba' dbang po pad+ma ngas thugasakyi yang bcud man ngag 'di gangs dkar ti se' brag la sbas snyags mar nad mtshon gzi langs tshe nga sprul las can gcag gis rnyed spron log bdud kyis ma bkagasan dus kyi ru 'dzang gzhesas par byed bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshosasrung dam nyamasalag tu ma shor zhigaḥ sam wāḥ rgya rgya rgya brda thim snyiḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang a khyung bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho lasaldan 'gyur rdor rnamasakyi bkra shis dge ba'i skyesadu mar bcasate nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ kho bo sbasapa'i la'abyor nusaldan dpa gyi rdo rjesadabyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod la bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni las ldan 'gyur rdor gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/

keḥ bka' rgya gnad gyi lde'u mig lasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dgyes bskul mda' dar dpal gyi dga' ston bzhugs soḥrkuḥ na 31 gu dzag pad+ma ka ra yeḥ tho(1lha/smra/1/spyis mda' la dar tshon sna lnga btagasaḥ gser dngul g.yu byur rin chen sgron dkyil 'khor g.yas su mdzes par bkod lha mi yongs kyi dpal du brten bsgo tshe 'da' bkra shis 'gyur med 'diḥ rin chen sangs rgyas spyan ma'i bskyedaḥ dbying phyug ma yis bdud rtsi dbabaḥ gos dkar dam tshig sgrol mas brtenaX ma mā ki yis phun sum tshogasaḥ tshig pa bcu gsum 'dzoms pa laḥ dgra bla bcu gsum 'du 'bral medaḥ mda' ltong dbang chen rta mgrin gnasaḥ mde'u a stag phag mo'i dal sgo gsum lha klu gnyan rje bstodaX dar tshon dkar po dung 'dra laḥ dpal btul dkar po sde bzhi brtenaX dar tshon ser po gser 'dra laḥ dpa' bo gser mdog sde bzhi brtenaḥ dar tshon dmar po mtshal 'dra laḥ mdzes pa dbang mdog sde bzhi brten dar tshon smug po mchong 'dra laX rig 'dzin spug po sde bzhi brtenaḥ dar tshon sngon po mkha' 'dra laḥ mi

nag grub chen sde bzhi brtenaḥ dar tshon ljang gu mtsho 'dra laX rtsal chen dpa' bo sde bzhi brtenaḥ dung shā rin chen mdzes pa laḥ g.yang lha sgo bzhi srungs ma brtenaX mgron bu pad+ma'i thig le la ja ma dung sman tshogs rnams brtenaX rin chen gser gyi sa le sgrom g.yang lha nor lha phyugs lha brtenaX byu ru 'od 'bar mig gsum la pha lha ma lha phyug lha brten khrab byang mdzes pa mig dgu laḥ dgra lha phrag lha thams cad brten dar ras stag ras gzig ras la0 phywa cha g.yang gi dpal rnams brten dkyil 'khor dbus su bkod pa ni rma rgyal gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra rma g.yang phun sum tshogs par re gaḥ gser can mar khus bkang ba ni gser gyi mtsho bdun bkod pa 'draḥ klu g.yang phun sum tshogs par shogaḥ g.yas su bye mar bkod pa niX dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab 'draḥ lha g.yang phun sum tshogs par shogaḥ gter bum nor bu'i bang mdzod ni lho sprin 'ja' yi 'khyud pa 'dra: gnyan g.yang phun sum tshogs par sgo gaḥ mkhan bya dpag bsam ljong shing 'dra: dgyes bskang bya rigs bcu gsum 'dzomasaḥ dpal 'byor phun sum

rkaḥ tshogs par shogaḥ rten gyi mchog gyur mda' dar 'disaX 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bskulaX pu ṭa mi yi dngos grub bskulaḥ bde stong phyag rgyas dngos grub bskulaX mi dbul nor gyi dngos grub bskul ༷ rin chen brgyan gyi dngos grub bskulaX rta lug gnag gi dngos grub bskulaX dbang thang dpal gyi dngos grub bskulaX dam pa chos kyi dngos grub bskul: 'khor slob 'dus sde'i dngos grub bskulaḥ mnga' thang stobs kyi dngos grub bskulaḥ rigs sngags nus mthu'i dngos grub bskulaḥ sa lam 'bras bu dngos grub bskul: yon tan ma lus kun bsdus nasaX mda' dar 'di la rten chos laḥ tshe gang skyid pa'i gnas thob steḥ mkha' spyod rig 'dzin 'grub pa dang 'ja' lus 'od sku mngon gyur regagaḥ snyen swā sti sirnyi maṅga leḥ gzhan yang shis brjod rgya cher bya des ni dgos 'dod lhun grub 'gyur sa ma yāḥyem rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng ge thugs kyi yang bcud zab pa 'i gter gangs dkar ti se'i brag la sbas dus kyi snyigs mar gyur ri na sprul las can gcig gis rted smon log dam sris ma bkag na dus kyi rgud pa cha shes skyobs bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos sru sa gshe bskur mkhan la ma shor

gcigaḥ sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho 'gyur rdor rnams kya bkra shis dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan pa du mar bcas te nan tan chen po sa bskul ngor/kho bo sbasapa'i rnala'abyor nu ldan dpal gyi rdo rje dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa ni 'gyur rdor gyas bgyis pa dge legasaḥ sarba ma le/

rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde'u mig lasaḥge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i shing rtsi dang bya rigs 'bul ba thugs dam dgyes bskyed bzhugs soḥkeḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye go2 ga 56 shang rtsi sna tshogs bya rigs bcas sngags da phyag rgyas spel byas teḥka hrī rnga yab gling nas pad+ma thod phreng gis phrin las rtsal thob ge sar dgra bla'i rjeḥsgrub mchog bdag gi 'bod do da tshur byon phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub char du bsnyilaḥkya shugs pa sngon po g.yu yi lo 'dab canaḥgasung snyan g.yu bya dbyed kyi rgyal mos bstodaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po mchod cing bskangasaḥ'ajigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las grub mdzod cigaḥ su ru dkar po dung gi me tog canaḥmathing ril sngon po bdud rtsi 'dzin pa'i bstodaḥge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po mchod cing bskangasaḥrgyas pa'i brin las tshe dpal bsod nams bskyed gya rta dmar po zangs kyi lan phran canaḥsgogs 'jo gsung snyan 'jol bya'i rnam par bstodaḥge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po mchod cing bskangasaḥdabang gi brin las bde stong dga' bzhi bskyedaḥlha lo sman

shing bdud rtsi'i lo ma can ngang ngur gong mo rtse 'jo byed cing bstod ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po mchod cing bskangs drag pos phrin las phyogs bzhi'i mtha' dmag bzlogaḥtsan dan dkar dmaradri bsung ldan pa'i shing gser dngul g.yu dang byi ru'i bya yis bstodaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po mchod cing bskangasaḥ rnal 'byor nang don rtogs pa mkha' mnyam spelaX dkar smug a dkar sgron shing ro nus ldan snyugs bya de'u mo dang khrung khrung bstodaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po mchod cing bskangasaḥ rnam mang phrin las rabs 'byams char ltar phobaX seng ldeng dmar po bde drod 'phel ba'i shingaḥ ka la peng ka kṛ ti pa yis bstod ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po mchod cing bskangasaX nyon mongs tsha gdung zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod sgrub mchog bdag gi kha 'dzin rgyab brten gyisaḥ chos mthun bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dngaX bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho'i mtsho bar ma——daX de ltar ljon shing bya rigs 'bul rnam mang phran las gang bcol 'grub sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin grags pa'i dpal da 'gyur med rdo rje gnyis kyi nan tan chen pos bskul ba dang
ma

rkaX bka' rgya gnad kyi lde'u mig lasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dgyes bskyed bye mar rin chen spungs pa bzhugs soḥrkuḥ na 31 gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye shāsnye sto1 phye mar gangs ltar spu ba la 'bri mar thig le'i tshom bu bkod sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs te dgra bla'i rgyal por 'bul ba ni baX lha yi mar la klu yi zhunaḥ 'bru sna bdun gyi bye mar 'diX gangs dkar rin chen spungs pa laḥ bdud rtsi'i zil ba 'khrigs pa 'draḥ 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i mu 'byud laḥ sna tshogs pad+mo gcal du bkramaḥ chos dbyings nam mkha' mdzes pa'i rgyanaḥ 'dod yon lnga yi 'od phung 'baraḥ lce la regs pa'i lus sems bdeX khung du btang bas nyon mongs grolaḥ lha yi dga' ston gnyan gyi yasaḥ klu yi longs spyod dgra bla'i gsos kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston 'dis 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po mchodaX phyogs bzhi'i bdud bzhi 'dul ba dang rgyal khams chos la 'god par mdzodaḥ dpal 'bum rgya tsha zhal dkar mchodaḥ btsan po'i gtsan g.yang 'dir khug cigaX gser sde tshangs pa'i bu yag mchodaḥ phyug po'i

phyug g.yang 'dir khug cigaḥ bdud gcod shan pa me ru mchodaḥ 'phan po'i 'phan g.yang 'dir khug cigaḥ 'bru ba chos skyongs rgod po mchodaX dar bo'i dar g.yang 'dir khug cig 'dan ma rin chen bsam 'grub mchod dpal rtsal stobs g.yang 'dir khug cigaX 'om bu'i khra tsha glog 'byugs mchodaḥ pho lha dkar po'i kha 'dzin mdzodaX dung skyongs stag lha khri dkar mchod 'phrag lha rin chen 'bral med mdzodaḥ g.yu lha thog rgod 'bar ba mchodaX dgra lha gnyan po'i dbu 'phang bstodaX sngags kyi dbang phyugs khro thung mchod grogs lha gnyen pos grogs dang sprodaḥ rgya ru khra chung nor bu mchodaḥ 'dod ster zas lha 'dzum pa'i skyongasaḥ a yag thar ba rgyal mtshan mchod zhing lha gnyan po'i kha 'dzin mdzodaḥ 'om bu a nu dpa' seng mchodaḥ tshong lha nor bu'i dpal kha sprodaḥ rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra mchod jag lha'i tshe sgog shug ma mdzodaḥ dpal lha mu spyangs dkar po mchod dpa' 'dzang stag ltar ldan par mdzod 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me mchodaḥ mda' rtsal thog las ngar bar mdzod ༷ a stag rdo rje phag mo mchod bde stong 'du

rku ཿ 'bral med par mdzodaḥ dpa' bo zhal dkar ldem pa mchod mi rgyud chu las ring bar mdzo daḥ be ru'i sras mchog rat+na mchodaḥ mi rgyud gser las bzang bar mdzodaḥ 'om bu'i rnal 'byer dar li mchodaḥ mi srog brag las sra bar mdzod0 sras po lha rgod 'bum me mchod/ mi 'bru nas las mang bar mdzodaḥ la sras dgra la rtse rgyal mchodaX mi g.yang rab tu 'phel du gsolaḥ dpa' bo ga dar spyang sngon mchod nor g.yang rab tu 'phel du gsolaḥ mi chen dpa 'a bo lhun grub mchodaḥ zas g.yang rab tu 'phel du gsolaḥ mi thung khro rgyal rgod po mchodaḥ chos g.yang rab tu 'phel du gsolaḥ dgra bla dpa' btul sum bcu mchod bsam don 'bad med 'grub par mdzod ja ma dung sman thams cad mchodaḥ dga' bzhi'i zur mig 'bar bar mchodaḥ dpa' btul grub chen brgyad cu mchod ༷ sa lam nyams rtogs 'barabar mdzodaḥ bka' 'khor sprul pa yang g.yog mchodaḥ 'di phyi gnyis kyi don 'tshob mdzodaX kai bswo cha'o wa rgyal loḥ de ltar phye ma/ra thu la ba yis bsod nam sa ye shes tshogs rdzo gas 'gyur sa ma yā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma se bha wa'

thugs kyi yang bcud zab pa'i gter gangs dkar ti se'i brag la sbasaḥ o rgyan sprul pa gcig gis rnyed gdul byas lhag ma de yis skyongs 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing bkod 'gyuraḥ sa ma shāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥdziḥzhesapa'ang lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtsho bstan 'dzan rgya mtsho 'gyur med rdo rje rnams kyis bkra shis dge ba'i bskyes bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ kho bo nusaldan 'dusapa rtsal gyisadabyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa ni las ldan 'gyur rdor gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/ zhus so

rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde'u mig lasaḥ 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub kyi bsang gsol bdud rtsi'i sprin phung bzhugs soX rkaḥ na 31 gu dzag pad+ma ka ra yeḥ rte/3)sa/ lha shing sna tshogs dud pa btang bzang drug phye mar rin chen brdar sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel rol mo snyan pa' glus bskul te na 31 rat+na dra yā yaḥ skyabs bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum dngaḥ chos bden pa gnyis kyi bden mthu stobasaḥ sngags ting 'dzin phyag rgya zab mo'i mthusaX bas bdud rtsi kun bzang mchod pa'i sprinaX steng lha yi dga' ston nam mkhar mnyam: bar mi yi 'dod dgus gling bzhi khyabaḥ 'og klu yi nor snas sa gzhi phyuraḥ ngo mtshar ba'i mchod sprin bsam mtha' yasaX 'dod yon gyi lha mo'i bro gar bsgyuraḥ dga' ston la ma tshang med pa'i dkoraḥ dpe ting 'dzin nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'phrulaḥ mthong thos dang dran reg ngoms tshim 'dis bu 'dzam gring seng chen rgyal po bsang sku ya seng 'phrul gyi lde mig bsang dpal ma seng nor bu dgra 'dul bsang phyogs bzhi yi dgra 'dul dbang phyug gling bzhi yi

skyabs mgon dam pa bsangaḥ bod mgo nag skyongs ba'i rje bo bsang rdzong bco brgyad len pa'i lde mig bsang dpal a co 'phrul gyi jo ru bsang ban sngags sde yongs kyi srung ma bsang bon zhung zhung kun rgyu'i gshed po bsang rje sangs rgyas pad+ma'i phrin las bsang lha dbang chen 'dzum pa'i zhal bzang bsangaḥ khong grub chen brgyad cu'i rgyal po gling dpa' btul yongs kyi rtse 'dzin bsang phywa g.yang dang nor gyi gter mdzod bsangaX sku'i dgra bla dpa' chas thams cad bsang bdud btul ba'i mdung zhags ral gri bsangaḥ rta cang shes rkyang rgod 'phel po bsangaḥ stobs rdzu 'phrul rlung gi shugs can bsangaX phyi'i zol tshul nang gi sems dpa' bsangaḥ sa gsum la dbang ba'i phrin las bsang dpal don kun grub pa'i rta mchog bsang thugs dgyes skongs dung sman bco brgyad bsang rga skya los seng lcam 'brug mo bsang dpa' a stag rdo rje phag mo bsang yang smon grub byang chub sgron ma bsang lung legs nyes shan 'byed g.yu sgron bsangaḥ bdud thod mda' 'debs grogs 'bum mtsho bsangaX dpal bde stong bskyed pa'i chos

rkaḥ mtsho kong mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i la mdzes bsangaḥ ma rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig bsangaX des phrin las mkha' 'gro thams cad bsangaḥ dpa' ya med 'bum gyi ngo len bsang ཿ rgya mi chen rgyal po'i tsha bo bsangaX mdangs bco lnga'i zla zhal dkar po bas ཿ bdud mun khams bsregs pa'i dpa' bo bsang rje sbyi dpon sa ra ha pa bsangaḥ dpal tshe yi rig 'dzin chen po bsab ཿ gling bstan pa dar ba'i gzhi ma bsaja ཿ dpa' grub chen yongs kyi blo rten bsangaḥ mi tshe ring kha dge bkra shis bsangaḥyab sang blon ku ku rū pa bsang lus bde stong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangaX sems 'od gsal rtogs pa' sgron ma bsang rtsal 'gags med srid kyi 'char sgo bsangaḥ dbang pad+ma'i zhal can rong tsha bsangaḥ sbyor sgrol gyi phul phyin la rgod bsangaḥ dpal rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra bsangaX dpa' thog med dgra lha rtse rgyal bsangaX yang g.yang lha mi spyang dkar po bsang: gling chung rgyud mi dgu rta dgu bas ཿ 'khor dmu spyang dpa' bo bzlog med bsangaḥ dpa 'a drag rtsal 'dran zla bral ba bsangaḥ stobs rdzu 'phrul mkhyen gnyis rgyas pa

bsangaḥ sa gsum na grags pa'i dpa' btul bsang 'dran zla med gling sde'i ya gyal bsang: de'i blon chen sde bzhi'i dmag tshogs bsang mda'i rtsal thob 'dan ma rin chen bsang sras dpa' rgod g.yu 'od 'bum me bsangaḥ 'khor dpa' mdzang khri skor bco brgyad mon dung skyong stag lha khri dkar bsangaḥ de'i mapha kheb dpa' bo bco brgyad bsang dmag dung 'phru can la bsgrangs yas bsangaḥ hor ser po'i bdud gcod shan pa bsangaX srog gcod pa'i blon chen sde dgu bsang 'khor ri thang dar dmar 'phru can bsangaḥblon ta zig zhal dkar ldem pa bsang yang a grags dam pa'i mi bcu bsangaḥ 'khor 'phru sngon can la 'bum sde bsang 'jang sgrug po'i g.yu lha thog 'gyur bsangaḥ dpa' wa thul skyes bu bcu drug bsang yang smug po'i 'phru can 'bum sde bsang kong srid skyongs spyang thul dkar po bsangaḥ ru brgyad kyi dgra bla mched brgyad bsang rgya kha che kong gi las dmag bsangaḥ yang blon chen ga dar byang sngon bsangaḥ las byed pa'i gtso bo sbun drug bsangaḥ 'phru nag po can gyi dmag sde bsangaḥ dpal grub chen rin chen bsam

rkaḥ 'grub bsangaḥ rje sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dar lu bsang mtshal me stag bdud kyi kha gnon bsangaX dpa' ya med a nu dpal seng bsang yang khro tsha glog 'khyugs rgod po bsangaḥ ye 'bum pa g.yu yi mtshal glu bsangaX rong sde dpon stag mo 'byen yag bsangaḥ 'brog kha 'dzin gnam lha 'bum thub bsangaX yul tsho drug rje bo thams cad bsangaḥ rje grub brnyes rig 'dzin rgya mtsho bsangaḥ rtsis sman dang bla ma lha rje bsangaḥ 'khor g.yu 'phru can la mu med bsangaḥ yul 'om bu'i shog chen gnyan dmag bsangaḥyang stag rong dpon po khro rgyal bsang: don bde stong bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bas ཿ sngags phur thog yongs kyi gtso bo bsangaḥ ma mkha' 'gro yongs kyi grogs po bsang sgo khams gsum rol bar mnga' brnyes bsangaḥ 'phrul thabs mang dbang gi lcags kyu bsangaḥ dpal 'dod yon lnga po rgyan rol bsangaḥ gnas kun mkhyen gsal ba'i me long bsang rdzong nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lde mig bsangaḥ grogs che rgyud mi bzhi rta bzhi bsangaḥ mgon lha yag nyi 'bum nor bu bsangaḥ dgra lha mgon mi zi dmar po bsangaḥ btsan lha chen

stong thub rgod po bsangaḥ gza' khra tsha khri dar 'bum pa bsang 'khor stag rong shog chen bco brgyad bsangaḥ de'i rje dpon grub chen thams cad bsang ཿ 'bri rga bde'i chos skyongs ber nag bsangaX de'i sras mchog thog rgod 'bar ba bsang 'bri rin chen lha dpal gzhon nu bsang yul rga rje'i klu phyug dpa' bo bsangaḥ gser nyi 'bum lha dar stong thub bsang dpal lha chen tshangs pa ngo lug bsangaḥ gdung btsan po gnang li a dpal bsang dpa' ya med seng stag a dom bsang sog mi chen rga yi bla ma bsangaḥrje bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan bsangaḥ gdung be ru'i nyi ma rgyal mtshan bsang dpon a yag thar ba rgyal mtshan bsang stobs mthu ldan mgar ba rgyal mtshan bsang yul stag matre 'i pad+ma sangs rgyas bsangaX dpal nyag tsha grub pa'i dbang phyug bsang bu 'brug sgra tshang pa'i dpa' yag bsang sras rat+na bsam 'khru1ba rgyal po bsang yang mi thung dpa' brjid khro rgyal bsangaḥ bdud the'u 'gong dam 'dogs rgu ru bsang gling che rgyud shog chen brgyad cu bsangaḥ yang shog chung rtsi rtsi grangs med bsangaX khong rje bo grub chen

rkuḥ thams cad bas ཿblon thugs bskyed smon lam dag pa bsangaX'akhor ru 'dren 'phru can dmag sde bsangaḥgayang dpal 'dzin zhal dkar ldem pa bsangaḥrdzong nyer lnga'i lde mig thams cad bsangaḥsteng lha dmag bu yug 'tshubs 'dra bsang rje lha chen tshangs pa dkar po bsangaḥganam gong sman lha yi rgyal mo bsang sri rin chen tha le 'od dkar bsangaḥbar gnyan dmag thog ser khol 'dra bsang rje a bo ger mdzod dam pa bsangaḥganyan la sras thog lha rtse rgyal bsangaḥbadud btul ba'i klu phyug dpal ldan bsang 'og klu dmag rgya mtsho khol 'dra bsangaX rje klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen bsangaḥsras a yag dung gi me tog bas ཿ'dzin thabs mkhas rlung zhags dmar po bsangaḥbaka' 'khor tshogs sprul pa bsam yas bas ཿsku'i gzi mdangs rta bdun dbang po brjidaḥgasung dpal 'bar tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar snyanaḥthugs mkhyen brtse'i sgron mes mun khams sa saḥstobs yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyamasaḥrtsal phrin las mtha' bzhi'i dmag gi gshedaḥsngon thugs dam bzang po rjes dran nasaXdus

snyigs ma lnga yi smag rum 'dir yongs skye rgu'i spyi mthun las sdug skabasaX mtha' bzhi yi gral kha dmag gis nyams rje sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba phabaḥbod mgo nag bde skyid nub rir phyogasaḥgayang bsod nams dpal la hab thob byed sgra yod med mgo la thal mos 'debaḥsems gnyis 'dzin bdud kyi dug gis bsgyuraX las dmag jag gsod gcod tshong la g.yengaḥ'abyung bzhi yi dgra gshed 'thab mo ling yul dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rten skal nyamasaḥsmad mdo khams 'dren ston chos khams ralaḥbod mgon med nyam thag snying rje'i yul rje khyod kyis 'di la ma gzigs samaḥthugs dam bca' g.yel bar ma gyur ram:mi bdag gis 'o dod gdungs ba'i yus rje dpa' btul grub chen snyan la simaḥthugs dgongs pa'i rtsal mdangs myur bar g.yos skus 'dul ba rdzu 'phrul stobs bcas bskulaḥgasung 'dul ba bka' khrims chos kyis sdomaX thugs 'dul ba ru bzhi'i dmag sde stong yon tan gyis bstan pa'i sgon me sbor phrin las su rgyal khams bde skyid ldanaḥchos 'jig rten bya ba yang rabs kyiḥkhyim

rkeḥ drug cu dbul phongs rgud pas dbenaX dpal bde skyid 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis stsolaḥ che dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'phel rgyas mdzodaX mi skyid ldan dpung grogs lha rgyal lo gling kyi bswo cha sgra'i bstan pa daraḥ bu 'dzam gling skyes bu don grub kyisaḥ deng re smon 'di yang myur grub mdzodaX de ltar 'dzam gli bde ldan phyir dgra bla'i lha bsang 'di ltar phul dge mtshan dpa la gyi pad tshal bkra lugs gnyis lang tsho 'phel rgyas 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥyinamaḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugasabacud 'di dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na rgud pa sna mang 'byung ba' tshe 'tsho byed sman gya dngas ma na/gangs dkar ti se'i byang ngos sbas tshogs smon las 'phro 'dzoms pa yi skal pa can gyi dpal du rted 'dod sred mkhan la mi 'chor bar bstan pa' che ba bskyed phyar spel sngags kya bdag mos thub pa ra srungs thugs sras rag 'dzan dang 'phrad shogaḥ sa ma wāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyiḥ zhes pa'ang a khyu gong ma'i mi rje dam pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba da / lung zin snying jor dam pa byams chos nas thabs shes mtshon pa'i gos bzang / 'tsho byed sman dang nor mchog snag shog gis skyes bcas bskul ba dang / tshogs smon las 'dzoms 'gyur rdor da grogs racha' ming can rnams kyas bskul ngor/ kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus pa
rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zan ste tris bgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅka le/

rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal por rlung rta 'bul ba dbang thang dpal bskyed bzhugs soḥrku na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ 41rna110 la yi dmu dag dkar ngo dang gnyan gyi dar ser klu yi sngo sna tshogs khra bo phun sum sgrubs rten 'brel snying po'i rab tu gnas me tog 'thor zhing shis — brjod da sru mar 'bul ba ni kye dgongs la dpe blang sngon po be+eḍūr+yaḥ bde gshegs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams mchodaḥ gti mug rmong pa'i nongs pa mthol zhing bshags bya ba lhun gyi grub pa'i dbang tha bskyedaḥ gser la dpe blang ser bo ku lang dbyibs rabs 'byams rgyal ba'i sku yi dkyil 'khor mchodaḥ zhe sdang 'khrugs sems nongs pa mthol zhi bshagasaḥ 'jigs pa'i tshogs kun zhi ba'i las dbang bskyedaḥ mtshal la dpe blang dmar po rā ga'i gzugasaḥ gsung mchog pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor mchod 'dod zhen chags pa'i gdung sems mazol zheng bshagasaḥ khams gsum dbang du 'du ba'i rlang rta bskyedaḥ mtsho la dnge / blang dkar po rin chen shelaḥ yon tan rin

chen rigs mchog ma lus mchodaḥ nga rgyal rgyas pa'i 'khrugs sems mthol zhing bshagasaḥ tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang rlung rta bskyedaḥ g.yu la dpe blang ljang gu in+d+ra'i dpal phrin las rabs 'byams rgya mtsho'i dal du 'bul phrag dog rlung sems gnyis snang mthol zhing bshags gang brtsam bya ba mthar phyin dbang thang bskyed mkha' la mjes pa'i bya rgyal ga ru ṭaX dgung la grags pa'i dbyar rnga sgra bo cheḥ gangs la brjed pa'i gdong lnga g.yu ral canaḥ sa la dpa' 'dzing rgya stag 'dzums drug ldan chos skyongs dgra bla mnyes pa'i rten du 'bulaḥ mi dang ma bral kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzodaX srid na che ba'i dpal 'byor rtags mchog brgyadaḥ phun tshogs nor mchog rgyal srid rin chen bdunaḥ shin tu dge ba'i bkra shis rdzas mchog brgyad dpa' btul dgra bla'i tshogs la gus pas 'bul srungs skyobs ma zhan dpa' rtags rgyal kha bskyed che ba'i che ba gnam bcu dbang dang ldan rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan rta mchog rin chen brgyan rigs gsum 'phags pa'i snying po ya mtshan pa ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po dgyes phyir 'bul don

rkeḥ gnyis gang rtsam bya ba lhun grub mdzodaX tshong mgron jag sogs las bzhi gang brtsam yangaḥ bsam pa'i thog khel 'dod pa lag tu rnyed grags snyan 'byor bzhin myur ba'i shugs thob nasaX bkra shis bsam don 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cigaḥ de ltar phul ba'i bsam don 'grub mi mthun g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur sa ma wā rgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes pa 'ang dad ldan dhe wa'i bkra shis lha gos bcas bskul ngor /nu ldan pasaspel ba ma le/

rkuḥ badzaḥ de ring bkra shis nyi ma laḥ kun bzang bsang sprin nam mkha' mkha' mnyam spelaḥ 'dod dgu'i longs spyod char ltar 'bebasaḥ dgra bla'i dar chen dgungs la phyaraḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba bskyedaḥ sems can yongs la phan bde spelaḥmago nag skye rgu'i 'dug chas bsgrubaḥ byang chub sems kyis gzhir la drangs stong nyid rtogs pa'i sprul bsgyur 'gyedaḥ bswo dgra bla'i rgyal po mkha' la bstodaX dbu 'phang lha zhal dung las dkar brin las nam mkha'i glog ltar 'gyuḥ 'bul ba po la bsrungs skyobs mdzodaX mi ya tshe rdzi sgog skyobs gyisaḥ phyugs g.yang ru ma mtsho ltar bskyilaḥ rtsa dkar rigs rgyud 'ja' ltar bkraḥ za ma mo la dpal gsum 'dzomasaḥ mi mtha' chu las ring ba da ཿ mi 'bru nas bas 'phel ba dngaḥ mi rigs gser las bzang ba dngaḥ mi srog brag las sra bar mdzodaḥbaswo dgra bla'i rgyal po'i kha 'dzin mdzod ja ma dung sman tshogs kyis skyongasaḥ dpa' btul dam pa rnams kyis skyobs grub chen yo sa kyis byin gyis rlobasaX tshe 'dir ci bsam yid bzhin 'grubaḥ phyi ma rigs 'dzin
rdog// ḍiX rdordo~X 'khor ba dong sprugs nus par shogaḥ mo su stosidim le/ dgra bla'i dar bstod 'di ltar bya lha yi dpal 'dzoms phyu g.yang 'phel dgos pa che snyamasanu ldan pas rin ོ shog skyar gsal

rkuḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaX ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po la lam lha gnyer bcol bsam don lhun grub bzhugs soḥkeḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ 2) gnya la tu thugs mthun mchod dzos sna tshogs bsags sngags dang phyag rgyas spel byas te snye / rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal yas kyiḥ pho brang pad+ma 'od kyi byang phyogs nasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po da tshur byonaḥ phyi nang gsang mchod mthun rdzas rgya mtshos bskangasaX bdag cag gar 'gro gang 'dod don rnams sgrubaḥ kyi gangs dkar rtse nas 'gyeng pa yi: wer ma dung seng g.yu ral canaḥ thugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangs bdag cag shar phyogs 'gro ba la don de grub nas bder phyin mdzodaḥ kye nagasatshal khrod nas 'gying ba yi wer ma mtshal stag dmar po niḥ 'dod yon mchod pas thugs dam bskangasaḥ bdag cag lto phyogs 'gro ba la don de tshob nas bder phyin mdzodaḥ kye 'jigs rung tshal nas rgyu ba yi wer ma dom bu thugs dkar niX thugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangs bdag cag

nub phyogs 'gro ba laX don de grub nas bder phyin mdzod kya rdza brag khrod nas 'byung ba yi wer ma rtsal ldan gzig mo niX thugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangasaḥbadag cag byang phyogs 'gro ba laX don de grub nas bder phyin mdzod kye byang thang yul nas rgyu ba yiX wer ma byang 'brong ri thur canaḥ thugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangs bdag cag shar lhor 'gro ba laḥ don de grub nas bder byin mdzod kya na dmar dkyil nas rgyu ba yi wer ma rkyang bu kha dkar niX thugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag lho nub 'gro ba la don de grub nas bder phyin mdzodaX kya rong khong yul nasargyu ba yiX wer ma zangs 'phar bang rtsal can thugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag nub byang 'gro ba laX don de grub nas bder phyin mdzod0 kye ri gsum ri yi rtse mo lasaḥ wer ma wa mo mdur stobs canaḥ thugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangs bdag cag byang shar 'gro ba la don de grub nas bder phyin mdzodaX kye rgya mtsho 'byel ba'i klong dkyil nasaḥ gser mig 'dzin pa

rkaḥ rtsal shugs canaḥthugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangasaḥbadag cag chu las brgal ba laḥdon de grub nas bder phyin mdzod kyaḥngam 'brog g.yang sar gnas pa yi:wer ma lcags spyang mthu rtsal canaḥthugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangasaḥbadag cag lam 'phrang g.ya sa nas don rnams grub nas bder phyin mdzodaḥkyi dgongs sngon dbyings nas rgyu ba yiX wer ma g.yu 'brug rdzu 'phrul canaḥthugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskang saX bdag cag steng phyogs 'gro ba la don de grub nas bder phyin mdzodaḥkyi 'og gi phyogs na gnas pa yi wer ma smig bu chen mo niḥthugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangs:bdag cag 'og phyogs 'gro ba laḥdon de grub nas bder phyin mdzodaḥ kyi dbang sngon 'dab ma la 'arten pa'i wer ma re 'byams ngar ma niX thugs mthun mchod pas mnyes pa bskangasaḥbadag cag dmag cag g.yul zhugs naḥ pha rol brlag nas bder phyin mdzodaX kyi 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub kyisaḥthugs bskyed dpal las 'khrungs ba yiḥwer ma 'phrul gyis rdzu

'phrul canaḥ skyes bu'i bsgod pa'i lam lha steḥ 'di phyi gnyis kyi don 'grub mdzodaḥ zhal bzhes thugs dam mi g.yel bar las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzodaḥ de ltar lam lha gnyer bcol 'dis gang brtsam 'dod don thogs med 'grubaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin grags pa' dpal dang 'gyur med rdo rje gnyis kyi bskul ba dang / slob bu dhe was shog gu'i mthun rkyen bcas bskul ngor/ kho bo bdud 'dulabazhib nu ldan 'du pa rtsalagyisachos dbyings rig pa'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni las ldan 'gyur rdor mang gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam̐/

rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥdagra bla chos skyong bskang gsol phrin las lhun grub 'dod 'byung nor bu bzhugs so rkaḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeX mi4)sletshubazhithugs dang mthun pa' mchod rdzas rnams sbyangs bsgyur spal la 'ad skad do baspomi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings rum nasaḥdagra bla'i rgyal po mthu rtsal canaḥchos kyi bsrung ma dam tshig 'dzinaḥrnal 'byor dgra bla mthu bo cheḥrig 'dzin yongs kyi srung ma deḥ'abod do gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaX dam tshig gsang ba'i gdan la bzhugasaḥdangos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dngaXbarten sgrub bskang rdzas yo byad kyisaḥdagra bla ge sar gsol zhing mchodaḥkha 'dzin sdong grogs rgyab rten mdzod ja ma dung sman gsol zhing mchodaḥphywa g.yang dngos grub char ltar bsnyil dpa' 'bum rgya tsha gsol zhing mchodaXskyes bu bdag gi dgra bla mdzod tshangs pa'i bu yag gsol zhing mchod skyes bu bdag gi phrag la mdzodaX bdud gcod shan pa gsol zhing mchodaḥskyes bu bdag gi jag lha mdzodaḥ

'dan ma rin chen gsol zhing mchodaX skyes bu bdag gi dgra lha mdzodaḥ'abru ba chos skyongs gsol zhing mchodaḥ skyes bu bdag gi grogs lha mdzod ༷ khra tsha glog 'khyugs gsol zhing mchod skyes bu bdag gi dbang lha mdzod stag lha khri dkar gsol zhing mchodaX skyes bu bdag gi rgyan lha mdzodaḥ g.yu lha thog rgod gsol zhing mchodaX skyes bu bdag gi shag lha mdzodaḥrnal 'byer khro thung gsol zhing mchodaḥskyes bu bdag gi lha mgon rgu ru khra chung gsol zhing mchodaḥskyes bu bdag gi zas a yag thar pa gsol zhing mchodaḥskyes bu bdag gi shugs lha mdzodaḥ.a nu dpal seng gsol zhing mchodaḥskyes bu bdag gi tshe rdzi mdzodaX ma ṇi ka ra gsol zhing mchodaḥskyes bu bdag gi dpal lha mdzodaX dmu spyang dkar po gsol zhing mchodaḥ skyes bu bdag gi 'phan rtsal bskyedaḥgayu 'od 'bum me gsol zhing mchod skyes bu bdag gi dbang thang spelaḥ a stag klu mo gsol zhing mchodaḥ skyes bu bdag gi lus lha mdzodaḥzhal dkar ldem pa gsol zhing mchod skyes bu kha dge bkra shas mdzod be ru'i rat+na gsol zhing mchodaXskyes bu bdag gi g.yang lha

kaiḥ mdzod dgra la rtse rgyal gsol zhing mchodaḥ skyes bu bdag gi nor lha mdzodaḥ ga dar spyang sngon gsol zhing mchod skyes bu bdag gi phyug lha mdzod mi thung khro rgyal gsol zhing mchodaḥ skyes bu bdag gi dkor srung mdzodaḥ dpa' bo lhun grub gsol zhing mchodaX skyes bu bdag gi brin las sgrubaḥ lha yag nyi 'bum gsol zhing mchodaḥlha zhal dung las dkar gyur cigaḥ khra tsha khri thar gsol zhing mchodaX dgra bla mi dabhe ma bral cigaḥ sto thub rgod po gsol zhing mchodaX tshe dang srog gi kwa ba mdzodaḥ mi zi dmar po gsol zhing mchodaḥ sngon bsu rgyab brten ma g.yel cigaḥ mi chen bla ma gsol zhing mchodaḥ tshe 'di skyid dang ma bral zhigaḥ kun dga' nyi ma gsol zhing mchod skyobs pa chos dang ma bral cigaḥ pad+ma sangs rgyas gsol zhing mchod gling bzhi dab du 'du bar mdzodaX ka ne gom pa gsol zhing mchodaḥ skye dgu chos la sbyor bar mdzodaḥ spyi dpon rgyal po gsol zhi mchodaḥ rig 'dzin zhing du lam/ sna drongasaḥ dgra bla'i dmag tshogs gsol zhing mchodaḥ du ru'i dpung tshogs 'joms par mdzod0 dpa' btul ma lus

kaiḥ nas 'phuraḥ thugs mthun gtor ma bdud rtsis bskangasaX zhing lha ma g.yel kha 'dzin mdzodaḥ kye dgra blaglag nag rog po niḥ skyes bu'i rgyab g.yon 'gyur zhing ldengaḥ sha khrag rus pa gtor mas bskangs jag lha ma g.yel kha 'dzin mdzod kyi dgra bla zangs kyi khyung dmar niḥ skyes pa'i rmog dkar rtse nas 'khoraḥ dgra bgegs don snying mchod pas bskangs: wa mgon ma g.yel kha 'dzin mdzodaX kye rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa dngaḥ gzhan phan phrin las 'gyed pa laḥ dgra bgegs bdud kyi mi tshugs phyiraḥ ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul dngaX dgra bla'i tshogs kyi kha 'dzin mdzodaḥ mi mthun 'jigs tshogs zhi ba dngaḥ tshe bsod longs spyod dpal 'byer spelaḥ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus phyogs bzhi'i dgra bgegs mtha' dmag bzlogaX rnam kun bde skyid ldan pa dngaḥ bsam don chos bzhin 'grub mdzod cigaḥ de ltar dgra bla gnyer bcol 'dis rnam mang phrin las lhun gyis grub phya na bar chad bdud las rgyal bsam/ don chos bzhin 'grub pa ra 'gyur sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'a lung zin grags pa 'i dpa la da 'gyur med rdo rje'i nan

kaiḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po ge sar la dgyes bskyed yon 'bul bum pa bzang po bzhugs soḥrkuḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye sgospo111( dgra bla'i rgyal po ge sar la phrin las bcol phyir yon 'bul ni bsreḥ chos dbyings nam mkha' rnam dag sangaX be+eḍūr+ya yi 'od khyims nangaḥ o rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i glingaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ pad ma rgyal po'i brin las garaḥ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul rtsalaḥ pho nya sprul pa yang g.yog bcasaX sgrub mchog mos ngor da tshur byonaḥ go khrab brten pa'i rdzas la bzhugasaḥ dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul brtse ba'i zhal bzang bstan pa dngaḥ rtags par bsrung skyobs ma g.yel zhigaX bsaḥ dgra bla'i lha dar phyug mo 'diX ge sar dpa' btul tshogs la 'bulaḥ rgyal bstan dbu 'phang mtho ba'i yon gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes dgra bla'i go khrab mtshon gsum 'diḥ ge sar dpa' btul tshogs la 'bul rgyal khams bdud las rgyal ba'i yonaḥ gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes

rkaḥ brtse bas bzhesaḥ phye mar 'dod rgu'i bang mdzod 'diḥ ge sar dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bulaX bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i yonaX gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhesaḥ mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas rnamasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bulaḥ 'di phyi'i bde legs bskyed pa'i yonaX gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhesaḥthugs dang mthun pa'i yo byad rnamasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bulaḥ bdag gi bsam don 'grub pa'i yonaḥ gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhesaḥ shī yis che rgyud dgra bla bstodaḥ ma dang ma bral kha 'dzin mdzodaḥ bswo yis 'bring rgyud dgra bla bstodaX la zhal dkar po mi la stonaḥ cha yis chung rgyud dgra bla bstodaḥ lha g.yang bsod nams mi la 'dzomasaḥ bkra shis dpal kyi rgyal khams gangaḥ yon bdag bsam pa chos bzhin 'grubaḥ sngags pa phun tshogs lnga ldan rgyalaḥ don gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyin 31ga de ltar phrin las grub pa 'a yon phul bas ci bsam yid — zhin 'grub sa ma pā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma thad phreng ga thugs kya yang bcud man — ga gter ga sa dkar ti se'i brag la sbas dus kyi snyigs ma ra gyur pa naḥ o rgyan sprul pa

kaiḥ gtub pa da 0 dpa' rtags mi la ma 31ra cigaḥ shā ma ma tsit+ta rag hūṃ sbyo swā hāX srung cig bkod pa khrab la bkodaḥ sog bar stag mo 'bum thub nu bar dgra bla du khyung bkodaḥ gra bzhir nyi 'bum nor bu bkodaḥ rgyun thag re 'byams nga ra ma bkod srung gur rdo rje'i rdzo nga su gyuraḥ pha rol dgra sde brlag nus shogaX ( ma ma tsit+ta rak+ta hūṃ spre swā hā srung cig bkod pa rmog la bkodaḥ thed rgyan gser gyi rdo rje bkod rna rgyan pha lam nor bu dkod rtse la rat+na yid bzhin bkodaḥ dar la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bkodaḥ mi 'gyur lhun po ltar brjid cingaḥ tshe srog rdo rje'i ra gur chud0 pha rol bdud dpung gzhoms gyur cigaḥ ka ma ma tsit+ta rak+ṣa hūṃ sbyo swā hā srung cig bkod pa sbra khang bkodaḥ phug la bkra shis khyung gcig bkodaḥ thog la gser gyi ru sbal bkodaḥ mda' la 'dod 'byub ba mo bkodaḥ srid pa'i ba sbal khyu gsum gyiX mi phyug g.yang gi dpal mdzod basprangaḥ gang sto bral bar brtan gyur cigaḥ hūṃ ma ma tsit+ta rak+ṣa ṭ+wāṃ/ sbyo swā hwaX srung cig bang mdzod 'di la bkodaḥ mdzod khang yid bzhin nor bu bkod kha rgyan dpag

rkaḥ byad ma sod la byad gtad khrol mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhingaḥ bkra shis bde legs dpal 'phel mdzodaḥ dgra bla'i dmags tshogs ngo so bstod mi dang ma bral kha 'dzin gyis bya ba gang brtsam mthar phyin paḥ gī bswo cha'o lha rgyal ma ཿ de ltar dgra bla'i bska gsol 'dis bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhen 'grub bar chad dgra bdud g.yul las rgyal bsam don 'byung bar gdod mi za sa ma yāḥ ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugasab da 'de ga sa dkar ti se' brag la sbas dus kyi snyags mar gyur ba na nga sprul las can gcig gis rted spyi mthun las kyi ma 'phrog na bde skyid snang ba gsal ches byed bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos sru sa dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhig sa ma wāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu su brda jim snyi zhes pa'ang lu zin chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shas dge ba' skyes du ma dang bcas te nan tan chen po sa bskul ba dang / tshogs smon las 'dzom sa 'gyur rdor nas thabs shes mtshon pa 'i la regs rin chen sna gas shog dra bral dkar yol kyi skyes bcas nan tan chen po bskul ngor/ kho bo sbasapa'i rnal 'byor nu ldan dpal gyi rdo rjesadabying snang mkha' 'gra'i brda mdzod /sabasgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni 'gyur rdor gyas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lo/

rkaḥ dag sna lasaḥ dgra bla'i gsol bsdus niX mchod rdzas yo byad dpung chen bsags la kyiḥ gnam bab lha las 'khrungs ba yiḥ thugs bskyed dam bca' khur lci ba'i:'jam mgon smra ba'i nyi ma yisaX brin las ma rtogs bdud sde'i gshed gser ba'i nyi 'bum lha dar dngaḥ btsan po gdong gi chos 'phan rjeḥ lung gnang grub pa'i a dpa la rgyalaX mi chen dpa' bo lhun grub dngaḥ don 'grub gzu ba lha mgon nagaX a yag shakya rgyal mtshan dpalaḥ spyi dpon khro thung rgyal po dngaḥ 'bru ba chos skyongs rgod po rjeX be ri nyi ma rang 'khrungs sogasaḥ gser ba shog chen bco brgyad kyis rje bo grub chen thams cad laX gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol bstodaḥ dgra bla'i kha 'dzin sdong grogs kyisaḥphywa g.yang char du brnyil ba dngaḥ dgra bdud bgegs kyi gnya' mnon cingaḥ rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags bskyedaḥ lugs gnyis bya ba mthar phyin mdzod bswo mthu rtsal gnyan las 'khrungs ba yiḥ rnam mang phrin las khur lci bas snying rje'i dbang phyug mkhyen brtse'i zer gdul dka' 'dul ba'i dgongs spyod can ༷ 'dren ston kun dga' nyi

ma'i zhal legs nyes mkhyen pa'i rtsis sman rje rtsal thob a nu dpal sang btsan thog rgod khra tsha glog khyugs rgyalaḥdapa' bo g.yu rgyal rdo rje dngaḥ'om bu'i 'brug sgra thog rgyal dngaḥzla zhal khrab btsan dkar po dang ya med seng stag a dom rtse dang:lha rgod gzhon nu la sogs pa'i 'om bu'i shog chen drug drug sde'iḥrtse 'dzin grub chen thams cad kyangaḥdagongs pa'i rtsal bskyod gnas 'dir byonaX snyigs ma'i nad mtshon gzeng lang skabasaḥbastan 'gror lhag bsam dkar ba dngaḥkha 'dzin sdong grogs rgyab brten gyisaḥbadud sde ldog pa'i zil mnon cing dge bcu'i khrims sgo 'jam dar btsunaX lugs gnyis bya ba bkra shis pasaḥrtag tu bde skyid ldan par mdzod dus 'khrugs rgud tshogs zhi gyur cigaX bswo dpal stobs klu las 'khrungs ba yiḥmangon spyod phrin las khur lci bsaḥgasang ba'i bdag po'i mthu stobs rtsalaḥphyogs bzhi'i bdud btul dpa' 'dzang canaX rdzong khag bco brgyad gter bdag poḥpad+ma rgyal po'i brin las dngosaḥge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po dngaḥdapa' 'bum rgya tsha zhal dkar poX tshe yi rig 'dzin

kaiḥ spyi dpon rgyalaX dgra bla'i g.yang gcig nang chung dpalaḥ zhal dro bkra shis seng rlon dang bstan 'gro'i snyi ma ka ne kumaḥ rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra dngaḥ lha rgod 'bum me dpa' rngam ldan blon chen 'dan ma rtsal ldan poX bka' blo bdud gcod dme ru rtseḥ dam gtsang g.yu lha thog 'gyur rgyal: grub brnyes dung skyongs stag wa dngaḥ a stag dpa' ba'i lha mo dngaḥ dpa' lha mi spyang dkar po rgyalaḥ 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me rje khrom pa spya thul dkar po canaḥ nang blon zhal dkar ldem pa dngaX bdud 'dul ga dar drag pa canaḥ dmu spyang drag rtsal rju 'phrul canaḥ bzhi bzhi dpung gi rje bo ni ༷ grub pa brtes pa'i dpa' bo kunaX dgongs pa'i dbyings la phyogs ris bralaḥ rnal rol rtsal snang nub med pa0 mtha' bzhi'i dmag gi gnya' gnon phyiraX mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaX ye shes mtshon chas char phob laḥ log rtog bdud sde thar bar rlogaX bstan 'gror sman pa'i lhag bsam can srung skyobs smon pa' re 'bras rtsolaX dgra bla ma bral kha 'dzin gyisaḥ tu rū'i gze pa mtha' dag sol 'bras bu gsang sngags

bstan pa spelaḥ bshad sgrub 'khor lo gnyis ldan gyisaX gangs ljongs bod khams 'tsho byed cing don gnyis bya ba mthar phyin nas rnga yab dpa' rir sun ma gyisaX ngan song // rdoX ༷ sdi / /rdo dīX/hūṃ~X ༷dren chos skur rgyas thob la 'di phyi'i phan bde 'byung bar mdzod ༷ sa ma yu grangs bsogs snyang nye phrin las myur mngon spyod lhun grub the so bral rgya rgya rgya snying

keḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i lam lha gnyer bcol yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs soḥkaiḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ rtomigisha /〉〉11 mchod rdzas sna tshogs bshams pa la sngags dang phyag rgyas spel byas te0 bswo tshos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa'i klongaḥ 'od gsal phyogs ris bral ba'i zhing lnga ldan zangs mdog dpal ri nasaḥ pad+ma rgyal po gnas 'dir byonaḥ bdud rtsi dza gad mchod pa dngaḥ thugs mthun bgos bus dgyes pa bskangasaX phyogs mtshams gar 'gro'i lam lha mdzodaḥ sgron ma bkyag go phywa g.ya stsolaḥ bsam don chos bzhin grub pa sogs ༷ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaX bsaḥrin chen g.yu yi sku mkhar nang chos kyi rgyal po'i srid 'dzin paX dpal mgon dgra bla'i grwal dbus nas ge sar rgyal po gnas 'dir byonaḥ rin chen dza gad gser skyems dngaX dbang lnga'i dga' ston mchod pa 'bulaX phyogs mtshams gang du 'gro ba yiḥ don de 'grub nas bder phyin cingaḥ dgra jag g.yul las rgyal ba dngaX bkra shis ngo so mtho

ba yi phrin las rabs 'byams sgrub mdzod cig bswo dgra bla mi dkar rta dkar canaḥ bco lnga'i zla ba'i zhal mdzes paX dpa' 'bum rgya tsha gnas 'dir byonaX dza gad gtor mas dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag shar phyogs 'gro ba laḥ don de 'grub nas bder phyin mdzodaX bas dgra bla miser rta ser canaḥ gser mdog nyi ma shar 'dra baḥ tshangs pa'i bu yag gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag lho phyogs 'gro ba laḥ don de 'grub nas bder phyin mdzodaḥbazwaḥ dgra bla mi dmar rta dmar canaX dmar nag dug khrag khol 'dra'i skuḥ bdud gcod shan pa gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor mas dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag nub phyogs 'gro ba la don de 'grub nas bde phyin mdzodaḥ bswo dgra bla misngon rta sngon can smug po mchong gi zhal mnga' ba ༷ 'bru ba chos skyongs gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i dgyes pa bskangs bdag cag nub phyogs 'gro ba laḥ don de 'grub nas bder phyin mdzodaḥ ba༄༄ dgra bla mi ljang rta ljang canaḥ ljang nag rgya mtsho mer 'dra'i sku ༷ 'dan ma rin chen gnas 'dir

rku byonaX dza gad gtor ma'i dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag shar lhor 'gro ba laḥ don de 'grub nas bder phyin mdzodaḥ bskuḥ dgra bla mi dmar rta smug canaḥthog ser glog dmar 'khyugs 'dra'i skuḥ 'om bu'i khra tsha gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag lho nub 'gro ba laḥ don de 'grub nas bder phyin mdzod bswoX dgra bla mi dkar rta dkar can dung la nyi 'od phog 'dra'i zhalaX stag lha khri dkar gnas 'dir byon dza gad gtor ma'i dgyes pa bskangasaX bdag cag nub byang 'gro ba laX don de 'grub nas bder phyin 'dzod badzaḥ dgra bla mi sgrug rta smug canaḥ mchong zhal g.yu yi smin ma 'baraX g.yu lha thog rgod gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag byang shar 'gro ba laḥ don de 'grub nas bder phyin mdzodaḥbaswaḥ 'phrul gyi rta mchog bra nag steng sngags kyi dbang phyug he ru gaḥspyi dpon khro thung gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor mas dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag dam chos rtsol ba laḥ don de grub nas mthar phyin mdzod baX rta mchog spug gu sgab

nag stengaḥ g.yu mi dung gi lan skra canaX rgu ru khra chung gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangasaX bdag cag phyu g.yang sgrub pa la don de 'grub nas 'gong 'dre thul bas dgra bla mi ser rta ser can ser po 'bum gyi kha lo baX a yag thar ba gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangasaX bdag cag gzhan phan bsgrub pa la don de grub nas bde legs stsolaX bas dgra bla mi khra rta khrananan can khra bo 'bum gyi kha lo ba a nu dpal seng gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangasaX bdag cag gzhan don rtsom pa la don de grub phyir le lo gzhom badzaḥ dgra bla dung mi mtshal rta canaX dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi rje ma ṇi ka ra gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangs tshul khrims rnam dag bsrung ba laḥdon de mtha' ru phyin par mdzodaḥbazwa dgra bla midakar rta sngon canaḥ dpa' mdzang stag mo 'bum gyi rjeX mi spyang dkar po gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bzod pa'i phar phyin bsgom pa la don de gegs med grub par mdzodaḥbs

rkaḥ dgra bla mi spug rta ser canaḥ dpa' bo 'bum gyi kha lo baḥ g.yu 'od 'bum me gnas 'dir byon dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangs bdag cag bsam gtan bsgom pa laḥ g.yeng ba'i phyogs lhung zhi bar mdzodaḥ bsaḥ dgra bla mchong mi mtshal rta canaḥ o rgyan mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi rjeḥ a stag dpa' mo gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangs bdag cag lag mthong bsgom pa laḥ byang rmug 'thor 'byams bsal bar mdzodaḥ bas dgra bla mi dkar rta nag canaḥ zo dor 'bum gyi kha lo ba zhal dkar ldem pa gnas 'din byon ja gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangasaḥ zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub pa la rten 'brel nyes tshogs stong par mdzodaḥ bsaḥ dgra bla mi ser rta smug can dregs ldan 'bum gyi kha lo baḥ sras mchog rat+na gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangs rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub pa laḥ dpa la 'byor mnga' thang 'byor bar mdzod bswo dgra bla mi dmar rta dkar canaḥ rnal 'byor 'bum gyi spyi rje boḥ rnal 'byor dar li gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i mchod

pas bskangasaḥ dbang gi phrin las sgrub pa laḥ lha 'dre mi gsum 'du bar mdzodaX baX ཿ dgra bla mi skrug g.yu rta canaḥ srin po sha zan 'bum gyi rje lha rgod 'bum me gnas 'dir byonaḥ dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangasaḥdrag po'i phrin las sgrub pa laX dgra bdud dam sri med par mdzodaḥbs dgra bla mi dkar rta dkar can nor lha khri ma 'bum gyi rjeḥ dgra lha rtse rgyal gnas 'dir byonaX dza gad gtor ma'i dgyes pa bskangasaḥ bdag cag gang brtsam 'grub pa dngaḥ snying gi chos 'dod chos dang sprod:bsaḥdagra bla mi sngon rta sngon canaḥzhing skyongs dur bdag 'bum gyi rjeḥg dar spyang sngon gnas 'dir byonaḥdza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangasaḥbadag cag gang brtsam 'grub pa dngaXlag pa'i nor 'dod nor da sprodaXbs dgra bla mi ser rta sngon canaX dmar ser 'bum gyi rtse 'dzin paḥmi chen lhun grub gnas 'dir byon dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangs ༷ bdag cag gang brtsam 'grub pa dngaX rgyab kyi gos 'dod gos dang sprodaḥbs dgra bla mi dmar dug rta canaḥ rigs sngags grub pa 'bum gyi rjeḥkhro thung rgyal po

rkaḥ gnas 'dir byonaX dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangasaḥ bdag cag gang brtsam 'grub pa dngaX rin chen brgyan 'dod brgyan dang sprodaḥbazwaḥ ser po gser sde'i shog chen dang spug po 'om bu'i dpal sde dang dmar po dmu spya mngon spyod steḥ kun kyang gnas mchog 'di ru byon dza gad gtor ma'i mchod pas bskangasaḥphyogs mtshams gar 'gro'i 'dod don sgrubaX dgra jag chom rkun med par mdzodaḥtshong la 'gro ba'i tshong dpon gyisaX ja dngul dar zab phud kyis mchodaḥtshong gi rgyal kha khyod kyis longasaḥnor gyi spus kha bdag la sprod jag la 'gro ba'i jag dpon gyisaḥ rgya ja'i dwangs ma phud kyis mchod mi nor chod la rang nor gyisaḥdapa' kha gzhan la ma shor cigaḥdamag la 'gro na dmag dpon mdzodaXbadud rtsi rgyugs chang bsang mchod 'bulaḥdagra bo'i mi rta grum chings kyis rang gi mi rta'i kha 'dzin mdzodaḥphyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang dge mtshan bkra shis dpal 'bar phyiraḥ gī bswo cha'o lha rgyal loḥ bsam don chos bzhin grub mdzod cigaX de ltar lam lha gsol mchod 'dis phyogs bcu gar 'gra'i don

'grub cing nyer 'che'i rkyen snang kun las rgyal bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥyem rgyal dbang pad+malithugasakyib daḥ gangs dkar ti se'i brag la sbas dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na nga sprul las can gcig gis rted spyi mthun las kya ma bsgyur na rgud pa che shos skyobs par 'gyur 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing la 'god bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos srungs 'dod sred can la ma shor zhigaḥ sa ma shāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shas dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskul ba dang / las smon 'phro mdzomasa'agyur rdor nasathabs shes mtshon pa'i lha reg rin chen snag shog dri bral dkar yol gya skyes bcas bskung ngor/ kho posbasapa'i rnam 'gror nusaldan dpal gya rdo rjesadabying snang mkha' 'a'akhonabarda mdzad la brgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni 'gyur rdor gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lo/

'o/ bas bswo ge sar dgra bla' rgyal po mchod smon grub ka ne+e kum pa mchodaḥ lha sras dgra 'dul rtse rgyal mchodaḥ 'om bu'i khra tsha glog 'byugs mchodaḥ sras po lha— —1 'bum me mchod: 'bru ba chos skyongs rgod po mchod 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me mchod rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra mchodaḥ bdud gcod shan pa me ru mchodaḥ a stag rdo rje phag mo mchodaX dung skyongs stag lha khri dkar mchodaḥ g.yu lha rdo rje thog 'gyur mchodaX dpa' lha mu byang dkar po mchodaḥ dgra 'dul zhal dkar ldems pa mchodaḥ tshangs pa'i lha bu dkar po mchodaḥ gnyan chen ser po ger mdzod mchodaX klu phrug 'od ldan rin chen mchodaḥ sring lcam tha le 'od dkar mchodaḥ gnam gong sman gyi rgyal mo mchodaḥrnal 'byor dbang phyug khro thung mchodaḥ dpa' btul grub chen brgyad cu mchodaḥ yang sprul sa ya dung phyur mchodaḥ dung sman sgrol ma nyer gcig mchodaḥ dpa' rtags dgra bla bcu gsum mchodaX sngon gyi tha tshig dgongs bzhin duḥ snyigs ma lnga yi dus 'di ru dmu drag lha yi'i kha rlangs dugaḥ bse shang bla mtsho' dbal ngad pa ཿ mu stegs ku lang gcer

bu'i 'phrulaX than gzugs khyi dang spyang gu'i dmagasaX stag ltar ngar zhing glang ltar 'dzegs 'brug ltar grags shing sbrul bzhin 'khyugasaX sprel ltar 'dzegs pa'i 'khri shing chodaḥ lha dmag bu yug 'tshub ltar sgronaḥ sngon po'i bsrung bas rwa gur gtoraḥ gnyan sde thog ser khol ltar rgyugaḥ dgra la mtshon cha'i 'phrul 'khor thobaX klu dmag dug chu khol ltar phyuraX rgya la khung thum nad sna phobaX bya 'phur rjes med ci bzhin du: dus la bab pa'i dam dgongs laḥ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzodaḥ sngags pa rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags stonaḥ mgo nag 'dug chas 'grub pa dang rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas par mdzodaḥ sngags pasur+ya' thol byung du pha ba pa'oḥ
