rkaḥ bka' rgya gnas kyi lde mig las bskang rdzas byin rlabasabadud rtsi'i rgya mcho bzhugs sa na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeX spyo/zi/// tshogs rdzas yo byad ci 'byor bsags dga' ston tshogs su 'bul ba na ma ātshwaḥ stong chen chos dbyings bhan+ta dza sgod bcud dpal 'byor tshogs su sharaḥ gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gros brgyanaḥ skyes bu don grub bskang phyir spro ma āts+tshaḥ brdal khyab pag pa'i gzhong pa dza sha khrag rus gsum tshogs su sharaḥ bde stong rtsa thig rlung gsum brgyanaḥ 'phrul gyi lde mig bskang phyir spelaḥ 37 ā& stong gsal kun gzhi'i bhan+ta rtsa tshogs yul ga ṇa tsakrar sharaḥ gang shar rang grol la mos brgyan: nor bu dgra 'dul bskang phyir spro 67 ātshuḥ phy-i nang gsang ba de nyid tshogasaḥ gnyis su med par 'bul lags naX gdul bya'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhesaḥ nyams bskangs sa lam rtogs pa spelaḥ rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dngaḥmachog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsolaX nam mkha' mdzod sngags da rten snying brngo da la spel bar bya'o 'di yang sgrub pa'i cha lag tuḥ yid kyi 'bra sha rte tris ro ra rgyal mchog bzhad pa'i rdo rjes gris don gnyis
'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig sabo maṅga le/

rkuḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub rtsal kyi dgyes bskang pad+ma'i phreng ba bzhugs soḥrkuḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye (dirnya 413/ thugs da mthun pa 'i mchod rja sa da brten sgrub mnyes bska rja sa bsags nas sngags dang phyag rgyas sbya sa bsgyur spel lhar gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yi hūṃ trīḥ gleng gi mchog gyur mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i glingaḥ gnas kyi mchog gyur dhu ma tha la nasaḥ gling gi ya gyal dpal ri pad 'od kyiḥ byang phyogs mngon spyod lhun grub gzhal yas nasaḥ sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zhal tshab phrin las gteraḥ ge sar dgra bla'i dbang phyug seng chen rgyalaX dpa' btul grub chen dung sman mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaX phyag brnyan sprul pa yang sprul dpung dang bcas dung dung gdungs ba'i glu yis 'bod bskul naḥ thugs dam dgyes bskangs 'du ba tshogs la byonaḥ mkha' dbyings 'ja' khyims me tog sbang char 'khrigasaḥ sna tshogs pad zla rig chen khri khar bzhugasaḥ brtse ba'i zhal bzang skal ldan mos mtshor ngomasaḥ phyu g.ya 'dod dgu'i dngos grub

stsol bzhin tuḥ rgyal bstan rin chen sgrol me sbar du gsolaḥ o ma hā gu ru kā ma thā la rā tsa sarba sa ma yā dza dzaḥ / hrīḥ bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma rā ga'i zhalaḥ mtshan dang dpe byad rgya mtsho'i lang tshos 'byudaḥ nyon mongs g.yul ngo mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog paX ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'dren mdzad pa'iḥ rgyal tshabs gnyis pa pad+ma saṃ bha las phrin las byed po gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pa'iX ya seng 'phrul gyi lde mig thugs dam bskangs shes rab ral gris srid rtsa dum bur gcodaḥ thabs shes mda' gzhus bden gnyis chos ston nas: sbyor sgol mdzad pa phrin las mtha' yas pa'iḥ ma seng nor bu dgra 'dul thugs dam bskangasaḥsangs rgyas bstan pa dkar 'byams dar zhing rgyas sems can yongs la phan bde'i chos char phabaḥ mgo nag mi yi 'dug thabs so chas 'grubaḥ 'dzam gling skyesabu don grub thugs dam bskangasaḥ nya gang zla zhal skal ldan bu la ngomasaḥ dga' bde'i glog zhags dpa' bo mkha' 'gror 'khyudaḥ khra tsha dug zer bdud bzhi'i steng du kholaḥ dpal ldan

rkaḥ nor bu dgra 'dul thugs dam bskangasaḥ lha chen tshangs pa'i thugs kyi thig le cheḥ a bo ger mdzod mdun nas 'dud cing brtse gtsug na rin chen zhabs pad spyi bor lenaḥ lha klu gnyan gyi rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ lha dmag bu yugs 'tshub pa'i mdung dar bsgrengasaḥ srid gsum dam la 'dogs pa'i 'phrul zhags bskoraḥlugs gnyis bsam don 'grub pa'i sba lcag phyaraḥ ge sar 'khor los bsgyur rgyal thugs dam bskangs rmongs pa'i mun sel rmog dkar dbu la mdzes nyon mongs gdungs zhi dpa' khrab sku la brjid srid zhi mnyam sbyor dbang gi ber chen klubasaX 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur ge sar thugs dam bskangasaḥ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dngaḥ nyon mongs g.yul ngo 'joms pa'i ru mtshon brgyadaḥ skye rgu'i rgud pa sel ba'i gdugs chen phubaḥ dgra bla'i dpa' chas bkod rdzogs dga' bzhi'i dpal 'bar gser rga nyi mas 'khyud rten 'brel phun tshogs bal stan sme ba'i glingaḥ bya ba mthar phyin gser srab g.yu mthur mdzesaḥ dpa' bo glog zhags 'khyugs 'dra'i cang shes rkyang rgod

rlung gi ga gag pa canaḥ lha klu gnyan gyi 'dod don grub pa'i rtaḥ thugs bskyed dag pa bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i grogasaX dbang chen h+ya skṛ wa'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs 'phags ma nyi shu gcig brin las rnam bzhis gdul dka' 'dul ba'i gnyenaX bde stong dga' bzhi'i zlos gar mchod sprin stobasaḥ dgyes bskyed dung sman bco brgyad thugs dam bskangs dpa' 'bum rgya tsha bco lnga'i dung zla'i zhalaḥ 'bri ba chos skyongs dpa' rtsal 'dran zla bral0 bdud gcod shan pa khams gsum srog gi bdagaX 'dan ma rin chen bsam 'grub thugs dam bskangasaḥ tshangs pa'i bu yag 'brug sgra gser gya zhalaX 'om bu'i khra tsha glog 'khyugs thog las ngaraḥ dung skyongs stag lha khri dkar grub pa'i rje 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyur bde stong rnal 'byor spyi dpon khro thung rgyalaḥ 'gong po spun dgu'i gnya' mnon rgu ru dngaḥ a yag sras po thar ba rgyal mtshan zhabasaX a nu dpal ldan seng ge'i byang chub thugs bskyed ma ṇi ka ra dngaḥ dpa' rgod dam pa mi spyang dkar po rgyalaḥ 'dan sras rin chen g.yu 'od 'bum me dngaḥ a stag

keX rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskangasaḥnang blon bkra shis zhal dkar ldem pa dang be ru'i sras mchog rat+na dbang gi rgyalaḥ sbas pa'i rnal 'byer 'om bu'i dar lu da ཿsras po la rgod 'bum me'i gter bdag sras po dgra lha rtse rgyal dngaḥmi chen 'phan phyug dpa' bo lhun grub rgyalaḥ g.yang mdzod ga dar rdo rje byang sngon dngaḥ mi thung dpa' brjid khro rgyal dpa' btul skyes bu dam pa mi bdun dngaḥyang 'dul mtshal rtags dgra bla bcu gsum rgyalaḥphul du phyin pa'i skyes bu sum bcu dang grub brnyes rig 'dzin brgyad cu'i ser po gser la nyi 'od phog 'dra'i dmagaḥ dkar po dung la zla bas 'khyud 'dra'i sde dmar po mtshal la slog zhags 'khyugs 'dra'i dmagaḥ sngon po baḍūr dmag sde'i ljang ku g.yu 'od rlang pa phyur 'dra'i sde spug po mchong la zil ba chag 'dra'i dmagaḥ khra bo gzi la nyi zla'i 'od 'khyugs khyu nag po dung chu khol 'dra'i mgar ba sdig can gsod gcod shan pa'i dmagaḥche rgyud gser re ga khri skor brgyad cu dngaḥ 'om bu'i sde 'khor nyi shu rtsa lnga dngaḥ chung rgyud dmu spyang dpa' ba'i las dmag

bskangasaX nyu hrīḥ thugs dam gnyan po bskangs ba'i dam rdzas niḥ la rdzas nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lngaḥ sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol byang chub semasaX bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid rin chen bdunaḥ ga ṇa tsakra me sa gal phye dngaḥ zla rgyas zla phrum ma dwa na dang niḥ kha mngar skyur dang ska ba sla ba'i rigasaḥrdo rje'i zil ba pad+ma rak+ta dang rnga chen dung sogs rol mo'i rigs sna tshogs go khrab mtshon cha dgra zor tho ba mdung rten dar rnga thig ru mtshon gsang ba'i rdzasaḥ mda' dar g.yab dar bye mar rin chen skyemasaḥ'adab chag sder chag rmig chag kha breg rigasaḥ dar zab 'bru sman tswa cha g.yang rten dang nor bu mu min mchong g.yu spos shel rigasaḥ bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib bye brag gisaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i dmag tshogs thugs dam bska saḥ dpa' btul dam pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtshos thugs dam bskangasaḥbaka' 'khor sprul pa yang g.yog lha ngo dgung bas mtho phyir thugs dam bskangasaḥ lha zhal du las dkar phyir wa srungs mi la 'khor phyir lha mi dpal gsum 'dzoms

rkaḥ phyir thugs dam bskangs gyur phrin las rnam bzhi stsolaX hoḥ de ltar bskangs bskangs gsol gache la mchod bstod 'brasaḥ mi mthun rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs rnams bzlogaḥ nyes pa kun gyis nam yang mi tshugs shingaḥ nyes tshogs ye shes ka dag phyogs su bsgyuraX dgra bdud dam sri ming gi lhag mar gyuraḥ mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog tu ru'i dpung rnams phamaḥ 'jigs pa kun zhi bde legs dpal 'byor rgyasaḥ mos bzhi dbang 'dus dgra bgegs tshar bcad nasaX bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid dpachos 'bar regag de ltar bskang bas tshogs chen rdzogs las nyon sems kyi rtogs sgrib sbyangs tshe dang la nyams rtogs yon tan 'phe la don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za sa ma yā a maḥ rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas ma 'ongs snyigs ma' gdul bya la shan tu brtse ba' rjes gzigs nas phrin las maro na spyod drag sgrub 'di skal ba can gyi dpa pa du bzhag ga sa can ti se'i bya ro 'i sbas sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa nusaldan rdo dze+edang 'phrad nas gdul bya'i lag ma skyongs bar byed 'brel tshad rnga yab dpa la rir 'god bka' 'di sngags kyi bdag mos sru sa dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhag sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim ñtsā zhes pa 'di' a khyung go

ma'i mi rjesabastan 'dzin rgya mtshosabakra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang / rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa'i 'gyur med rgya mtshos thabasashes mchen pa'i jos bcas bskul ba dang / snying nor lung zin shrī tri dang 'gyur rdor ratā pa ra rnams kya bskul ngor/ kho bo nusaldan dpal gyi rdo rjesadabyingabasnang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin zhi yis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lo/

rkaX bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig las gnas yul mkha' 'gro'i bskangs ba ni bh+yoḥ 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhing: dpal gyi ri dang sham bha la mkha' 'gro'i gling dang pad+ma'i thangaḥ rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang u tsa la gnam lcags za 'gram ko ga'i thangaḥ ne'u sang sman ljongs la sogs nasaḥ mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro maḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogasaX mkha' la 'gro zhing las rjes gcodaḥ rnal 'byer zhabs pad spyi bor lenaḥ bde stong dpal la 'dzum gyis g.yoX ba spu g.yo zhing dkyus ring 'dresaḥ pad zhal ut+pal dri bsung 'thul 'o chu 'dzin dang bde ba 'baraḥ dpa' bo'i sku la btud bzhin tu: 'dzum reg brda sgo sprod sbyor nasaḥ byang chub sems kyi thig le cheX rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs la sproX ardzi li dang rā ga hosaḥ 'khor 'das gnyis med mnyam par brdalaḥ lhan skyes bde mchog rdo rje mjalaḥ tshim pa drug ldan zlos gar bsgyuraXkhams lnga dngas mar smin pa'i 'brasaḥ he ru ka dpal dngos grub stsolaḥ de ltar phul bas don gnyis 'grub rtsal rdzogs mkha' spyod zhing la sbyod sa ma rwa ཿ rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang snyi

jor byams chos da 'gyur rdor rat+na sa ra rnams kyas bskur ro ra/ kho bo nusaldan 'dusapa rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod pas bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin shrī tris bgyis pa dge legs 'phe la/ sarba maṅga la/rkuḥ tshogs la rol ba ni kye hoḥ ston pa rdo rje rgyal po dgongs myong grol sngags kyi dga' ston tshogasaḥ rgyal bas bzhes lhag dngos grub 'di thugs brtses dgongs bzhin dgyes par bzhesaḥ zhes sgob bu'i gus 'dud kyi phyag rgya da bcas te phul bla mas a la la ho bde ba che gzung 'dzin mtshan ma bral ba yiḥ de bzhin nyid rol bdag phyag 'tshalaX theg chen thabs tshul mkhas par spyodaḥ a ho ma hā su kha sirnyi pha la a la la hoḥ gtsa spe gnyis 'dzan rtogs pa da ༷ bral bas theg chen rja sa la spyod na so skye sgo theg pa da rig 'dzan sar spyod khyad chos yin sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'ang snyi nor byams chos da 'gyur rdor rat+na sa ra rnams kyis bskul ngor/ kho bo nu ldan pasamakha 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur baḍi yi ge pa ni lung zin shī cas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma ṅga le/ཿ

rkuḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i bzhengs zhu thugs rje'i nyi ma bzhugasaḥrkuḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ ra((/dzakhrim( dpa la 3 na dgra bla'i dam ga tshogs la bzhe sa zhu gsol — 'di lta steḥ / dzaḥ bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byu gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥdagongs shig seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul rtsalaḥ ra ma dung sman dpa' btul dgra bla'i tshogs/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas bzhengs su gsol ri rgyal lhun po lta bu'i sku mchog g.yangaḥ bkra shis rtags kyi me tog bcas te bzhen saḥ 'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba'i gsu gdang sa bcasaḥ gdul bya chos la 'god phyir bzhengs su gsolaḥthugs mchog mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u nasaḥ mkhyen brtse'i 'od sto 'bar bzhin bzhengs su gsol 'dod 'byung gter je bum pa bzang po lasaX gdul bya'i re skong yon tan gter mdzod phyesaḥ gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phrin las rlabs po che'iḥ phyogs bzhi'i du ru'i dpung ma kha lo bsgyuraX dpal ldan mgon po nag ro / bzhengs su gsolaḥ

bing las lha dmag 'tshubs bzhin bstan pa srungs dgra bla gser sde'i dpa' btul kai yis bskulaX ser po hor gyi smon log ming med mdzodaḥ dgra bla 'om bu'i dpal sde bas yis bskulaḥ nag po bdud kyi dam sri ar la gtod ja ma dung sman tshogs rnams glu yis bskul rin chen nor sna bdun gyis phywa g.yang bsdus lha yi dgra bla skar tshogs bkra ltar byonaḥ gnam the'u dkar po'i cho 'phrul dbyings su bsgyuraḥ gnyan gyi dmag tshogs 'ja' 'khyugs bkrag 'bar bskulaḥ bar the'u khra bo rgya 'dre'i 'tshubs ma bzlog klu yi dmag tshogs rgya mtsho me ltar phyur sa the'u nag po dam sri sbun dgu thul smon lam grub pa'i skyes chen thams cad bskulaḥ rgyal bstan rin chen nyi zla ltar gsal mdzodaḥ dpa' btul dgra bla grub chen thams cad bskulaḥ o rgyan mkha' spyod gnas su skyel bsu mdzod zab chos bstan pa yun du rgyas pa dang bshad sgrub 'khor lo'i yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'tshoX lugs zungs dpal 'byor rgya mtshos spud bzhin tuḥ don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod de ltar bzhengasazhu phul ba yas thugs dam

rkuḥ bzang po las la bskul rnal 'byor bzhed don 'grub pa sogs yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab ngo ye maḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma sa bha was thugs kya ya bcud zab pa'i gter ga sa dkar ti se'i brag la sbasaḥdus kya snyigs mar gyur pa na ri sprul las can gcig gis rted las na log pas ma bsgyur na snyigs ma' rgud pa cha shes skyobs 'dod sred can la ma/ shor cigaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi zhes pa 'ang lu zin 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskul ba dang / a khyu bstan 'dzan rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba da las na 'gyur med rdo rjes thabs shes mtshon pa'i lha reg sogs kyi skyes bcas bskul ngor/ kho bo sbasapa'i rnal 'byor nusaldan dpal gyi rdo rjes dbyingasasnang mkha' 'gra'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa na las ldan 'gyur rdor rgyas bgyis — dge legs phel/ sarba maṅga le/

keḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ dgra bla ge sar rgyal po'i bzhengs rabs gdul dka' bdud 'dul bzhugs soḥrkuḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye nā1141 sgron ma sna tshogs bkyags rgya sa te snyan 'i glu yis 'di skad do ba༄༄ mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings rum nasaḥ 'ja' khyims 'od kyi gur khang klongaḥ bdud rtsa sbrang char 'bebs pa nasaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro las la bzhengs dam tshig de bzhin dus la babs pad+ma 'bum sprin 'khyil ba'i klong bde chen pad+ma bkod pa nas snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje'i zeraḥ 'gro 'dul pad+ma 'byu gnas shar de bzhin dam tshig dus la babs rnga yab mkha' 'gro 'du glang nasaX rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes skuḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas phrin las garaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po bzhengasaḥ dam tshig de ltar dus la babasaḥ mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung gzhom pa'i phyiraḥ rgya gar grub chen thams cad kunaḥ dpa' btul dgra bla'i phyag rgyar bzhengs de ltar dam tshig dus la babasaḥ mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling dang: g.yu lo can gyi pho brang

nas ja ma dung sman thams cad bzhengasaḥ dam tshig de ltar dus la babasaX dug gsum las skyes bdud sde rnams sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i dgongs spyod can lha klu gnyan gyi dmag dpung sharaḥ dam tshig de ltar dus la sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang sems can yongs kyi phan bde spelaḥ bshad sgrub 'dus sde rgyas pa dang dgra bdud dam sri brlag la sogs phrin las rabs 'byams gang bcol don: thog med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod phywa g.yang mtsho ltar 'khyil ba dngaḥ dngos grub char ltar 'bebs pa dang bsrung skyobs bu bzhin 'tsho rdzi mdzod zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel b.raḥ las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod thugs dam dus babs sa ma yā0 ki bas cha'o lha rgyal 21: de ltar bzhengs rabs phul ba yis sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dran nas rnal 'byor bzhed don 'grub pa dang sbyin bdag re ba skongs bar byedaḥ sa ma yuḥ ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma se bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis thugs kyi yang bcud man ngag skor gangs dkar ta se'i brag la sbas dusakyi snyigs mar gyur pa na nga sprul nga da mi gzhan pa'i rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rjes rnyed smon log dam sri' ma bkags na dus kyi rgud

ma/ pa cha shes skyobs bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos sru sa 'dod sred can la ma shor cagaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thimaḥ3/ཿ zhes pa'ang lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskul ba dang a khyung bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos rab mdzes dar gya yol ba bzang po' skyes dang / las ldan 'gyur rdor nas thabs shes mtshon pa 'i lha regs sogs kyi skyes bcas bskul ro ra/ kho bo sbas pa 'i rnal 'byer nus ldan dpa la gyi rdo rjes dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni las ldan 'gyur rdor gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

rkuḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i dbo ngas gache la bkyags mchod bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs soX kaiḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye che5)/ru /() bas chen spro zhing rol mo sgrogs snyan pa glu yis 'di skad do bas bswo bsuḥ mi mngon chos dbyings dbus mtha' med pa nasaḥ dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma kun 'dus dpalaḥ o rgyan chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ bdud rtsi bsang da kun bzang mchod pas mchodaḥ thugs rjes skyongs shing nyams rtogs 'bar bar mdzod: bswo rnga yab zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nasaḥ o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging gi rjeX dgra bla'i rgyal po seng chen nor bu rtsalaX gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol dbu 'phang bstodaḥ phyu g.yang dngos grub char ltar bsnyel ba da ཿ dgra bdud cham la phab pa'i brin las mdzodaḥbs rang bzhen rnam par dag pa'i gnas mchog nasaḥ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las gcig bsdus paX dpa' brtul grub chen brgyad cu sras 'khor bcas gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol dbu 'pha bstodaḥ tshe

rabs kun tu thugs rjes ma dor skyongasaX mi mthun 'jig pa kun las dbug dbyung mdzodaḥbasre ma rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling dbus nasaXbade stong dga' bzhi'i 'od stong gzi 'bar ba'i ja ma dung sman rdzong chen lde mig rnamasaḥgasol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥphywa g.yang 'dod rgu'i char ltar brnyil ba dngaXzhu bde'i dwangs ma'i sgyu lus smin par mdzodaXbs steng 'og phyogs mtshams yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas lha klu gnyan dmag dgra bla'i dmag tshogs rnams sprul ba yang g.yog mu mtha' yas pa rnamasaḥgasol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaḥmatha' bzhi'i dmag thul tu ru'i dpung pham nasaX lugs zungs dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod kha g.yang bkra shis tshig tu brjod pa bzhinaḥ'adod don lag tu 'byor ba'i phrin las mdzodaXzhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel dam tshig can:rnal 'byer bcol ba'i phrin las grub mdzod cigaḥbasto bas bswo rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud paX rig 'dzin brda yis brgyud paḥgang zag snya khung brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi brin las gcig tu

kaiḥ bsdus pa'i rang gzugasaḥ sa rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dang zhal mi gnyis pa seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra bla sgrub gnas kun gyi bsrung maḥ rig 'dzin kun gyi grogs po mdo sngags gnyis kyi bstan skyongs phywa g.yang gter gyi ba mdzodaḥ phyogs bzhi'i bdud kyi gnya' gnon tu ru 'joms pa'i tho lum rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag poX ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal poḥ dpa' 'bum rgya tsha zhal dkaraḥ gser ba'i nyi 'bum lha yagaḥ 'om bu'i khra tsha glog 'khyugasaḥ rgyal sras ma ṇi ka raḥ dpa' bo lha rgod 'bum meX grub thob ka ne+e kum paḥ spyi dpon tshe yi rig 'dzin: sngags mkhan khro thung rgyal poX lha rje kun dga' nyi ma: kun mtho bdud rtsi'i rgyal po lha yag nyi 'bum nor bu khra tsha khri dar 'bum paḥ lha chen stong thub rgod poX btsan po mu zi dmar po nyag tsha dpa' bstan rgyal poḥ rung tsha 'phan po dmar yag nang chung nor bu'i bang mdzodaḥ lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyalaḥ sbas pa'i rnal 'byer dar li 'om bu'i a nu dpal sengaḥ 'om bu'i mtshal stag dpa' rgodaḥ stag mgo'i pad+ma sangs rgyasaḥ dga' rje

klu phyugs dpa' bo: mi chen rga yi bla maX a yag thar ba rgyal mtshanaḥ 'bri ba chos skyongs rgod po be ru'i nyi ma rgyal mtshan: sras po rat+na dbang rgyal rgu ru khra chung nor bu:'bru sras thog rgod 'bar baḥ byabhe rlon grub pa'i dbang phyugaḥ sngags mkhan khro thung rgyal poḥ gzi ba khra chung mig rnonaḥ gzi ba 'phrul gyi me longaḥ gzi ba ngag gi dbang phyugaḥgazi ba stobs ldan nag thungaḥ mi chen dpa' bo lhun grubaḥ khro rgyal gyad kyi mi thung ཿ a yag shakya rgyal mtshanaḥ bdud gcod shan pa dme dzatsho shan pa'i spu gri mched brgyadaḥ'adan ma rin chen bsam 'grub 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me 'dan ma'i g.yu spyang bcu drugaḥ dung skyongs stag lha khri dkaraḥ dung lha rtse dgu mched gnyisaX seng phrug dung gi bu dgu 'jang phrug g.yu lha thog 'gyuraḥ g.yu lha'i rtse ru dmar poḥ g.yu lha'i lcags spyang mched brgyadaḥ ga dar bdud kyi blon poḥ bdud po sgog zan dmar poX sgog gcod dpa' bo sde bdun a stag dpa' ba'i klu mo klu mo'i me ru rtse brgyad 'dab ma can la bcu drugaḥ dpa' lha mi spyang dkar po0 dpa' bo seng stag a dom: dpa' rtag ngar ma

rka bcu gsum: nang blon zhal dkar ldems pa: g.yang gi dung ri dkar poḥ g.yang lha bsam grub spun drugaḥ khrom pa spyang thul dkar poḥ mi chung lce yi dbang phyugaḥ thog 'dra stag mo sde bzhiḥ dpa' btul dam pa sum bcu grub brnyes dbab phyug brgyad bcu: ja ma dung sman bco brgyadaX skya lo'i seng rkyangs 'brug moḥ gong za me tog lha mdzesaḥ gzi lha chos kyi sgrol ma: a grags byang chub sgrol maX mgar za chos kyi lha moXmon za nor bu mdzes sman mes za 'bum gyi gtso mo: phag mo klu yi dbang phyug lha dmag dung gi tshom buX gong sman gnam gyi rgyal mo : sri lcam sa le 'od gsalaḥ lha bu du thod dkar poḥganyan dmag gser gya me togaḥ gnyan rje gser gyi bya ru gnyan sras a bo ker mdzodaḥ gnyan za srid gsum gsal byedaḥklu dmag chu yi zil ba: klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen klu sras nor bu tsing kunaḥ klu mo bsam grub dbang mo: gser shog nyi ma'i zer 'bum:'om shog lho sprin phyug moḥ dmu spyang thog ser khol 'draḥ mdor na seng chen dgra bla'i dbang phyug gi bka' 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas pa'i ye

shes gsal ba'i sbyan gyis gzigs mi g.yo ting 'dzin snyan gyis gsonaXmakhyen brtse thugs kyi gzigs pas dgongs la 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byor dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe bsrings shig dpal bskyed cigaḥmathu phyungs shigaX grags pa sgrogs shigaḥsnyan pa spel zhigaḥthugs dang mthun pa'i mchod bsgrub brten bskang mnyes pa'i rdzas yo byad sna tshogs 'bul lo bzhes su gsol sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sems can las phan bde spel rnal 'byer ba'i mgon grogs mdzod mtha' dmag gi kha zer thulaḥdagra bdud bgegs cham la phobaXphywa g.yang gi mtsho mo bskyilaḥgrags snyan gyi rnga chen sbiraḥdapa' rtags kyi rgyal rnga brdung nyes pa'i tshogs zhi bar mdzod legs pa'i dpal kun nas rgyas mos pa bzhi dbang du bsdus ༷mngon spyod kyi mthu rtsal thob rgyal kham la bde skyid spelaḥbasam pa'i don chos bzhin 'grub ḍak+ki yis bsu mar bcasaḥ.o rgyan mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i gling rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo:bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang na bzhugs pa'i rig 'ardzan pad+ma rgyal po'i

rku spyan sngar 'god pa'i grogs po mdzod cig bswo bswo bswo du gling rol mo snyan pa'i sgra da bcas te gtor ma rnams bas chen du phul sru ma rnam gya mnyes pa bskang bar bya'oḥrlung rta phul lo bshags pa na ho: chos skyongs dgra bla'i dbang phyug gi: ting 'dzin ma gsal bying rmug 'thub cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongasaḥ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyamasaḥmachod bskangs brten pa'i dam rdzas nyungaḥ gsang sngags sbyor sgrol la ma zlosaḥ gtan tshig bzhi yis rgyas ma thebs le lo bsogs 'jog ser snas bcings: nyams chags log rtogs gol sgrib bcasaX nongs pa gang song mthol lo bshags sgrib med thugs rjes bzod par bzhes: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: lus kyi sgrib dag nad gdon zhiX ngag gi sgrib bral digs lkug grolaḥ sems kyi sgrib grol log rtogs sangasaḥ rang byung 'od gsal mkha' ltar rgyasaḥ rig pa rtogs med rjen par mthongaḥ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i thugs son nas rmad byung mdzad pa'i 'gro phan 'grubaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs nus par shog snyen aḥ(ཿbadz+ra sa ma yā āX smon lam niḥ hoḥ chos sku mkha' khyabs taing

'dzin de ring 'grub nam mkha' mdzod kyi dgongs pa rlabs po chesaḥ kun tu bzang po'i phrin las bdag gis 'grub chos dbyings gzhon nu bum skur grol bar re ga longs sku 'od gsal ting 'dzin de ring 'grubaḥ phyogs ris med par yongs la khyab cing brdalaḥ 'od mtha' yas pa'i mdzad pa smon lam bzhinaḥ bde ldan pad+mo bkod par byang chub shogaX sprul sku shes rab ti 'dzin de ring 'grubaX gzhan phan phyin drug spyod pa rlabs po che gu ru pad+ma'i thugs bzhed ci bzhin pa'iḥ zangs mdog dpal rir tshom bur 'tshogs par shog yang sprul sbyor sgrol ti 'dzin de ring 'grubaḥ phyogs bzhi'i bdud btul rgyal khams bde la sbyoraḥ tu ru'i dpa' brkong bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengasaḥ 'brel tshad mkha' spyod zhing la spyod par shogaḥ bdag gzhan don gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyin nas 'gro khams dong sprugs nus pa'i mthu ldan re gaḥ bsngo ba ni heḥrnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dgra bla'i rjeḥ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul sgrub pa'i dge yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde la 'god phyir bsngoḥ rgyal bstan yun du dar zhing rgyas

kaiḥ gyur cigaḥ smon lam stobs chen btab pa 'di yi mthusaḥ khams gsum bde skyid dpal 'byor 'dzoms par shogaḥ lan gsum du gdab bsdu rim ni mdun bskyed dgra bla'i dbang phyug gtso 'khor dang bcas pa rim gyis 'od du zhu nas pad+ma rgyal po la thimaḥ de 'od du zhu nas bdag bskyed kyi thugs gar thimaḥ der chos dbyings 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i ngang la dal gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go: shis brjod re na mo: chos sku bdib mchog gi zhalaḥ 'od mtha' yas pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ longs sku snying rje khyab brdal baX nam mkha' rgyal po'i bkra shis re gaḥ sprul sku gzhan phan phrin las phyugasaḥ pad+ma 'od 'bar bkra shis re gaḥ gang la bsam pa'i don 'grub pa'iḥ dgra bla ge sar bkra shis sgo gaḥ 'jigs pa kun las dbug dbyung ba'iḥ dpa' 'bum rgya tsha'i bkra shis shog: legs pa'i yon tan sgo 'byed paḥ nyi 'bum nor bu'i bkra shas regag bde stong 'bar ba'i zlos gar can: khra cha slog 'khyugs bkra shis shog mngon spyod phrin las rtsal thob paX 'dan ma rin chen bkra shis shogaḥ dga' bzhi'i zur mig dpal

'khrud pa'i ja ma dung sman bkra shis shog gzhan snang ma lus zil gnon pa'iḥ 'bri ba chos skyongs bkra shis shogaḥ nus mthu phur thog stong gi rje khro thung rgyal po'i bkra shis shog phrin las rnam bzhi'i char 'beb pa'i dpa' btul sum bcu'i bkra shis re ga 'brel tshad rig 'dzin sar 'god pa'i grub chen brgyad bcu'i bkra shis shogaḥgadul dka' ma lus tshar gcod pa'iX dgra bla'i dmag tshogs bkra shis shogaX 'khor 'das mnyams nyid chos skur grolaḥ dgongs pa zang thal bkra shis shogaX don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub pa'i zab gsang chos kyi bkra shis shog: sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa dang: grub 'bras mngon du 'gyur bar shogaX de ltar mchod pa' don gnyis 'grub rnam mang phrin lasamanga' dbang 'byor byin rlabs nus mthu bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu lo sa dang gsal ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma sgod greng gi thugs kyi yang bcud man ngag mdzod gangs dkar ti se' brag la sbas dusakyi snyigs mar gyur pa na nga sprul las can gcig gi rted spyi mthun las kyis ma bkag na snyigs ma'i rgud pa cha shes skyobs bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos srungs 'dod sred can la ma shor cigaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥ

kaiḥ ñtsāḥ zhes pa 'a lu zin chos kyi bdag ngo 'gyur med rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te bskul ba dang / a khyu bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos ya mtshan pa 'i la gos bzang po bcas da / las ldan 'gyur rdor gya thabs shes mtshon pa 'i la regs sogs kyi skyes bcas nan tan chen pa'i bskul ngor/ kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gya dbyings sna mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa ni las ldan 'gyur rdor gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/keḥ bden brjon ni na mo rgyal bar dgongs pa'i brgyud pa rig 'dzin brda' yis brgyud paḥ gang zag snyan khungs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams gyis bden pa chen po'i mthusaḥspyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i chos thos bsam sgom gsum la bar du gcod pa thams cad dngaḥ bye brag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra nang don nyams su len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bdud ma ṭaṃ rū tra thams cad gzugs rten 'di la khug cigaḥ n+dhoX tri a gar+sha ya dza dzaX dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoX lan bdun brjod 'di ya sgrub pa 'i cha lags su nus ldan rdo rje'i spel ba dge

rkuḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig las chos skyongs dgra bla'i rgyal po'i mngon spyod drag sgrub gnam lcags thogs ngar bdud dpung zil gnon bzhugs so kaiḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ skosdi7861 zhi ba snying rje'i nga nyad las 'o ga rtog 'dul ba'i dgongs spyod can dpa' bo bdud dgra 'dul mdzad pa bde chen 'bar lo' rgyan du rolaḥ de yis zhi drag las sgrub tshe steng cha rgyal po ltar du sgrubs mngon spyod dam gas rgyugs thabs su bsgoms las tshogs bsham bkod zhal shes ltar sna srid dag mnyam rtogs pa yis sgrubs pa lam du sgong ba ni skad cig gis mdun du ma ṭaṃ rū tra thal skya mgo bo gsum pa/ lag pa drug can lus la rang 'khrungs btagag pa dang rkang pa bzhi can dug lnga dug gsum gyi rang mdangs rgyan cha lugs rdzogs pa mi srun gdug shing rngams pa 'i tshul du gsal gdabaḥ de'i sa bon las spros pa'i 'od zer kyis stong khams 'jig rten gyis gnas mchis pa'i smon log dam sri thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas ma ṭaṃ rā tra la bstim mo bden brjod bya badz+ra maṇ+ḍal e spyo phaṭaḥ zhes dpal chen po'i sras phur thal 'byin gyi dgongs sprod can 'dril zhing gzir

bas rū tra'i phung khams 'dam rtsigs la skyogs phog pa ltar rnams shes 'og min la bsres nas khog pa dpal gyis dur khrod chen po 'jigs rngams bltar mi bzod pa'i pho brang zod pa'i sku mkhar rgya che la khyon yangs pa mtshan nyid bkod pa thams cad ma 'dres shing yongs su rdzogs par gyur de yang byang chub kyi phyogs chos thams cad rnam pa brda don brtags mtshon gyi tshul du 'khor 'das mnyam nyid chen po ru kha sbyor bar byed paḥ sha za dang ro langs ma mo 'kha' 'gro rdo rje phra men ma rnams dngaḥ dur shing rtsub shing tsher ma can la sogs pa'i nags tshal bsam gyis mi khyab pa la stag gzig dom dred phag 'phar ba lce spyang la sogs pa sha la rngam shing khrag la gdung zhing ngar skad 'don paḥ sna tshogs brag gi ri po dmar la gzengs pa nag la rtsub pa smug la chob pa'i rtse mo la dur bya dang srin bya dang sha zan dang khrag 'thung rus 'cha' rkang ldags kyi tshogs 'phur lding g.yo baḥ gzhan yang me rlung gi 'tshubs ma chen por 'phyo zhing 'byugs pa'i dbus su ging rus dngaḥ srin po dngaḥ gnod sbyin dang bdud btsan dang sgog bdag dngaḥ gza'

kaiḥ klu la sogs 'jig rten dreg pa'i tshogs bu yug ltar 'tshubs shing sbyor sgrol gyi las pa rngams paḥ khrag mtsho dang dug mtsho dngaX zhag gi mtsho la mi ro baṃ pa ham pa rnyid pa mang po' rba klong 'phyo zhing gram pa ru brdal ba la dur khrod kyi bdag po bdag mo rnams longs su spyod cing brin las la snying nye bar gnas pa'oḥ rab 'jigs pho brang chen po de yis dbus su rin po che'i khri pad zla nyi ma bdud srin dam sri gdug pa can rnams bsnol ba'i kharaX dpa' bo bdud dgra 'dul mdzad bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams pham pa'i seng chen skyes bu don grub char sprin 'khrugs nyams can mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor baḥ thog ser kyi bu yug 'tshub paX ki bswo dang cha sgra 'ur baḥ la klu dang gnyan dmags 'phro ba re 'ga' me ltar 'bar zhing btsan sde'i bu yug 'tshubs paḥ re 'ga' sprin ltar gtibs shing bdud dmags chu ltar khol ba re 'ga' thogs ltar g.yo zhing dgra bla'i ser sprin 'phro ba rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i pho nya mang po la zhon zhing phrin las sna tshogs zogs med du bsgrub par bskyed do de rgyab shar phyogs su dpa' 'bum

rgya tsha zhal dkar stag mo tshangs nas pheb pa lta bu'i dpal rngam can lho phyogs su 'bri ba chos skyong rgod po 'brong bu dar ma ra gyis chas pa lta buX nub phyogs su bdud gcod shan pa glog dmar thog chu 'khyugs pa lta buḥ byang phyogs su 'dan ma rin chen gcan spyang lug khyu la pheb bzhin dpa' ngar dang ldan paḥ shar lhor tshangs pa'i bu yag 'od kyis stong gsum 'gengs ba ༷ lho nub du 'om bu'i khrag cha 1ga 'khyugs srid pa g.yo 'gul byed pa nub byang du dung skyongs stag lha khri dkar sa chen g.yo ba'i 'jigs rngam dang ldan paḥ bya shar du g.yu lha thogs rgod 'bar ba 'brug sprin ser dang bsdebs pa lta buḥ shar stod du phur thogs khro thung rgyal po ging dkar nag khra gsum gyi bu yug 'tshub pa nub smad du rgu ru bsam 'grub rdo rje rdzas sngags thun gyi tshangs khangs 'khrugs pa ༷ kun kyang dgra bla'i dpa' chas can: rdzu 'phrul gyi chibs pa la bcibs shingaX rnam bzhi'i phrin las glog ltar 'khrugs shing thog zer ltar 'jug paḥ sku rdzu 'phrul ya ma zungs ngoms shi ཿ gsung phaṭa pho glu dbyangs cho sgra ru 'gyed bzhinaḥ thugs mkhyen brtse'i 'gro

rkaḥ phan kyi dgongs spyod la rnam par rol zhing rjes su chags pa da ldan par blta' 'oḥ de yi phyi rim la a yag thar ba rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la bya ltar lding baḥrje bcun a ni dpa' bo chu la nya ltar 'jug paX dbang mdzad ma ṇi ka ra mkha' la 'ja' ltar 'khyugs paḥ dpa' lha mi spyang dkar po 'byung ba rlung ltar 'jug paḥ rgyal sras g.yu 'od 'bum me che brjid kyi gzi mdangs bkra baḥ a stag rdo rje phag mo sbyor sgol la rtag tu gnas paḥ kun kyang dpa' ngar bzod par dka' baḥ che rtags srid na mtho baḥrdzu 'phrul sprul ba 'gyed pa phrin las glog ltar 'byugs pa ༷ dam sri gdug pa can 'dul ba'i dgong spyod dang ldan par bskyed do: de rgyab ja ma dung sman bco brgyad dpa' bo la zla zhal ngoms pa ཿ rjes chags la pad zhal 'dzum paḥ bstan gzhi la zur mig g.yo baḥ skal ldan la brtse sems dkar baḥ zhi bar gzigs pas mthong na skye rgu'i yid 'phrog shing dga' bzhi rtsol med du slong baḥ rgyas pa'i 'od zer g.yo tshe bsod nams longs spyod kyi gter sgo 'byed paḥ dbang gi 'ja' tshon 'byugs tshe gnas yul gyi dpa'

bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nye 'dus zlos gar la rol ba drag po'i srin zhal ngoms tshe dgra snying skog mar 'byin cing dam sri'i zhabrul 'khor bshigs nas sbyor sgrol drag po'i dgongs spyod la bsre zhing 'og min dbyings kyi dga' ston la spyod par bskyed do: de yi phyi rim dpa' btul dam pa sum bcu ni mgon lha yag nyi 'bum nor bu la lha sras dam pa bu dgu'i bskor baḥ dgra lha mgon mu zi dmar po la gnyan po sde brgyad kyis bskor baḥ btsan lha chen stong thub rgod po la mthu mkhan bu drug gis bskor baḥ gza' khra tsha khri dar 'bum pa la dpal grub chen dam pa sde bzhis bskor nas 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang phub pa dgra bla'i bu yug 'tshubs pa bstan pa bsrung ba'i lag rjes mnga' bzhinaḥsnyigs ma'i mgon skyabs su chas par bskyed doX de rgyab grub pa'i dpal btul brgyad cu ni dpal tshe yi rig 'dzin spyi dpon sa ra ha pa la grub brnyes rig 'dzin bcu dgu'i bskor ba rig 'dzin ka ne kum pa la bla med snying po'i don rtogs pa'i grub chen bcu dgu'i bskor ba rje bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan la sor byang sngags gsum kyi

rku yon tan phul du phyin pa'i skyes chen bcu dgu'i bskor baX mgon grub brnyes rnal 'byor dar lu la rdzu 'phrul thogs med kyi yon tan thob pa'i skyes chen bcu dgu'i bskor baḥ kun kyang mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer 'bar ba0 phrin las rabs dkar 'byed pa 'brel tshad don dang ldan paḥ dgongs spyod bstan pa dang sems can kyi phan bde la rnam par brtse zhing rjes su skyongs bar bskyed doḥ de'i phyi rims tshad med snying rjes zhi sgo srung mdzad dpa' bo zhal dkar ldems pa byams pa tshad med rgyas sgo srung mdzad be+e rus rat+na dbang rgyalaḥ dga' ba chen po'i dbang sgo bsrung mdzad 'om bu'i rnal 'byer chen po btang snyom mnyam brdal byang sgo bsrung mdzad gzhen nu lha rgod 'bum me rnams dpa' la ngar 'khrugs pa btsan la brjed chags paḥ khro la gtum rgyas pa gsod la lag brdar ba'i mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul dang ldan par bskyed do: de rgyab phywa g.yang gter gyi mdzod 'dzinaḥ nor lha yid bzhin nor buX dgra lha dung ser 'bar baX lha sras nor bu rtse rgyalaX mi chen bkra shis lhun grubaḥ ga dar byang sngon rgod po khro rgyal mi thung

dpa' brjid rnams g.yang rta rin chen rwa can la bcib shingaX 'dzam gling gi gter zog skyong baX dngos grub kyi pha phog 'byed paḥ legs nyes kyis so kha srung baḥ dam tshig la snying nye bar bskyed doḥ de rgyab dpa' mgon dregs pa'i dmags tshogs thams cad kyi dpa' la dar phyar rno ba'i mtshon brdaraḥ gdug rtsubs kyi cho 'phrul 'gyed bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing sems can la phan bdes char ba 'bebs bzhin du gnas par bskyed doḥ de dag gi thugs srog las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis dgra 'dul dbang phyug rgyal po dpa' btul grub pa'i dmags dpung rnams rang bzhin gyis gnas nas spyan drangs la bstims mo rnga glang rol mo' sgra dang bcas te spyon drangs ba ni ka trīḥ 'jigs rung dur khrod 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i gnasaḥ pho rgyud mo rgyud dregs tshogs sprin 'khrigs sang legs nyes shan 'byed dam srung mthu rtsal can dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul gshegs su gsol phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul sangs rgyas bstan srung ba mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog sbyor sgrol mdzad pa can: srid na ya mtshan che ba'i mthu ldan pa

rkuḥ dpa' btul grub chen sde bcu gshegs su gsolaḥ phyin drug mdzad pa'i 'gro phan phrin las 'gyedaX bstan la dkar zhing dam tshig dag par spelaḥ gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul ba'i dpa' brjed ldan grub pa'i rig 'dzin mched drug gshegs su gsolaḥ dga' bzhi'i phrin las 'byed pa'i dam 'dzin maḥ zhi rgyas dbang drag thabs mang mdzad phrin canaḥ mthong ba'i yid 'phrog dreg pa'i bde sbyin dpal dung sman 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsolaḥ rig gsum sems dpa' 'gro ba'i dpal bzhengs paḥ gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa'i sems can rnamasaḥ mngon spyod lam gyis rnams shes chos skur sbyoraḥ dpa' btul grub chen sum cu gshegs su gsolaḥrgya gar 'phags yul grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnamasaḥ thugs bskyed dga' ba'i gdul bya'i dpal bzhengs pa phyogs bzhi'i bdud 'joms dpa' btul brgyad cu poḥ snyigs ma'i rgyal bstan gso phyir gshegs su gsol phyi yi srung bzhi zhi rgyas dbang drag gteraḥ dam tshig 'dzan mas legs nyes shan drangs 'byedaḥ nang gi gsang sgo ra ba sde bzhis

skyongasaḥ dpal ldan dgra bla mched brgyad gshegs su gsolaḥ sngon nas dam mnos legs nyes rjes gcod pasaX rnal 'byor yongs la snying nye brtse ba'i grogasaḥ gtam gyi lab rog thugs bzhed kun rtsol bsaḥ dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmags tshogs gshegs su gsolaḥ brtse ba'i zhal ngoms kha 'dzin srung skyobs dngaX dgra bla mi dang ma 'bral rtag par skyongasaX oṃ pad+ma ra dzaka ma tha la sarba sa ma yā dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol ni hūṃ dzaḥ mi 'gyur rdo rje brag dang pad zla nyi bdud dang dam sri dgra bgegs pho mo'i khar ge sar dgra bla'i dmags tshogs bzhugs su gsol bstan pa srung zhing sems can phan bde spelaX sa ma yā dzaḥ sa ma yāX stoX phyag 'tshal ni na moḥ srid zhi'i skyabs gcig pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ bdud sde'i dpung 'joms ge sar dgra bla'i rgyalaḥ mthu rtsal thogs med dpa' btul grub chen laX brtse bas rjes su 'dzin phyir bdag phyag 'tshalaX na mo pu ru sha ya ho ༷ mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ dpa' bo dgyes skong kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin dbang lnga'i me tog tshil gsur bdug pa sposaX zhun me mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus kyis zhal

rkuḥ zas rkang gling sman gtor rak+tas skyemasaḥ 'dod yon lha mo phyi nang gsang mchod sprin dngos 'byor yid sprul 'dod yon mtha' yas pasaḥ bdud 'dul dgra bla'i rgyal po gsol mchod bskangaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las lhun grub mdzodaḥ o pad+ma ra dza kā ma tha la sa pā ri wa ra rū pa shabha ghadhe sa ra spasne me sa rak+ta tsit+ta bā ling ta a mṛ ta kha hiḥ bstod pa niḥ shā hrīḥ dpa' bo bdud dgra 'dul mdzad dgra bla'i rjeḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i so srung dam tshig can: mthu rtsal thogs med seng chen 'phrul gyi rgyalaX skyes bu don kun grub la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ pha rol phyin bcu'i mdzad pas 'gro phan sgrubasaḥ phyogs bcu'i dgra bdud dam sri thal bar rlogaḥ mthu stobs dbang phyug che btsan srid na spa dpa' btul grub chen bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod byang chub sems ldan 'gro la phan bde steraḥ phyin drug spyod pas gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dulaX sbyor dang sgrol la mnga' brnyes drag rtsal canaḥ stes chen dgra bla dpa' bo drag la bstodaḥ dung sman bco rgyad bde stong gas spod spel phu n+ya sum cu'i bstan pa'i so kha srungs grub chen

brgyad cu'i snyigs ma'i rgud pa skyobs phyi nang gter sgo srung mdzad rnams la bstod sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i pho nya ba che btsan srid na mtshungs bral dregs pa'i rjeḥbastan dgra zhing bcu'i don snying lkog mar 'byinaḥsde brgyad dreg pa dpal mgon tshogs la bstod phrin las bcol ba ni bdag mdun las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed dpa' btul dgra bla'i dmag tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskulaXkun kyang mngon spyod drag po'i las la chas shing sbyor sgrol gyis dgongs spyod zab mo la chas par mos laX hūṃ dza rnga yab dpal ri srin gling nas rje btsun pad+ma thong phreng rtsalaḥdapa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang bcas mngon spyod drag pos las la bzhengasaX brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥmatha' yi dmags dang kla kle'i sdeX rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥdza byang phyogs me rlung 'tshubs ma'i khrodaḥgadul dka' 'dul ba'i dgongs spyod can sbyor dang sgrol la mnga' brnyes pa'iḥge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po niḥmangon spyod drag pos las la bzhengasaḥbargyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la mtha' yi dmags

rkaḥ dang kla kle'i sdeX rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaX dzaḥ phyogs mtshams steng 'og dkyil 'khor nasaX mngon spyod las la mnga' brnyes paḥ rdzu 'phrul mthu dang stobs kyis bdagaḥ dpal btul grub chen skyes bu bcuḥ sprul ba g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos las la bzhengasaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mtha' yi dmag dang kla kle'i sde rdul du brlag pa'i brin las mdzod dzaḥ phar phyin drug gi mdzad pa stonaḥ log rtog 'dul ba'i dgongs spyod canaḥ nus mthu thogs med dpa' bo drugaḥ las mdzad sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos las la bzhengasaX brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ mtha' yi dmag dang kla kle'i sde rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ dza bde stong mchog gi spyod pa canaḥ bsre 'pho chos skur 'tshams sbyor byed thugs bskyed dam bca' khur lci bas dpa' btul grub chen sum cu poḥ mngon spyod drag pos las la bzhengasaX brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ mtha' yi dmag dang kla 1'i sde rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las

mdzodaḥ dzaḥchos dbyings nam mkha'iklong na gnas rigs kyis phyag rgya lnga yis 'phrulaḥ bde la stong pa'i rgyas 'debs maḥ dung sman dga' sbyin bco brgyad kyang mngon spyod drag pos las la bzhengasaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ mtha' yi dmag dang kla kle'i sde rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ dzaḥ'og min mkha' spyodazhing la bzhugasaḥ 'bum phrag dpa' bo rnal 'byor skyongs gzhan phan phrin las 'gro la 'gyedaX snyigs 'gro skyobs pa'i dam bca' can grub thob rig 'dzin brgyad cu po mngon spyod drag pos las la bzhengs brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la mtha' yi dmag dang kla 1'i sdeḥ rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ dza phrin las rnams bzhi'i dgongs spyod can: dam tshig phyag rgya bzhi ldan paX nang sgo srungs ba'i dpa' bo bzhiḥ phyi mi g.yang gi dpal 'dzin paX srid na mtshungs bral grub sde rnams mngon spyod drag pos las la bzhengasaḥ brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ mtha' yi dmags dang kla kle'i sdeX rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ dza me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i klongaḥ

rkaḥ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dgongs spyod canaḥ bstan pa srung ba'i dam 'dzin pa0 dpal mgon dgra bla'i dmags tshogs rnamasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos las la bzhengasaḥ brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ mtha' yi dmag dang kla kle'i sde rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥrgyugs chang khrag skyems 'di bzhes laḥ las pa las la ma g.yel zhigaḥ ling pa ling la ma sdug shigaḥ shan pa'i spu gri'i rno ma rdulaḥ gsod mkhan gdor ba lag ma ldumaḥ dpa' rtsal rngams yus mthu ma chung drag rtsal sprul pa yus ma zhanaḥ dgra dang zin gnyis ma nor b.raḥ gsod gcod brlag pa'i phrin las kyisaX bsgral 'dren dus gcig 'byung ba dngaḥ rgya mtsho chu kha la kheb 'phongaX be+eḍūr+ya yis kha dog bsgyuraX sngon po'i lan tshwa chu la dengasaḥ du ru bzhi sde rang gzhir gabaX mtha' mi'i snga 'gros phyir la brlogaḥ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rang gnas bsgyuraḥ nad kyi na bun mkha' la gtoraX mu ge'i rgud pa dbyings su zhiX mngon sprod phrin las grub pa dngaḥ dpa' rtags rgyal rnga 'byung bar mdzodaḥ zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel zhigaḥ dus la bab po

sa ma yā de ltar mdun bskyed drag sgrub 'das mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa dang mtha' mi kla klo rdul du brlog rno nus gnam lcags thog dang 'dra bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor zhig sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang las ldan 'gyur mdo gyi thugs bzhed 'grub pa dang de wa'i dar dang gos bzang bcas bskul ngor/ nusaldan mkha' spyod gling pas shar mar spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma pa /

rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig las ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po dpa' btul dam pa rnams kyimatshon las spu gri'i 'khor 'o bzhugs so rkaḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ lhagazhi1dza/1111 mngon spyod drag po' gzhung bsrang tshe bsgral las rgyas pa gzhung ltar bya spu gri' 'khor lo byed 'dod na las rim bcu gcig dag gis bstan dang po gnad nas bskul ba ni bas mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nyid lasaḥ mdzad pa mngon spyod phrin las can: lha klu gnyan gyi dmag gi rjeḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grogs ldan paḥdagra bla'i rgyal po mthu rtsal canaḥ che ge mo ni las la bzhengasaḥ khrag skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ dgra la rgyugs cig mthu ma chungaḥ bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhanaḥ mtha' mi kla klo rdul du rlogaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzod rnal 'byor bdag gi sdong grogs kyisaḥ dam tshig ci bzhin dus la babasaḥ ma g.yel ma 'gyengs sa ma yāḥ skyems gtor mchod gnyis pa ye bskyed bya ba naḥphaṭaḥ rang mdun ye las mi sngag btson khang du dṛ dang triX las bsngan 'gro'i dgra bgegs tshomasaḥ mngon smod lngar gsal rkang lag lcags

gzer gdab thar 'chor med par btson bzhin 'phar 'dar dmigs gsum pa 'gugs pa ni na re mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden mthu dngaḥ dpa' btul dgra bla'i rgyal po'i bden stobs kyis bstan 'gror 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gang yin rnamasaḥ rang dbang med par ling ga 'di la khugaX ci mang dang yang pho nya lcags kyu can rnams kyis dgra bo de'i snying nas bzung: zhags pa can rnams kyis mgul nas bcings lcags sgrogs can rnams kyis yan lags bsdam:dril bu can rnams kyis myos su bzhugs nas las kyi ling ga 'di la dbab pa'i phrin las mdzod cig bzhi ba phur bskul niḥ dzaḥ phur ni chos kyi dbyings nyid las pa ni thal 'byin brin las bskulaX mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i brin las mdzod sku stod ye shes khro tshul brjed0 dgra bla'i dmag tshogs bu yug tshubs0 smad ni lcags phur zur gsum pa me rlung dug gi tshwa tshwa 'khrigs che ge mo yi phyag mtshan deX dgra bgegs snying gi dkyil du thobasaX skyid badz+ra ki li gī la ya a spra ra ṇa phaṭa seng ha ra ṇa hūṃ lnga pa mtshon las ni dza bye dpa'

kaiḥ dmagaX mngon spyod brin las lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir: ljang ku mtsho la na bun phyur 'dri'i dmag rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir: smug po mchong la 'od stong 'khyugs 'dra'i dmagaḥsna tshogs mdzad pa mtha' ru phyin pa'i phyir khra bo gzi la skar mda' 'khyugs 'dra'i dmagaḥ mtha' bzhi'i bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyiraḥ mgar ba sdig can shan dmag thog ltar kholaḥdus kyi ru 'dzing rming nas tshar gcod phyiraḥ nag po'i dmag sde dug chu lhud ltar 'gyedaḥ dar 'phru rlang gis bskyod nas tshubs se tshubaX ki bas cha sgra sgrogs pas stong khams g.yo lha klu gnyan dmag stong gsum 'jig rten khengaḥthog ser dug gi zi ra rdza ltar nyil sna tshogadro mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i bu yug 'tshubs las pa las la dpa' rngams rubs se rubaX ling pa li la mdur rgyugs sha ra raḥgacod pa'i spu gri dug zer tha ra raḥbarlag pa'i tho lum thun char sha ra raḥbaskul ma mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs rkyen snang cer grol gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥmatha' yi dmag bzlog dus kyi rgud pa solaḥrgya 'dre me zhon

'byung po rlung zhon thulaX tu ru ka yis gzeng pa tshar chod cig drag po mngon spyod las la mi g.yel bar0 sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i phrin las mtha' yas paX dam tshig dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ ma badz+ra kā ma tha la rā tsa na sarba sa ma yā dza dza bh+yo bh+yoḥ mtha' mi kla klo gdug pa can gyi srog snying la rbad rbadaX gtor skyems dgra yi phyogs su rdeb dmod pa bor zhi thal mo brdab ral ba bsigs la dar nag rdeb dgra dpung pha lam yin yang 'jig bgegs ste rdo rje yin yang gtor des ni lo sa spyod lhun gyis grub bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ sa ma pāḥ ye maḥ rgya padabang pad+ma se snya was ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs brtse bas mtha' dbus re da par gter gyis bkang der 'dzan rgyal tshab sprul sku 'gyed dus dang dus su rgud pa gso 'ad yang ga sa dkar ti se yaḥ byang ngos g.yu yi ru sbal la ma 'gyur ran chen phyag rgyas btabaḥ rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe rgyal tshab sprul ba sku yis rted gdul bya'i lhag ma skyongs byed cing dus kyi 'byor rgud bsal bar byed bka' 'di sngags kya bdag mos srungs dam nyams lag tu ma sgo ra zhigaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu rgya ba thimaḥsnyi zhes pa'ang a khyung mi rje dam pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bkra shas dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang / lung zan rag pa 'dzin pa 'gyur med rgya mtshos thabs shes mtshon pa'i gos bzang po' skyes

rku bcas bskul ba dang / snying nor lu gis bsngags pa'i byam sa chos nas jor ma/chog snag shog sman dang la reg dkar dmar gyi skyes bcas bskul ba da / tshogs smon las 'dzoms 'gyur rdor da / rat+na sa ras bskul ngor/ kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byoraphaṭa rgyan rig 'jin nusaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyi sa snang mkha' 'gro'i brna mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin shrī tris bgyis nga dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

rkuḥ 'gugs thung niḥ na moḥ mtshog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum: ge sar dgra bla'i dmag tshogs kyiX bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs kyisaḥ bstan dgra mtha' dmag gdug pa can li ga 'di la myur du khugaḥ dzaḥ( baṃ ho dbyer med bstemaḥ di yang snyeng thor shī tris ro ra/nus ldan dpal gyi rdo rjes sarba ma ke la/rku ༷ thun zor byin gyis drubs pa ni mdun du dur khrod khrag ge rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus suḥ thun zor rnams re ye khaṃ las byung ba'i ye shes me yi 'od zer 'bar bas 'byung po thams cad bsregs par byed la: rgya mtsho chu yi rba rlabs g.yo bas dug gsum gdon tshogs 'bog brgyal byed pa: srid gsum 'thor rlung rab tu g.yo bas mtha' mi kla klo rdul du brlag paḥ dug gi rlang pa 'phyo zhing yung dkar nag gi chu tshwa 'khrigs paX mtshe yi rno ngar gzeng zhing sgrogs rdo'i 'phrul 'khor g.yo baX lce spyang sha la rub cing mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs pa: dgra dpung thal bar brlag cing bgegs dpung drung nas 'byin pa: nus mthu bzlog par dka' zhing mtha' mi'i gshed du gyur pa gang la dmigs

pa'i bdud dpung ming gi lhag mar byed pa'i mthu ldan du bsam laX o shā hūṃ snyisto skṛstoḥ gartsa gartsa ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsaḥ bhan+ta bhan+taḥhu lu hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tikhu tshin+ta tshirnyaḥ bhisto bhin+taḥ sa ṭa sbo ṭaḥ ram̐ ram̐ḥ hril hrilaX khro khro a mu ka myagaḥ e jur hūṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad sodaX brgya stong la sog ci rigs bo da mthar dgra bla'i dpa' mas drag po'i rno mtshon lha 'dre mi yi lag cha gang la gzas pa'i yul dgra sde mtha' dmag thams cad ming gi lhag mar byed pa'i mthu ldan du gyur cigaX rten snying lan bdun dang snyen su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā rwa me tog 'thor shad rab tu gnasapar bya'oḥs ma shāḥrgya rgya rgya snying nor zhi shis bskul ngor/nu ldan pas spel ba mang ga lam̐/
rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ 'dzam gling dgra bla'i rgyal po'i mtshon las lha min grong khyer 'joms pa'i thog mda' bzhugs soḥ

kaiḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ rnye/rwa1misgoskyo/ sa sa rgyas bstan la sda yi tu ca ka yi dpung pham phyir bsgral las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'ari zog zer bzhin du spreng bar bya sa ma yu thog mar gser skyems 'bul ba ni ram̐ ye dzaḥ gser skyems gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon mi zad pa'i gter du gyuraḥ ophaḥsno 'di phyi'i re ltos bla ma dkon mchog gsum lhag pa'i la mchog gu ru rin pa cheḥ thugs dam ma g.yel snyigs mi'i 'gro la gzigasaḥ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor grogs su sbranaḥ gdul dka' 'dul mdzad seng chen dgra bla'i rjeḥ dpa' btul sum bcu du sman lha klu gnyanaḥ sprul pa yang g.yog bsam mtha' yas pa'i dmagaḥ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor grogs su sbran: pho rgyud mgon po sngags srungs ma mo'i tshogs dregs pa sde bcu dpal mgon chos skyo sa rigasaḥ yul lha gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyo sa ba rnams gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor grogs su sbranaḥ bstan pa'i 'gal zla zhing bcu lag dmar dngaḥ mtha' yi dmag dpung tu ru bzhi yi sde: bde skyid 'phrog pa'i dam sri 'byung po rnamasaḥ rang

rku dbang med par las kyi li gar phobaḥ rgyugs chang khrag skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub mdzod cigaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ gzu dpa ni kyeḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gsumaḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gre rtsa gsum sde: chos sku longs sku sprul sku dbyings nas bzhengasaḥ legs nyes bka' khrims sdom nga /'i gzi dpang mdzodaḥ rin chen rin thang bral ba'i gser skyems bzhesaḥ snyigs ma'i rgyal bstan 'di la ma gzigs samaḥ mi srun skye bo dam nyams slob ma'i gshedaḥ dgra yi kha log bgegs kyi gzeng pas mnaraḥ dge bcu'i khrims kyi sma phab nag por bsgyuraḥ khrel med rkun po lang la shar ba'i dusaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po dmag la sbranaḥ skyabs dang skyel ma mgon du khyed nyid khuraḥ baglu 'am mi bslu dgra bla'i rgyal pe mkhyenaḥrne nus gnam lcags thog 'dra'i dbal ston laḥmangon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i phyiraḥ khrag skyems gter ma bzhes la dgra sde sodaḥ mtha' yi dmag dpung ming gi lag mar mdzodaḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma

yāḥmakhyen dpang ni kya 'gro ba'i don mdzadapad+ma rgyal po yi phrin las rtsal 'chang ge sar dgra bla'i rgyalaḥdapa' btul grub chen sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas:zo dor tshul 'dzin don la byang sems dngos legs nyes shan 'byed mkhyen brtse'i nyi ma can thugs rje ma g.yel nyams thag bu la gzigasaX bdag gi blo sna dkon mchog gsum la gtad 'dun phug dam pa'i chos su dril na yang dgra bdud dam sri mtha' mi'i ma ster nas lus ngag yid gsum tshe dpal bsod nams mnar chos ltar spyod kyang chos min dug gi sgrib lus ni bza' shing sdong po rul bar bsgyur ngag ni dpal zad mi rgan shi khar thug sems kyi mdangs nyams na bun mkha' la dngaXtshe yi dpal nub snum zad mar mer gyur bsod nams mdangs nyams me tog sad kyis nyamasaḥchos kyi ngad pa 'ja' tshon mkha' la bsdusaḥ e bden kun mkhyen mgon po'i dpang mdzod cigaXgayo zol rdzun gyis mgo skor ga la spob rgyu 'bras bskru med bden pa da ston zhig dpa' skyems gtor ma dza gad 'di bzhes la dgra bgegs rdul du brlag pa'i phrin

rkaḥ las mdzodaḥ e bskyed ni bdag skyed kyi phar mdun dgra bla'i rgyal po'i tshur mdunaḥ rlung me dug zer gyi tshwa la 'khrigs pa'i klobhe duḥ eḥ las gru gsum gshin rje'i bsha' khang nag po btsan gyis hab sha rtsod paX bdud kyi lcags sder bsgrad paḥ gnod sbyin gyis dug rkyal rdeb paḥ klu yi kha rlu g.yo baḥ ma mo'i mngal khrag 'phyo baX gza' yi khra tshwa rgyugs pa: kau ki thog zer 'phro baḥ mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs paḥ lce spyang gi glal ba 'khyugs pa: sod rgyob kyi sgra chen ldir ba ཿ de lta bu'i dbus su zloḥdang triḥlas smon log dam sri mtha' dmag gdug pa can gti mug phag gi mgo bo: 'dod chags bya yi sder mo: zhe sdang sbrul gyi mjug ma: nga rgyal sprel gyi spu canaḥ phrag dog khyi yi skad lhang lhang 'don paḥ rkang lag lcags gzer gyis bsdoms shing dri gshang gi lam nas dkar dmar gyi rgyun 'dzag pa: sdug gi mchi ma 'beb cing nyam thag dbug dang bral la khad 'dar khri li li byed pa gcig tu gyuraḥ bdag mdun gnyis kyi sku yi cha thams cad nas pho nya lcags zhags sgrog dril thog pa grangs med pa 'phros nas smon

ma ga dam sri gdug pa can gang na gnas pa'i sa nas 'thar 'chor med par bzung ste nam mkha' la btegasaḥ sa gzhi la brdabaX bar snang la g.yugaḥ phyag rgya bzhis bcing nas gang du 'ang 'jug dbang med par las kyi ling ga la sib sib bstim par bsam mo bden brjod na na mo rigs 'dzin rtsa brgyud kya dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa' bden pa dang: rdo rje chos skyongs ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gyi bden pa dngaḥ seng chen dgra bla'i rgyal po dpa 'a btul dam pa sum bcu grub brtes rig 'dzin brgyad cu: dung sman rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs kyi bden pa dngaḥ steng lha dmag gi bu yug 'tshubs shingaḥ bar gnyan dmag gi thog ser khol baX 'og klu dmag gi na kun 'thib paḥ dgra bla'i khra tsha 'khyugs shing wer ma'i glog zhags 'byub pa rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i mthusaḥ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sma phab cing sems can gyi bde skyid 'phrog pa'i dam dzaḥ

rkuḥ gzugs mi ltar yang spyod nga/ 'dre srin po las kyang gdug rtsub che ba'i smon log dam sri gdug pa can thams cad rang dbang med par khra gyi li li nag rga ra ra byis chung khra yis ded pa ltar rang dbang med par gzugs ling ga 'di la khug cig: hṝḥtriḥ.a gas ya da ཿ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ci rigs brjod 'gugs pa 'i las niXdzaḥ thams cad 'gugs byed pho nya moX lcags kyu dkar mo grangs med paḥ dgra bla'i sku yi sprul pa yisaḥ madro' bzhi'i dmag da kla kle'i sdeX bde skyid 'phrog byed gang yin rnamasaḥ rang dbang med par snying nas drongasaX las kyi ling ga 'di la phobaḥ ming byang nyid dang dbyer med bsreḥ khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha dza dza rtsa sngags mthar rloḥtre+eḥ.a la ya bla khug badz+ra adru sha dzaḥsbad sngags brgya sto la sogs brjod la thun 'dzan bci ba'i las ni shāḥ thams cad 'ching byed phe nya 23 zhags pa ser mo grangs med paḥ dgra bla'i yon tan pho nya yisaX mtha' bzhi'i dmag dang kla kle'i sde: bde skyid 'phrog byed gang yin pa'iḥ mgul nas las kyi zhags pas chingasaḥ ling ga nyid dang dbyer med par chibhe sa shig badz+ra pa sha hūṃ hūṃḥ rtsa sngag mtharaḥ

ha sa ya na sum̐ ri li li chings shig chings shig e nyung hūṃ dza pa sha hūṃḥ rbadaḥbargya stong la sogs brjod la rgyun 'dzin sdom pa'i las ni be thams cad sdoms byed pho nya moḥ lcags sgrogs dmar po grangs med pa: dgra bla'i gsung sprul pho nya yisaX mtha' bzhi'i dmag dang kla zla'i sde bde skyid 'phrog byed gang yin rnams yan lag mgul mi shes pa na/ las kyi liṅga nyid dang sdomasaḥ rnam par ching shig sbo ṭa baṃ baṃX rtsa sngags mthar dgra bgegs rjeḥtri e khung hūṃ myag rbad sbo ṭa baṃḥ ma ra ya sdomasaḥ rbad sngags brgya sto la sogs brjod la rgyun 'dzan myos pa'i lasaniḥ hoḥ thams cad myos byed pho nya mo dril bu ljang mo grangs med pa dgra bla'i brin las sprul pa yisaḥ mtha' bzhi'i dmag dang kla sgo'i sde bde skyid 'phrog byed gang yin rnamasaḥ sgo gsum spyo 'bog brgyal du chugs rnam par bying 'azib gaste ho hoḥ rtsa sngags mthar dgra bgegs rloḥtri dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya myos shig 'bog cigaḥ karma gharnye hoḥ brgya stong la sogs brjod la rgyun 'dzinaḥdabab pa'i las ni e thams cad dbab byed pho nya moḥ mtshon 'khor sngon po grangs med paḥ dgra bla'i thugs kyi sprul pa yis0 mtha'

rku bzhi'i dmag dang kla kle'i sde ༷ bde skyid 'phrog byed gang yin rnams: gzugs la dbyer med dbab par gyis ༷ badz+ra a we sha ya a aX rtsa sngags mtharaḥrjiḥtriḥ.a we sha ya a we sha ya e hur bye dza rbad sodaḥ rbad sngagasaḥbargya stong sogs brjod la rgyun 'dzin dbye ba'i las niḥ bh+yoḥ thams cad dbye byed pho nya baḥ kha kha mu kha mthu mo cheḥ hū lu mu kha drag rtsal canaḥ dgra bla'i mngag bzhugs pho nya yisaḥ mtha' bzhi'i dmag dngaḥ bde skyid 'phrog byed gang yin rnams ཿ mgon skyabs sdong grogs lha dang phyesaḥ srog gcod gshed ma bdud dang sprodaḥ badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa phaṭaX rtsa sngags mthar a d+dhiḥshig rak+ta ma ra ye phyes byesaḥ mā ma trag rū tra mā ra ya phyes phyesaḥ dgra bdud skyobs byed kyi lha dang phyes shigaḥbadz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa rbad sngags brgya stong la sogs brjod la rgyun 'dzan bdag gso ba ni sno bdag ni pa d+ma rgyal po yiḥ sku la bdun brgya nyer lnga rdzogasaḥ rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gros gtamasaḥ las mdzad pho nyas bu yug 'tshubasaḥ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gsang srog 'phrogaX che btsan srid na mtshungs dpe dbenaḥ snang srid lha 'dre dbang du bsdas dregs pa

ma lus zil gnon gyuraḥ sa ma hā gu ru pad+ma ra dza sarba duṣ+ṭa e dza bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa brgya rtsa brngo da sras mchog gso ba ni / bdag nai pad+ma rgyal po yiḥ g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin laX g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin noḥ g.yas pa za byed rang bzhin laX g.yon pa gsod byed chul du gnasaḥ g.yas pa khro bo'i ra bzhin laḥ g.yon pa khro mo'i bdag nyid do: khro bo'i rang bzhin gtum la rngamasaḥ khro mo che btsun bde stong 'baraḥ gnyis med mnyam par sbyor ba'i srasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po ki la yaḥ sku stod mthing nag khro chul rdzogasaḥmatshon chen dgra sta sha zung 'dzanaḥ smad ni chu srin dbal zur gsumaḥ me rlung dug gi chu chu 'khrigasaḥ phyar bas la klu gnyan dmag 'tshubs: btab pas sto gsum brlag par byedaḥ dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos mtha' dmag gzhom zhig gī la yaḥ rgya 'dre thul zhig kai la yaḥ 'byung po zil gnon ki la yaX dam sri rdul rlog gī la yaḥ sa badz+ra ku ma thā pa rā tsa na ki lī ki la ya hūṃ phaṭaX dgra bgegs gso ba niX bye nyon mongs las las skyes pa yi dgra bgegs dam sri las ngan sde rus pa zhe sdang pha las bskyedaḥ sha khrag

rkuḥ 'dod chags ma las grubaḥ sems ni ma rig dbang gis 'khrulaḥ dge ba bcu pe khyad du bsadaḥ mi dge bcu po da du blangaX mtshams med lnga yi 'bras bu smin bsgral ba'i zhing bcu khyod la tshang gru gsumatsasgo yi dkyil 'khor niḥ khyod nyid 'dug pa'i gzhal yas khangaḥ ling ga 'di la 'dug tsa naḥ las ngan 'khrul rgyun gcod pa yinaḥ ye shes mtshon chas dbab pa na: ma rig drung nas 'byin pa yinaX mtshon chen phur dbal gzir tsa naḥ bdag 'dzin rgong rgya gtor ba yinaḥshes rab ral gris btab pa naX kun rdzo ba 'khrul 'chang stongs pa yinaḥ ma 'jigs ma sgrag las las skyesaḥ sbyor sgol mad da par dad gus bskyedaḥ spyan mig zlum pos nga la ltosaḥbla pad+ma kā ma thā la rā tsa na gī la ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ phur gdab ni hūṃ / nga ni pad+ma rgyal po'i skuX snaja srid zil gnon he ru gaḥ che btsan srid pa gsum na 'phagasaḥ rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam dgra bla'i dmag tshogs grogs su sbranaḥ pho nya dam can las la chasaX ye shes mtshon cha'i thog zer sprosaḥ gang la bya ba'i dgra bdud kyiḥ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongasaX

rku la las sgog gcod don snying 'dren zhing gdul dka' 'dul ba'i dgongs spyod la gnas par bskyed doḥ de dag rnams las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la bstim mo: rnga gshang dang rkang gling gi sgras bskul te bstoX dug mkhar khro chu rang grub nang mi rta bam chen bsnol ba'i khar ༷ dgra bsad shan pa mthu rtsal can dmar nag mi srin khros pa'i sku bdud gcod nag po gshegs su gsolaX dgra la lce yis khrag 'debs cingaḥ gnyen gyi ngo so mtho byed pa'i pho nya chen po mthu rtsal can mi chung kha bde gshegs su gsolaX stag thul can la stong gi rjeḥ stag 'phru spud pa 'bum gyi gtsoḥ che btsan stag mo brgya yi dpon:stag zhon mi chen zangs lcags khro mkhar dgu rim nasaX zangs shon sbu gri reg gcod rgyalaX zang thal 'byung ba lnga la rgyuḥ wa thul dug sdong dgu khri mthon po'i yar steng naX rigs lnga nus mthu 'bum grub pa: byad ma brlag pa'i tho lum rgyal dpa' bo rtse dgu spug po mchong gi gur nang nas khri ma 'bum gyi ngo len pa rgod po gdung btsan srin

rkuḥ 'dul la phyag 'tshal loḥ na mo sa ma ya hoḥ shāḥ dgra bgegs dbang po'i me tog dngaX tshil chen bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs zhun chen mar me 'od dang ldanaḥ mkhris pa'i dri chab ngad pa g.yoḥ sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas dang mi rkang gling bu thod rnga bcasaḥ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i yon du 'bulaX bzhes la mtha' dmag tshar chod cig ma hā ru pa shabha gharnye ra sa spasne dharma pañtsa rak+ta bā ling ta khā hiḥ shā trīḥ dmar nag srin po 'khros pa'i zhalaḥ dgra bdud bgegs la dmar las 'gyedaḥ sha za khrag 'thung rngams brjid canaḥ bdud gcod shan pa khyod la bstodaḥ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad mtha' dmag gshedaḥ gsod gcod shan pa dmar las mkhan dgra bla'i rgyal po bka' 'khor ba las mkhan srog gcod brgyad la bstodaḥ nag po stong gi gra mtshon 'debasaX srog gcod 'bum gyi dmar las byedaḥ sha za stong gi cho 'phrul gtong yang g.yog spral bar bcas la bstod sbor sgol dang du ma blangs shing lta sbod zab mo'i la ma zlosaḥ so stes dang ni theg dman pa'iX blo yis nongs pa gang song bshagasaḥ badz+ra

sa ma yā ā rgyugs bskul niḥ bswo mngon spyod las la mnga' brnyes pa mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldanaḥ srid gsum srog rtsa lag na 'changaḥ bdud gcod shan pa me ru rtseX ma g.yel ma g.yel dgra la chos ki yis bskul ma bswo yis 'bodaX cha sgras stong gsum khyab bzhin duXshan dmag 'bum bcas las la rgyugaX gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis mnyam por bzhes la rdul du rlogaḥ bla rtags rkus la don snying phyung gdug rtsub cho 'phrul ltas ngan thongasaḥ sngags pa rgyal ba'i dpag rtags stonaḥ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod dzaḥ dbang phyug chen po'i zhabs pad khur legs nyes gnyis kyi shan drangs 'byedaḥ dgra brdung gnyen gyi ngo bstod pa'i mi chung kha bde dgra la chosaX gī yis bskul zhing bswo yis 'bod cha sgras stong gsum khyab bzhin tu ༷ gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis mnyam por bzhes la rdul du rlogaX ltas ngan thun mtshon char phob laX mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ dzaḥ che btsan stag mo brgya yi dponaḥ stag thul can la stong gi rjeX stag 'phru ldan pa 'bum gyi gtso stag sgo na mi chen dgra la chos
