rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad gyi lde mig lasaḥ seng chen dgra blamirgyal po'i thugs dam gnad bskul bswo rabs 'brug stong ngar sgra bzhugasaḥrkuḥ na 31 gu nag pad+ma ka ra yeḥ sa /nyanatsā bla) bso sgra drag po bsgrags pa yis dgra bla'i dmag tshogs gnad nas bskul de phyir dam tshig ldan pa yi 'di ltar rngam pa 'a sgra bcas gyer ba༄3mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings rum nas dgra bla'i dmag tshogs las la bzhengasaḥ dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul baḥ bdud kyi dpung rnams pham phyir bskul0 ja ma dung sman ḍak+ki'i tshogasaḥ bde stong mdzad pa ston phyir bskul ༷ thabs shes gnyis med dgongs spyod rnams drag po'i las labs yibaskul dgra bla dung mi dung rta can bco lnga'i zla ba nya gang zhalaḥ dpa' 'bum rgya tsha zhal dkar deḥ mngon spyod las la bsto yi bskulaḥ nag po bdud kyi mgo gnon mdzodaḥ dgra bla mi ser rta ser canaḥ bsreg bcad brdar ba gser 'dra'i zhalaḥ gser rje tshangs pa'i bu yug deX mngon sprod las la bswo yi bskul ser po hor gyi gnya' non mdzodaḥ dgra bla mi dmar rta dmar canaX glog stong

dus gcig 'khyugs 'dra'i zhal bdud gcod shan pa rme ru rtse mngon spyod las la bas yi bskul0 dmar po 'jing gi kha gnon mdzodaḥ dgra bla mi sngon rta sngon canaḥ sngon po be+eḍūr ya yi zhalaX 'bri ba chos skyongs rgod po de mngon spyod las la bas yi bskulaḥ sngon po rgya yi kha gnon mdzodaḥ dgra bla mi ljang rta ljang canaḥ g.yu mdog mtsho la phog 'dra'i zhalaX 'dan ma rin chen bsam 'grub de mngon spyod las la bswo yi bskulaḥ gu ne mon gyi kha gnon mdzod dgra bla mi dmar rta dmar canaX dmar mo mtshal gyi zhal mnga' baX 'om bu'i khra tsha glog 'byugs deX mngon spyod las la bswo yi bskul dmar po lhu khri'i mgo gnon mdzodaX dgra bla mi dkar rta sngon canaX dung rir nyin byed 'byud 'dra'i zhalaḥ dung skyongs stag lha khri dkar deḥ mngon spyod las la bswo yi bskulaḥ dkar po ta zig kha gnon mdzod dgra bla mi smug rta khra canaḥ 'od 'bar 'ja' 'od 'khyugs 'dra'i zhal g.yu lha thog rgod 'bar ba deḥ mngon spyod las la bas yi bsku‘paX a bse gdug pa'i kha gnon mdzodaḥ dgra bla mi nag rta nag canaḥ rigs sngags nus mthu phul

rkaḥ phyin pa sngags mkhan khro thung rgyal po deḥmangon spyod las la bswo yi bskulaḥkha che gdug pa'i mgo gnon mdzodaḥdagra bla mi rgur rta smug canaḥ'agong po spun dgu dam 'dogs pa'i rgu ru khra chung nor bu deḥ mngon spyod las la bswo yi bskulaḥ g.yang mdzod dgra la ma shor cig badzaḥdrag rtsal can gyi dgra bla bcuḥ sngon nas thugs dam zhal bzhes canaḥ dam tshig bzhin du bswo yis bskul gting rag gtor skyems 'di bzhes laX dgra dang zin gnyis ma nor b.raḥ mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengasaX bstan dgra mtha' mi'i gshed po mdzodaḥbaswo chos skyongs dgra bla mthu rtsal canaḥ pho nya yang g.yog dpung dang bcasaḥ snyan gyi gson la thugs kyis dgongasaX sgrub pa po yi grogs su chosaḥ dgra bla mi ser rta ser canaḥ dpa' ngar thog chu khol 'dra baḥ a yag thar ba rgyal mtshan deḥdrag po'i las la bswo yis bskulaX snyi rjes 'gal zla tshar chod cig: dgra bla mi khra rta khra canaḥ dpa' ngar nus mthu bzlog med paḥ'om bu'i a nu dpa' seng deX drag po' las la bas yis bskulaḥ bstan bshigs lag dmar dru 'byin

mdzodaḥ dgra bla mi dkar rta dkar can khra tsha thog zer khol 'dra baḥ rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra deX drag po'i las la bas yis bskul tu ru ka yi ru 'dzing bzlog dgra bla mi dkar rta sngon canaḥ mngon spyod las la mnga' brnyes paḥ dpa' lha mi spyang dkar po de drag po'i las la bas yis bskulaḥhor sogs mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog mdzodaḥdagra bla mi smug rta ser can rkyen po'i rang dbang thob pa yiḥ 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me de drag po'i las la bswo yis bskulaḥ 'khrul snang lam gyi ru tra sgrolaX dgra bla mtshal gyi rta zhon pa rdo rje phag mo 'dzum pa'i zhal a stag klu yi bu mo de drag po'i las la bas yis bskul ma rig rū tra chos skur sgrolaX bsreḥ mthu rtsal can gyi dgra bla drugaX sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ltaraḥ bswo yis bskul lo las la bzhengasaX gting rag gtor skyems 'di bzhes la phyin drug spyod pa rlabs po chesaḥ dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral 'dren mdzodaḥ bswo zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'iḥ dgra bla mi dkar rta dkar can dpa' bo zhal dkar ldem pa de thugs dam gnad nas bas yis bskulaḥ

kaiḥ 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi bar mdzod rgyas pa'i brin las sgrub mdzad pa'iḥ dgra bla mi ser rta smug can: be ru'i sras mchog rat+na deḥ thugs dam gnad nas bas yis bskul tshe dpal 'byor drug rgyas par mdzodaḥ dbang gi phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'iḥ dgra bla mi dmar rta dkar can sbas pa'i rnal 'byer dar li deḥ thugs dam gnad nas bswo yis bskulaḥ 'dod dgu dbang du 'du bar mdzod drag po'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'iX dgra bla mi smug g.yu rta canaḥ dpa' bo lha rgod 'bum me deḥthugs dam gnad nas bswo yis bskulaḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod bswo rnam bzhi'i phrin las grub mdzad rnams sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ltaraḥbaswo yis bskul lo las la bzhengasaḥ gting rag gtor skyems 'di bzhes laḥ zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yisaḥ rnal 'byor bzhed don kun sgrub mdzod bswo g.yang gi sku mkhar ldems pa nasaḥ nor bu mig stong gter gyi bdagaḥ lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyal deḥ thugs dam gnad nas bswo yis bskulaX rgyal bstan dar 'jam rgyas par mdzod

dpal ldan nor gyi g.yang mdzod nasaXgazu byur gser dngul gter gyi bdagaX'aphan po ga dar spyang sngon deX thugs dam gnad yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde skyid mdzod g.yang rta rlung bde ga rat+na'i gtsugasaX dgu khri dgu 'bum gter bdag poḥgayang bdag mi thung khro rgyal de thugs dam gnad nas bswo yis bskulaḥnd mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi bar mdzod rin chen sna dgu'i sku mkhar nas0 go khrab mtshon cha'i gter bdag poḥmi chen dpa' bo lhun grub de thugs dam gnad nas bswo yis bskulaX ru 'dzing dus kyi rgud pa solaḥbaswo mdzod chen bzhi yi lde mig rnamasaḥsngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes ltaraX bswo yis bskul lo las la bzhengasaX gtang rag gtor skyems 'di bzhes la mtha' yi dmag gi dpa' rkong shing bstan 'gror sman pa'i dpal bskyed cigaḥbs nam mkha' 'ja' 'od gur khang nas0lha yi dmag tshogs bswo yis bskulaḥbar snang thog ser 'khrugs klong nasaXganyan gyi dmag tshogs bswo yis bskul sa gzhi rgya mtsho 'khyil klong nasaḥklu gnyan gtod dmag gi dpa' rkong shingaḥdagung sngon be+eḍūr

rkuḥ klong dkyil nasaḥ dgra bla'i dmag tshogs bswo yis bskulaḥ o rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du gling nas dung sman tshogs rnams bas yis bskul sbas yul dur khrod gtsug lags nasaḥ dpa' btul grub chen bswo yis bskulaḥ che brjid dpa' bo 'gran bral rnams bswo sgra drag po 'brug gi bskulaX 'bring rgyud dpa' 'dzing 'om bu'i dmag bas sgra snyan 'gyur glu yis bskul chung rgyud dmu spyang stag mo'i sde bswo sgra srin po'i glu yis bskulaḥ bdud kyi grong khyer bswo yis pham: lha yi ngo so bswo yis bstod rnam bzhi phrin las bswo yis sgrubasaḥ kai bswo cha'o lha rgyal loḥ khrag skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes laX rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ gtor skyems dgra yis phyogs su sdeb dmod pa bor bas maro na spyod 'grub rno nus gnam lcags thog dang 'dra bden rdzun lag tu longs da gsalaḥ sa ma yu ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugasabacud gteraḥ gangs dkar ti se'i brag la sbas snyigs mar nad mchen gzing langs tshe nga sprulal las can gcig gis rnyed spyi mthun las ngan tshan po ches leg pa'i lam du ma bsgyur na re zhig sems can skyobs kya tha bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos sru sa dam

nyams lag tu ma shor zhigaḥ sam yu rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang lung 'dzin chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med yon tan rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcasate bskul ba dang / la smon 'phro mdzoms 'gyur rdor nas dbang gi gos bzang rin chen dang po' dbyar rnga bkra ba dri bral dkar yol nor mchog snag gi skyes bcas bskul ngor/ kho bo sbasapa'i rnala'adror nu ldan dpal gyi rdo rjesadabyingasasnang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa na las ldan 'byur rdor gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lo/

rka0 bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ seng chen dgra bla'irgyal po'i cha rabs dpal gyi rdzongs chen bzhugasaX kaiḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ //rte/〉〉/ṭ+wāṃ dgra bla'i rgyal po ge sar nyid ma ro na spyod las 'a bskul ba'i phyir cha rabs dpa 'a rdzongs snyan gsan phul rol mo sna tshogs sgra sbar bzhinaḥ / dzaX o rgyan mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling rig 'dzin dpa' bo rgya mtsho dngaḥ ging dang ling ga'i tshogs kyi rjeḥ rigs gsum pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul garaX seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul deḥcha'o cha'o dgra la chosaḥ sngon gyi thugs dam ci bzhin duḥ mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung gzhom pa'i phyir mgyogs pa rlung gi gshog ldan bcibs skad cig yud tsam gnas 'dir gshegasaḥ dpa' bo'i ru mtshon mkha' la gzingasaḥ bdud snying tsit+ta dmar 'byin mdzod0 'phrul gyi zhags pa dgra la dbobaX bsdom cing thar 'chor med par mdzodaḥdapa' bo'i 'khor gsum glog ltar 'khyagasaḥ dug gsum las stes dgra dpung gzhom lha dmag bu yug bzhin du 'tshubs nga rgyal las byung bdud sde gzhomaX gnyan dmag

thog ser khol ltar chos phrag dog las skyes dam sri sgrolaḥ klu dmag rgya mtsho 'byur ltar 'khrugasaḥ nyon mongs las skyes 'byung po thul dar nag ru mtshon rgyal mtshan bsgrings bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spelaX me rlung dug gi zi ra 'tshubasaḥ sa gsum gdug tshogs bsreg gtor mdzodaḥ 'ja' 'khyud dri bzang me tog 'phroḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sun ma mdzod rnam bzhi'i las la 'du ba rnams rnga yab dpal rir rgyas thob cigaḥ dzaḥ cha'o cha'o dgra bla chos dung dmag 'bum gyi kha lo ba dgra bla mi dkar rta dkar can dpa' 'bum rgya tsha zhal dkar deX do nub mngon spyod las la chos0 gser 'od mtsho la phog 'dra'i gziḥ ser po 'bum gyi kha lo ba gser rje tshangs pa'i bu yag deḥ do nub mngon spyod las la chos glog stong 'byugs pa'i gzi brjed can dmar po 'bum gyi kha lo baḥ bdud gcod shan pa rme ru rtse do nub mngon spyod las la chosaḥ sngon po be+eḍūr ya yi gziḥ lcags 'phru can la 'bum sde'i rjeX 'bri ba chos skyongs rgod po de do nub mngon spyod las la chosaḥ g.yu mdog mtsho la phog 'dra'i sdeḥ

rkuḥ ljang nag 'bum gyi kha lo baḥ'adan ma rin chen bsam 'grub de do nub mngon spyod las la chos mtshal rir me 'od phog 'dra'i zhalaḥ dar dmar 'phru can 'bum sde'i rjeḥ 'om bu'i khra tsha glog 'byugs de do nub mngon spyod las la chosaX bdud rtsi sprin gyi char 'bebs paḥ sbug po'i 'phru can 'bum sde'i rje dung skyongs stag lha khri dkar deḥ do nub mngon spyod las la chos ༷ sna tshogs 'ja' yi gur khang phubaḥ mdzes tshon bkra 'dra'i gnyan dmag rje g.yu lha thog rgod 'bar ba deX do nub mngon spyod las la chosaX bde sto spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ba sprul pa bu yug 'tshubs 'dra'i rjeX sngags mkhan lha mgon khro thung rgyalaḥ do nub mngon spyod las la chos ༷ dam sri spun dgu'i gshed po cheX nag po 'bum gyi las dmag rje rgu ru khra chung nor bu de do nub mngon spyod las la chosaXdza cha'o cha'o dgra bla rnams rgyugs chang dza gad khrag skyems dngaXdamar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes laX dpa' bo las la ma g.yel shigaḥ mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal ma bul zhigaḥrdon po'i so kha ma rdul zhigaḥ nyag phran mda' ngar ma zhan paraḥ

smon lamam ga pa'i dam sri rnamasaḥ bsgral zhing 'dren pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ dzaḥ sngon nas dam tshigs mnos pa yi dgra bla mi ser rta ser canaḥ a yag thar ba rgyal mtshan deX mngon spyod drag po'i las la chosaḥ gzi yi gur khyims phub 'dra'i buḥ dgra bla mi khra rta khra canaḥ 'om bu'i a nu dpa' seng de do nub mngon spyod las la chos 'ja' 'od sbrang char 'khrugs dbus nas dgra bla mi dkar rta dmar canaḥ rgyal sras ma ṇi ka ra de do nub mngon spyod las la chosaḥ dpa' mdzing stag mo 'byon yag niḥ dgra bla mi dkar rta sngon can dpa' lha mi spyang dkar po de do nub mngon spyod las la chosaḥ dpa' rtsal nus mthu thog med paḥ dgra bla mi skrug rta ser can 'dan sras g.yu 'od 'bum me de mngon spyod rdo rje phag mo 'dzum pa'i zhal mdzes rngam mtshal gyi rta zhon paX a stag dpa' ba'i klu mo de mngon spyod drag po'i las la chosaḥ dzaḥ phyin drug spyod pa ston mdzad pa'i0 dgra bla dpa' bo sde drug gis rgyugs chang dza gad khrag skyems dang dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la dpa' bo las la ma g.yel cig mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal

kaiḥ ma bul cig rnon po'i so kha ma rdul zhigaḥ nyag phran mda' ngar ma zhan par ༷ smon lam log pa'i dam sri rnamasaḥ bsgral zhing 'dren pa'i phrin las mdzodaX dzaX cha'o cha'o dgra la chos gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gur khyims nasaḥ dgra bla mi dkar rta dkar canaḥ dpa' bo zhal dkar ldem pa deḥ drag po mngon spyod las la chos be+eḍūr ya yi 'od khyims nasaḥ dgra bla mi ser rta spug canaḥ be ru'i sras mchog rat+na deX drag po mngon spyod las la chosaḥ dbang gi 'od khyims g.yo ba nasaX dgra bla mi dmar rta dkar canaḥ sbas pa'i rnal 'byer dar lu de ༷ drag po mngon spyod las la chosaḥ mtsho gling gser ri gur khang nas dgra bla mi spug g.yu rta canaḥ dpa' bo lha rgod 'bum me deḥdrag po mngon spyod las la chosaḥ dzaḥ rnam bzhi phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i dgra bla dpa' bo sde bzhi yisaḥ rgyugs chang dza gad khrag skyems dngaX dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la dpa' bo las la ma g.yel cigaX mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal ma bul cig rnon po'i so kha ma rdul zhig0 nyag phran mda' ngar ma zhan par smon lam log pa'i dam sri rnamasaḥ

bsgral zhing 'dren pa'i phrin las mdzod dzaḥ cha'o cha'o dgra la chos g.yang mdzod nor bu mig stong nasaḥ dgra bla dung mi dung rta can dgra lha yid bzhin nor bu deX dkar po'i dmag dpung bzlog phyir chosaḥ gzi mdzod mig bu stong mkhar nasaḥ dgra bla mchong mi mtshal rta canaX 'phan po ga dar spyang sngon de khra bo'i dmag dpung bzlog phyir chos khrab mdzod bse mkhar dgu thog nas dgra bla mi ser rta sngon can: mi chen dpa' bo lhun grub deX sngon po'i dmag dpung bzlog phyir chos ༷ g.yang rta dgu khri dgu 'bum nas dgra bla mtshal mi dung rta can g.yang bdag mi thung khro rgyal de dmar po'i dmag dpung bzlog phyir chosaḥ dzaḥ mdzod chen bzhi yi lde mig 'dzin dus kyi dbul phong rgud bsal ba'i g.yang bdag dpa' bo sde bzhi yiḥ rang rang sprul ba g.yog 'khor bcas rgyugs chang dza gad khrag skyems dngaX dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ dpa' bo las la ma g.yel shigaX mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal ma bul zhig rnon po'i so kha ma rdul zhig nyag phran mda' ngar ma zhan paraḥsmon lam ma ga pa'i dam sri rnams bsgral zhing 'dren

rkuḥ pa'i brin las mdzodaḥ dzaḥ cha'o cha'o dgra la chos dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul baḥ ya seng 'phrul gyi lde mig dang ja ma dung sman nyi shu gcigaX dpa' btul dam pa mi bdun dang yang 'dul skyes bu sum bcu poḥ spyang bdag lha sras nor bu bzhiX grub thob skyes chen brgyad cu poḥ yang g.yog sprul pa mu med paḥ nam mkha' sa gzhi gang ba'i dmagaḥ thog 'brug glog stong 'khyugs bzhin tuḥ dgra la mtshon brdar khrigs se khrigaX bdud la bro brdung thibs se thibaḥ bgegs la mda' 'phen sha ra raḥ sri la thun 'debs nyi li li rta rgyugs ldogs sgra ldi ri ri gī bswo cha sgra 'u ru rtsa gzhu brdung mda' spreng tha ra raX mdung dang ru mtshon rgyugs se rgyugs dgra stur so ngar dug chu kholaḥ do nub bstan pa'i dgra la chosaḥ kun kyang thugs dam ma g.yel b.raḥ rgyugs chang dza gad khrag skyems dngaḥ dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ dpa' bo las la ma g.yel shig mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal ma bul zhig rnon po'i so kha ma rdul zhigaX nag phran mda' ngar ma zhan paraḥ smon lam log pa'i dam sri rnams bsgral zhing 'dren pa'i

phrin las mdzodaḥ dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ dmanyams pa'i dgra bo 'di'i rnam shes mkha' spyod kyi zhing du spor la gzugs phung ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsgyur de mthu chen dgra bla'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstabs po ma hā me sa khā ha ma hā rak+ta khā hiḥ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi 'di ltar cha rabs bden mthu brdar dgra dku pha lam yin kyang 'jigs mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grubaḥ sangs rgyas bstan/ pa 'i che ba bskyed sems can yongs la phan bde sbyin rno nusabyin rlabs bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ yo rgyan pad+ma'i thugs bcud 'di gangasadakar ti se'i brag la sbas snyigs ma lnga ya dus skabs su thugs kya sras da 'phrad par 'byuraḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thimaḥ3)ཿ zhes pa'ang lung zin 'byur med rgya mtshos bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang / las ldan 'gyur rdor gos bzang g.yar rnga bkra ba bkra shis lha regs nor mchog snag shog mdzes pa' dkar yol bcas te nan bskul ngor/kho bo nus na dpal gyi rdo rjesamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ma'adi la bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni 'gyur rdor nathangabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

rkuḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ 'dzam gleng skyes bu don grub rtsal gyis rgyugs byang rlung nag 'tshubs ma bzhugs soXrku na 31 gu nag pad+ma ka ra ye rtenardo 47 gtor ma dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim bya sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor mos rgyugs chang dza gad khrag sbyar phyar bstan pa'i dgra la yus rngams bskyed snyan pa'i glu dang rol mo bcas hūṃ bh+yoḥ dgongs shig bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsumaḥ gson cig ma mgon lcam dral bka' sdod tshogasaX gzigs shig ge sar dgra bla'i dmag tshogs rnamasaX do nub mngon spyod drag po'i las la bskulaḥ bdud rtsi khrag chang mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ snyigs ma'i sems can sdug bsngal 'di la gzigasaX mi bden rdzun gyi dbu skor ga la spobaḥ nad mug mtshon cha'i gzeng pa phyogs bzhi'i langaX dgra yis kha lo bgegs kyis hab sha rtsodaḥ dam pa'i chos khrims bstan pa 'dzin dbang medaḥ mi yi mgo gnon phyugs kyi g.yang len zhingaX gzhon nu'i khral bsda gza' mi gshag phral bgoX ste dgu'i bsam sbod sdag bsngal gdungs bas gziraX spi mthun las kyis basmral

yang snying rje'i gnas kye ma kye spyod 'di la ma gzigs sam: ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po gnad nasabaskul ya seng 'phrul gyi lde mig khyod dran 'bod ma seng nor bu dgra 'dul ra mdar sbranaḥ mgo nag mi la skyabs med skyabs su phebasaḥ mdo sngags bstan pa'i srung ma las la bzhengs jo skyes yid bzhin nor bu ma g.yel zhigaḥ drag lha'i kha rlang dug mtsho skem du chugaḥ btsan lhas smon log me dpung rang mal sodaḥ stobs chen sdig pa'i dug sbal snying khrag gtoraX bdud rgyal dri ngan mtha' mi'i chu klong skemaḥ ma g.yel thugs rje ma chung stobs ma zhanaX rkyang bu bsam don kun 'grub las la bzhengasaḥ 'dzam gling skyes bu'i thugs bzhed myur bar bskulaX gling bzhi skye dgu'i so chas mi nyams paraX myur mgyogs stobs kyis mtha' dmag kha lo bsgyur 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs 'phags ma lha mos 'dzum dung sman rnam kyis snyan gsan bskul glu phulaḥ 'gro ba'i skyid sdug thugs rjes ma dor gzigasaḥ las ngan 'khrugs rtsod ming gi lhag mar mdzod 'og min dbyingasanas dpa' 'bum rgya tsha bskul dgra bla'i chas gsol mtha'

rkaḥ mi'i gshed du bzhengasaX grub pa'i dbang phyug spyi dpon rgyal po bskulaḥ smon log 'phrul gyi rgyal po bsgral 'dren mdzod dpa' rgod thog med dgra lha rtse rgyal bskulaX dmag gi rje bo btsan dug nag po thulaḥ pad+ma'i zhal can rong tsha ge 'phan bskulaḥ chags pa dab bsgyur bdud mo dam la thogaḥ rgyal sras byang sems ma ṇi ka ra bskulaḥ smon lam log pa'i dam sri ar la gtodaX sbyor sgol phul phyin lha rgod 'bum me bskulaḥ bdud kyi gral kha mda' yi rno la drongasaḥ yab rje dam pa phying rlon rgyal po bskulaḥ gtso bo kha 'dzin tsi na'i che dgu gzhomaḥ 'chi med rig 'dzin ka ne+e kum pa lta ba log pa'i lam ston thams cad sgrol mi g.yang dam pa nang chung g.yu stag bskul:bdud phrug 'phrul gyi a lu rta mig gtoraX 'da' yi rtsal thob 'dan ma rin chen bskul byang gi mtsho shog lce spyang dmag sna bsgyuraḥ ku zhe'i du skyong stag lha khri dkar bskul lho yi me shog 'phar ba'i dmag sna bsgyuraḥ ser po hor rje bdud gcod shan pa nub kyi lcags shog dug khyi'i dmag sna bsgyuraX smug po 'jang sras g.yu lha thog

'gyur shar kyi rlung shog dom bu'i dmag sna bsgyuraḥ tā zig nang blon zhal dkar ldem pa bskul gshin lha thog rtse rgya khra'i dmag sna bsgyuraḥ rje bo khrom pa spyang thul dkar po bskulaX dug sbal mgo dgu lan tsha'idamag sna rtsal rgod dpa' bo ga dar byang sngon bskulaḥ smon lam log pa'i bdud kyi dmag sna bsgyur grub pa'i dbang phyug rin chen bsam 'grub rgya 'dre me zhon mkha' las sdog med mdzodaḥ sbas pa'i rnal 'byer 'om bu'i dar lu bskulaḥ 'byung po rlung zhon sa las ldang med mdzod0 'om bu'i mtshal lu me stag thog rgod mkha' la bsgod pa'i bya sngon bcing bsdam mdzodaḥ dpa' bo 'gran bral a nu dpa' seng zangs lcags mkhar gyi ngan sngags mkhan po thul ༷ 'gyur med khra tsha glog 'byugs rgod po bse shing bdud mo dam sri mi zan sgolaḥ stong thub rgod po g.yu yi mtshal 'bum bskulaX sa yi phongs byed dom bu snying sdug gzhomaX rong sde'i rje ba stag mo 'byon yag bskul mu stegs bya lag can gyi dmag sna bsgyuraḥ 'brog mi kha 'dzin gnam lha 'bum thub bskulaḥ mkha' la bsgrod pa'i bya bde ga can khyu bzlog stag rong

kaiḥ spyi dpon sngags pa khro thung bskul rdzas sngags rbod gtong rigs sngags drung 'byin mdzodaḥ mgon chen lha yag nyi 'bum nor bu tu ru dkar po'i 'phrul dang dmag sna bzlogaḥ dgra brdung lha mgon mi zi dmar po tu ru ser po'i 'phrul dang dmag sna bsgyur ༷ btsan po lha chen stong thub rgod po tu ru dmar po'i 'phrul dang dmag sna bsgyuraX gza' rgod khra tsha khri dar 'bum pa bskul tu ru sngon po'i 'phrul dang dmag sna 'grib rgod po chos skyong ber nag bskul log rtogs bdud kyis spyor ngan gzul 'khor bzlogaḥ rga rje'i rgyal po klu phyug dpa' bo bskulaḥ mtha' mi dbus bskul bdud kyi 'phrin pa sodaḥ gser ba'i gtso bo nyi 'bum lha dar bskulaḥ yul gru bco brgyad gtso bo dam sri thulaḥ sog yul mi chen rga yi bla ma bskulaḥ sog po sprel slag can gyi dmag sna bsgyuraḥrtsergyud rgyal mtshan thog pa mi bzhi dpal la hab sha rtsod pa'i mtha' dmag bzlogaX rgu ru shog chen drug gi rgyal po bskul dam sri spun dgu 'phar ldang g.yo med mdzod che 'bring chung gi las dmag thams cad bskulaḥ nad mug 'khrug rtsod dus kyi

'phel 'grib bzlog blon chen drug gi las dmag thams cad bskulaḥ khra spyang dom glag dam sri sde bzhi thulaḥ yang 'khor khri 'bum sa ya dung phyur bskul dus kyi rgud pa sna mang zhi bar mdzodaḥ mdo sngagasabastan pa'isgron me phyogs bcur sbor ma rig mun sangs dge bcu'i khrims la gnasaḥ o rgyan pad+ma'i gdul bya'i zhing gyur teḥ ge sar dgra bla'i sa lam mdzub mos stonaḥ dpal gyi ri dang rigs ldan sham bha laraḥ dpa' btul rnams kyis sngon bsu rgyab bskyel bcasaX 'ja' lam gdong nas rol mo bstod bsngags 'uraḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gral mjug zin pa dang skye dgu bde la sbyor ba'i mthu ldan nasaḥ don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzodaX de ltar rgyugs byang bskul gsol gdab rgyugs chang brag skyems gtor ma/ 'bulaḥ mtha' mi kla klo gzhom pa 'i mtshonaḥ 'di yi nus mthu bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ dkon mod rgyal khams 'grim dang mtho sa ma yuḥ ye maḥrgyaladabang pad+ma'i thugasabacud 'diḥte se gangs kyi byang 'dab nas sprul nga dang ma gzhan pa nus lngan rdo rjes rnyed par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgyaḥ gu rgya bdo tham snyi zhes pa' a khyu mi rje bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang rdo rje'i

rkaḥ lung zan 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang / snyang nor dam pa byams chos 'gyur rdor rnams kyi bskul ro ra/ kho bo nu ldan dpal gyi rdo rjes dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa na lung zan shrī tris bgyis pa dge le gas 'phel/ sarba mabe le/

kaiḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ ge sar dgra bla rgyal po'i dmag 'gyed rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhugasaḥrkaḥ na 31 gu theg pad+ma ka ra ye 142411 sha khrag dmar gya gtor ma la dgra bgegs 'gugs bstem nan tu bya dgra bla gnyes pa'i dzos su spel rnga gshang 'khrol bzhin 'di skad kyer ba13mi mngon nam mkha'i klong dkyil nas 'dzam gling seng chen rgyal po yiḥ dgra bla'i dpa' chas klubs bzhin duḥ mngon spyod drag po'i dmag la chosaX dung ri 'od kyi gur khyims nas dgra bla mi dkar rta dkar canaḥ dpa' 'bum rgya tsha zhal dkar deX mngon spyod drag po'i dmag la chosaḥ mchong ri 'od kyi gur nang nas dgra bla mi spug rta smug canaḥ'abri ba chos skyongs rgod po deX mngon spyod drag po' zangs ri 'od kyi gur nang nasaḥ dgra bla mi dmar rta dmar canaX bdud gcod shan pa miru rtse mngon spyod drag po'i gser ri 'od kyi gur nang nasaḥ dgra bla mi ser rta ser can: gser ba'i nyi 'bum lha yag deḥ mngon sprod drag po'i g.yu ri 'od kyi gur khyims nasaḥ dgra bla mi sngon rta ljang

kaiḥ shag kyi lce 'deb thags se thag dgra bo'i nyes pa dran du chugaḥ dpa' bo'i mtshon brdar rubs se rubaḥ dgra bo'i dran pa nyams su chugaḥ pho nyas thun 'debs nyi li liX dgra bo 'bog cing brgyal du chugaX do nub nam kyi gong thun la dgra bo'i bla rkun jag pa 'gyedaḥ 'phrul gyi than mdzod rgo phyes laḥ dgra yul than snas 'geng du chugaḥ drag rtsal dpa' ngar stobs bskyed laḥ dgra bo'i pho brgya gri ru sod mo rnams 'gags cing spyo ru chugaḥ byis pa rnams ni chung sris 'phrogaḥ ming gi lhag tsam ma sdo/sa paraX bsgral 'dren brlag pa'i phrin las marngordod gtor skyems dgra bo'i phyogs su sdeb mngon spyod drag las myur du 'grubaḥ sa ma yāḥ.oṃm rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng gi thugs kya yang bcud zab pa'i gter gangs dkar ti se'i brag la sbas dus kyi snyigs mar gyur pa na nga sprul las can gcig gis rted smon log bdud kyi ma bkags na snyigs ma'i rgud pa cha shes skyobs bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos srungs 'dod sred can la ma shor cigaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thamaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'ang lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang a khyung bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho las ldan 'gyur rdor rnams kyi bkra shis dge ba' skyes du mar bcas te nan tan chen pos

rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig las ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'idamag rgyug spyogs rdo ngar ma bzhugasaḥkeḥ na 31 gu na pad+ma ka ra yeḥ shā(shāmakhyen gtor skyems bshams la 'gugs bstems byedaḥsha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor mos rka gling bdud pa'i sna drangs nas dmag rgyugs bskul ba 'di lta ste bsaḥ sangs rgyas chos kyi srung ma cheḥ dgra bla yongs kyi rgyal po ni seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul rtsalaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i dmag la bzhengasaḥ dgra bo brlag pa'i las la rgyugs bco lnga'i zla ba'i zhal bzang canaḥ dpa' 'bum rgya tsha zhal dkar deḥ mngon spyod drag po'i las la chosaḥ dgra bo gsod pa'i shan par rgyugs gser gyi rta bdun zhal bzang can: gser rje tshangs pa'i bu yag de mngon spyod drag po'i las la chosaḥ dgra bo gsod pa'i shan par rgyugasaX glog dmar stong 'khyugs 'od 'bar baḥ bdud gcod shan pa me ru deḥ mngon spyod drag po'i las la chosaḥ dgra bo gsod pa'i shan par rgyugasaḥ mchong zhal dung gi so sgo can 'bri ba chos skyongs rgod po deḥ mngon spyod drag po'i

rkaḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde mig lasaḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po la brten pa'i glud rabs lha 'dre'i mgu bskyed bzhugasaḥrku na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ skos/graX/ mi bdud mi nag zhwa rang can rta bdud 'jag rta rgod po dang khrag slo ngar mi khrag lung can gri bdud dug gsum gardon gyi gzugs 'go po bse rag the'u rang dang rgya 'dre'i gzugs bzhi yas glud bcas g.ya mkhar 'aro ra btsug yas dzos bcas zhal shes ci bzhin 'god par bya da ngo bden stobs brjod nga ni na 31ཿ mabyedag garna/ma sku ga༄/ma rtsa ba ga༄/maḥbaden gnyis bslu med bden stobs dngaḥ dpa' btul dgra bla'i nus mthu yisaḥ 'byung po'i tshogs rnams 'dir khug cigaḥ tri a ga ya dzaḥ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan bdun brjod rin chen ming dang gzungs mdzes dang 'byams klas 'jigs kun bral ba yiḥ de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo glud gtor 'dod yon phun tshogs gyur ༷ 3 āḥ/ ha ho hrīḥsngags drug phyag rgya drug gis spel de nas rmang rabs gyer ba na kye 'jig rten srid pa'i khams 'di naḥ bdag gir bzung ba'i ma rig pa nyon mongs las las stes pa'i gdon khyod kyi

kaiḥ bu bsam 'phel dbang rgyal ltaraḥ gsol ba btab pas dgos 'dod char ltar 'beb pha rol g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan skuḥ sras mchog dgra la rtse rgyal dbang bskur roḥ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ma chen bkra shis lhun grub kyi sku gtad la hūṃ trī mkhyen rgya tsheb mkha' ltar rnam par dgaḥ btang snyoms chen po phyogs ris med par brdalaḥ bsam gzhugs che bas sde gsum skyid la sbyor mi chen dpa' bo lhun grub dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa maḥ ga dar sngon po'i sku gtad laḥ / hrī ma rung klu btsan gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyiraḥ pad+ma'i bka' rtags snying la gnas pa yiḥ ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i brin las paḥ ga dar byang sngon stag mo'i dbang bskur roḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya a bhi mi thung khro rgyal gyi sku gto la hūṃ hrī gzugs thung gzibarjed che ba srin po'i skuḥ nyes chad phral la ston pa gnod sbyin rigasaḥ mngon spyod bsgral 'dren las la mnga' brnyes pa mi thung dpa' brjid khro rgyal dbang bskur roḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya a bhi dung sman sgrol ma rnam lnga'i sku gtad laḥ ( hrīḥ sgro la dkar gzigs pa seng rkyang 'brug mo

dang gzi lha chos sgron byang chub g.yu yi sgronaḥ kong za me tog lha mdzes sgol ma steḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dbang bskur ro rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa cha gsang dbang niḥ / trīḥ mtshan lhan bhasnyo dum gcig snod kyi nang bla ma yab yum mnyam sbyor skyems kyis bkangaḥ a li ka li bde stong mnyam par brdalaḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa kun dag nas gsal stong zung 'jug rtogs pa mngon gyur shogaX rtsa sngags mthar wak+ka a snyi ṣiñtsa ā sngags phreng gtad laḥ ( hrī gsang sngags rigs sngagasagazung sngags kun 'dus pa'iX ye shes sngags 'khor bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dal skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro byad gtad rbod gtong rigs sngags las grol nasaḥ rnams par rgyal ba'i nus mthu stobs rdzogs shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ phreng ba gam laḥ ( hrīḥ bde bshegs dam pa rigs brgya'i byin rlabs pa'i rin chen phreng ba 'od lngas lug rgyud 'brel skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur roX ngag rlung rnam dag rdo rje'i gsung thob shogaXrtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi

rkaḥ shel dbang niḥ ( trīḥ dga' bde'i lang chos 'khyud pa'i mdza' na moḥ bcu drug mdab sa 'bar phyag rgya bde ba'i gzugs skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur roḥ 'du shes gsum gyi rol rtsed la brten nasaḥ bde sto zung 'jug rtogs pa mngon gyur shog rtsa sngags mthar rtsat+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉ཿ dgra bla'i dpa' chas gtad la hūṃ trīḥ phas rgol g.yul bzlog khrag rmog phub ber chenaḥ tshem tshem bem da rgyal mchan ru mtshon daraḥ sna tshogs dar chas dpa 'a ba'i yo byad kunaḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad par bgyiḥphas rgol rbod gtong rigs sngags gzhom pa dang mtha' mi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dbang thob regagaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥtsit+ta a mdu zhags da ral gri dgra stur gtad la hūṃ trī bdud snying drung nas 'byin pa'i mdung zhags griḥ dpa' bo'i g.yul bzlog mda' gzhu dgra sta dngaḥ sbyogs rdo thog zhags thun rwa phur bu sogasaḥ dgra 'dul mtshon cha rnams kyi dbang bskur roḥ ca sngags mthar tsit+ta a bhi tshig dbang na ཿ ( trīḥ sims ni ma bcos chos nyid ngang la zhogaḥ blta ru med do mkha' ltar rnam par dgaḥ bzung du med do 'od

gsal phyogs ris bral dmigs su med do tshogs yul spros pa chod blo 'das ngang nas chos sku'i nyi ma sharaḥ snang gsum mun pa sangs so rigs kyi buḥ a a a phaṭaḥ me long gtad la bye hrīḥ chos dbyings kun nas zlum pa thig le'i klong bag chags spros dang bral ba 'od gsal klongaḥ gnyis med mnyam nyid mtshon pa brda yi dbangaḥ zang thal mngon du gyur ba'i dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥ dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa trīḥ rdo rje gtad la ka hrīḥ 'pho med gnyug ma'i rdo rje spros las 'dasaX zang thal don gyi rdo rje dngos pos dbenaḥrig stong rtags kyi rdo rje mnyam nyid ngang don de rtogs phyir dgongs pa'i brda dbang bskuraḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa gtor dab niḥ/ hrī brdal khyab chos kyi dbyings kyi bhasto na lhun rdzogs rang byung ye shes gtor chen bshamasaḥ gang shar rang grol 'dod lnga'i rgyan gyis sprasaḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ skye gnas bar dor thos bsam bsgom mthar phyinaḥ bsam gtan bar dor rig pa rang grol sharaḥ 'chi kha bar dor 'pho ba rang grol rtogs rmi lam bar dor 'khrul snang rang grol nasaḥ chos

rkuḥ nyid bar dor 'od gsal ma bu 'dresaX srid pa bar dor kun gzhi rang grol teX sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan mngon gyur shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal la bā ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa o āḥ( hrīḥ mtha' rten gtad la bye hrīX sdon tsho bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po yisaḥ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis rdzas mchog brgyad ༷ phul byung mtshan dpe'i yon tan las 'khrungs ba'i0 bkra shis dpal 'bar rtags mchog rnam pa brgyadaX 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i srid nor mchogaḥ 'phags pa'i nor bdun dam pa'i dbang bskur roḥsrid dang zhi ba'i bde legs dpal 'byor nasaX khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i dbang thob shog0 rtsa sngags mtharaḥ aṣ+ṭa maṅga le a bhi ṣiñtsa (ཿ skyems dra sa laḥtso ardopa sngags kyi dgongs spyod zab mo lam khyer ba'iX rnal 'byor khyed la bdud rtsi skyems mchod 'bulaX sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs bar mnga' gsol lo: mtha' mi kla slo 'dul ba'i gnyer gtad doX a mṛ ta siji a la la hoḥ dbas yon rin tha che ba' nor bdog pa gang 'byor bla mar phul rtsa ba yan lag dam khas blangs sgo gsum bran du dbul bar bya thabs des dbang thob sgrob pa dag nyams

rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ yimaḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugasabacud 'ad ran chen srog ga gta' ru zungs gang 'brel don dang ldan par byed dper na rin chen gser 'gyur rtsas lcags khams thams cad gser du bsgyur de'i ni thabs grol lam zab kyis sbyor sgrol gang 'brel smin grol byed bka' 'di ti se'i gangs la sbasaḥ a tsar gzhon nu bkra shas kyis snang ba brda yi dpe bstan nas pad+ma'i byin rlabs sngon gnas mthu rjesasu dran pa'i skal ba ldan rin chen shog rkyar gsal bar byas las 'phro can gya dpa la du shogaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'ang a khyung mi rje bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bkra shas dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang / rdo rje'i lung zan rag pa 'dzan pa 'gyur med rgya mtshos thabs shes mtshon pa' bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang / rdo rje'i lung zin rig pa 'dzan pa 'gyur med rgya mtshos thabs shes mtshon pa 'i bkra shisapa' skyes bcas bskul ba dang / snying nor lung zin dam pa byams chos kyis gos bzang dbyangs gsal bkra ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba da / 'byur rdor da rat+na sa ra'i mos blos bskul ngor kho bo sbasapa' rnal 'byor nusaldan 'du pa rtsal gyi dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mardzod la bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa na lung zin shrī tris bgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sabo masgo la/

༄༅/ 'dzam gling skyes bu'i mchod 'grigs bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho bzhugs/༄༅/ / na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye/ rgyal kun gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul las/ zab gsang sgo brgya 'byed pa'i gnyen/ 'gro rnams phan bdes tshim mjad pa'i/ rag 'dzin nus ldan rdo rjer 'dud/ gang gsung chos sgo mtha' yas las/ 'dzam gling skyes bu don 'grub kyi/ bdag mdun sgrub la nyer mkho'i phyir/ mchod 'grigs bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho bri/ rtswa gsum skyes bu dgru bla dang/ wer ma las bzhi bskung gtor sogs/ 'di yi dam gu ru nga zhon gyisasogs mchan dgra bgegs tshar gcod brten gtwor dang / sman gtwor lam la tshe gtor bcas/ phye mar g.yang rten sna tshogs pa / dgra bla'i dpa' chas brten phud rnamasaX dkyil 'khor steng gi cha la bkod/ mdun bskyed dug sgrub gtor ma dang / shan pa las la rbad pa gnyis/ bar dang 'og gi cha la bkod/yang na mnyam bkod zhal shes bzhin/ gzhan yang rgyun gtor dkar dmar dang / bgegs gtor tshog du chad bstan bcas/ dpal bsgos grangs mang ja gad dang / 'bru sna gtor 'bul

dgra bla'i dar/ mkhan bya bas shug la sogs pa/ ma tshang med pa ra bsags byas te/ dang po bsang chu byin rlabasadang / de nas mchod rdzas yo byad la/ chab byung dang ni sbos byung bya/ dkar phyogs skyong rnams skyem gtor dang / bgegs rigs lan chags gtor mas brngan/ mchod rdzas yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ sman raka gtor gsum gzhung ltar phul/ mchod byang dgra bgegs tshar gcod la/ mchod gtor skyems phud 'bul ba dang / gtor 'bul lang ga sbrag nas stobs/ rdzas bskang mar me bha ling ta/ rak+ta sman sogs rim bzhin bya/tshogs la phud bshagasabasgral gsum dang / bskang rja sa byin rlabs gnam phud mchod/ dra sa rol lhag 'gron dgyes pa bskang / de nas dgra bla'i rgyal po yi/ dug byung dang ni zhud byung la/ sman raka bran la g.yon bskor bya/ gnas khang phyi na mchod rdzas sogs/ rta nor lug la ñtsā gsol dang / khyim bsang byas la gtsang mar bya/ gzhi bta bal stan dkar po 'am/ min ya bal 'dab bya pas 'thus/ skyes bu'i gtor ma byin gyis rlabs/ mnga' gsol snyem phud gser skyem 'asgor/ skyem mchod 'o phud gtor ma bya/ bsang la phyi nang gnyis su dbye/ lam lha da ni bskang gsol

༄༅/ / la/brten pa'i gtor mar chu gtsang bran dgrwa bla'i gnyer bcol gser skyem 'thoraXyonā 'bul dpon slob yon mtshod kyis skyes bu'i gtor mar sher tshig phul/sngags mtshod sman raka gtor gsum bran/srung la sne mar sgron me bkyag/dar tshon sna lnga'i mda' dar g.yug/spyan 'dren mjug tu skyem phud mchod/dgru bla'i dpang bstod yon bdag la/mda' dar gtad de me tog 'thor/bskung gsol brten gtor rgyun gtor rnams/byin rlabs mchod 'bul bzhu ltar bya/lam lha gnyer bcol brtan phud 'thor/g.yang blan khyim bsang 'o phud mchod/rten bzhugs rab tu gnas par bya/gsol mchod 'khrugs bskang dpa 'a gtor dang /shan pa za ngu phrin bcol la/dmar gyi gtor ma re re phul/donas dga' ston chogs mtshad bya/mdun bskyed drag sgrub gtor ma la/dgra bgegs 'gugs bstem bya ba da /gtor 'bul skyem thu da gzhu ltar byed/spu gyi 'khor lo byed 'dod na/bskul bar skyem phud dmar gtor mchod/'gugs bsgral bstan da gtor 'bul bya/drag bskur rdo rje'i gad mo la/skyem phud sha khrag dmar gyi gtor/dgra bgegs 'gugs bstim byin rlabs dang/gtor 'bul

'don tshig ltar du bya/ skyem gtor dgra bo'i phyogs su sdeb/ de nas thun zor rab gnas dang / smad las gser skyem gzu dpang la/ sha khrag dmar gtor re re dang/ mkhyen dpang skyem phud dpa' gtor dang/ shan gtor sman raka gtor mas bskang / gi rabs sha khrag dmar gtor phul/ bas rabs gtor skyems dgra phyogs sdeb/ cha rabs rgyugu byang dmar gtor dang / rgyugu bskul gtor 'bul gtor skyems mchod/ dmag 'khyed rgyug la gtor skyem re/ dgra dang bgegs kyi phyogs su sdeb/ drag bzlog mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog la/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams dang/ sha khrag dmar gyi gtor 'bul bya/ bskul ba chad bstan bro mnan sogs/ lhag chad bskang bcas spyi ltar ro/ glud rab bca' tshogs gzhung ltar la/ sbyang spel bsngo sogs 'don tshig ltar/ srung 'dzug gong ltar bya ba dang/ dung rdo bcu gsum bstod pa la/ dza gad skyem phud mchod byas te/ dung rdo g.yas bskor lha la phul/ ngam gyi rdo nag g.yon bskor gyis/ mi nag zhwa ring steng du spungs/ shā dkar bal stan dkar po las/ gzhung ltar dkyil 'khor mdun du phul/ shā nag gru gsum bal nag las/ gzhung ltar zhwa ring mnan la bcag srab mda'

༄༅/ / sum sbrel mda' steng 'then/ srung mdud byas la mda' dar brgyan/ rkun thag rno dbal mtshon gyis gcod/ rmas bsgyur mchod g.yog srin lag steng / chus bkrus khrag lung steng du bshal/ ni bdud phab par gra mgo 'phur/ rgyal rab rim bzhin gri byung nas/ mtshon rab gri bdud mtshon chas gtib/ de nas g.ya' mkhar thams cad bshig dgra dpung gcag byed rdo ril la/ tho bris dpung pa tshig ma bcag mar gyi tshom bu bkod byas te/ dpang bstod byed tshe lha la 'bul 'byung por lam bstan bgegs sprad dang / sru ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par byaḥ zor la chas bskyed spyi ltar dang / rtsa bsnyen bzla bzhin 'khyel 'gros bya/ phur gdab nas bzung me skyog dang / dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams mnan/ spro na las bzhi'i bro gar 'khrab/ 'di la bzlog pa khri 'am stong / tshad da ldan pa 'khyol bar bya tshe 'gugs g.yang gtād gzhung bzhin dang / bzhengs zhur dza gad skyem phud 'thor/ bzhengs rab gdul dka' bdud 'dul la/ skyes bu'i gtor ma rdo rjes phul/ lha bsang sprin dkar 'khrigs 'dra phud/ bkyag mchod gtor ma bsang du phul/ dbang thang rlung rta'i dpal kha bskyed/ lhag chad bskang la

grugs byad ma bris pa'i khar/ shan gtor bdud gri nag po la/ bdud bshos dmar nag bdud kyis bskor/ rtsang gi dra ba mig mas brjid dang ldan par bya/ slar smras pa/ gang gsung gdams pa'i yang zhun las/ snyigs 'gro'i rgud tshogs skyobs pa'i /ra rigs/ bdag kyang skye ba' phreng ba sa rim gnyis dga' ston la rol nas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i gru char gyis/ don thabasal nyer mkho'i mchod 'grigs bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho 'di ya mkhas pa rnams kyis phyag bzhes bzhin du dung dkar ba shi/ —

༄༅// //bsregasablugs nyon mongasagayul 'jomasakyi thig ne+eḥ thig chen phyi ltar la/ thabs rgya nag po gru gsum thod pa 'i bteg kha khyer dmar po gru gsum ral gri'i bteg kha pad mthing ga gru gsum rdo rje' bteg mchi gzhi dkar gru gsum rdo rje'i rwa ba ser po/ mi ran gru gsum gzhi ser pad+mas ra ba dmar ser/ kha khyer phyi ma gru gsum mthing ga 'khor lo'i ra ba ser po ste las bzhi'/ phyi rim me ri pa dras bskor/ phyogs gsum la rdo rje sngon po rwa gde sa phyed pa ras mtshon no/ rtsig shi ni sum rim la naja ma rtse sor bcu gnyis/ bar ma rtse sor nyi shu/phyi ma brkyang sa gru ga / yam shing sor brgyad/ shi tsher ma 'am drag po'i shang gang ru ngo zhal shes so/ 'dzam gleng skyes bu chen po'i ling ga da bsregs blugs thig lags so/
skyu khi — gra ghi brgya — ḍo rme — pa — — nga/ ༅ / smrar 4 / thur skepa gru ga— ma bar5bag— ma / ga nas/

kaiḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi shā mig lasaḥ dgra bla'i rgyal po'i brten dar bri thabs dpag bsamabashan shing zhes bya ba bzhugs che /rkaḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye/ (3ba 'a nibyed// dri bral dar dkar mdzes pa la/ rin chen lnga da bzang po drug/ bdud rtsi chos sman sbyar ba yi mtshal gyi re'u mig dgu ru bskor dbus su dgra bla'i rgyal po yi sku gzugs mngon rtog ltar du briX mdzes pa tshon gyi rtsi gsol loḥ shar gyi re'u mig gru bzhi laḥ g.yang rta nor bu'i bang mdzod khuraḥ srid pa'i ba mo bsam 'grub dkar bya rje dung khyung g.yu gshegags can gnyan gyi lu gu dkar po rnamasaḥ nam mkha' sa gzhi mdzes rgyan bcasaX lho yi ling tshe gru bzhi la a bse'i dung mi smra ra can go khrab mtshon cha'i dpal gyi gtam nub kyi re'u mig gru bzhi la rug yul gnod sbyan mi dmar poḥ gser dngul dar zab dkar gyis spud byang gi re'u mig gru bzhi laḥ gzi lha chos kyis sgon ma la gzi mchong byi ru g.yu mu min margad la sogs rata'i gtamaḥ shar lho'i phyogs kyis re'u mig la smrag tshal stag mo'i 'byor yag bkod lho nub mtshams kyis re'u mig laḥ

dung brag gangs seng dkar po'i brgyan nub byang phyogs kyi re'u mig laX gnam ri ljon shing khyung gi brgyan byang shar re'u mig gru bzhi las mtsho gling brag skyibs g.yu 'brug 'khyil de rgyab mu 'khyud gru bzhi las mdun nas nye ba'i rin chen bdun g.yas nas bkra shis rdzas mchog brgyadaḥ steng phyogasarin chen rtagasamachog brgyad g.yon nas rgyal srid nor sna bdun mtshams su gter gyi bum pa dang dpag bsam ljong shing 'dod 'jo'i ba ma rmos rang 'khrungs lo bcud bkod de rgyab mu 'byud gru bzhi las dbyangs dang gsal byed rten 'brel snying gser gyi laji nyid du byas de rgyab mu khyud gru bzhi la rtse mo dpung rgyan gzungs gis bskor phyogs bzhir 'byung bzhi'i ri mo dang mtshams bzhir lcags zhags sgrogasadril briḥ de rgyab mu 'khyud gling bzhi la dbang mdog 'od zer pa d+ma'i 'byud lha yi dar lce sngon po la 'bod pa'i sngags ni gser gyis bri gnyan gyi dar lce ser po laX rbad pa'i sngags ni mthing gis brisaḥbatsan bdud dar lce dmar po laḥ bsad pa'i sngags ni snag gis bri sgrub pa'i rten 'dzug rab tu gnas dgra bla'i dar chen mkha' la phyaraḥ lha klu gnyan dmag bsang gis mchod bstan

rkaḥ 'gror sman pa'i sems bskyed bya rnal 'byor dbang phyug bden grub mthus gang 'dod thogs med yid bzhin 'byung de la the tshom tsam yang medaḥ bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ 'dod sred can la ma shor cig sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thimaḥsnyi zhes pa'ang slob bu 'gyur med kya bzhed ngor 'grub phyir nus ldan pas mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni zhang po pad+ma'i mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/

rkuḥ bka' rgya gnad kyi lde'u mig go'adzam gleng skyes buyibaca' chogs ni go gtor rtsa gsum las bzhi'i gtor ma bskang gtor sman raka gtor gsum spyi ltar dang rin chen sgod du 'dzam gli skyes bu' gtor ma gdan zhi dbang rgyas drag rin chen zur brgyad dam bcu nyi zla'i khar dpal gyi gshos bu gangs dkar la nyi ma shar ba lta bu pa da skor rnams gser mdog lte bar mtshal gyis byugs pa/ rin chen sna bdun bsres pa'i mar gyi ril bu bcu 'khor rtsib bam rin chen gyi zur steng bkod yang ril bu drug las bzhi'i gdan steng/ dpal bsgos bzhi gdan kheb khar phyogs mdog tu bya'oX gdugs ri dar dar tshon 'dod rdzas rdzas rtags rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun sogs phyi nang gsang mchod rgyas par bkrams mdun bskyed rkyagator ma rna ma ṭaṃ bkod pa'i snyi khar gru gsum e yi khang pa sum rim/ de rgyab rtsibs bcu/ de rgyab rtsibs drug de rgyab rtsibs sum cu/ de rgyab brgyad cu/ de rgyab sgo bzhi'i tshul du bya/ dbus su gtor ma gdong zhal can/ zur lnga rtse mo lnga pa/ de rbab sming bshos bcu de rbab dpal gtor 5ga de rbab sman rting bco barbad/ de rbab dmar gtor sum myu/ de rbab bshos nag barbad myu

sgo bzhir dmar gtor phyogs mdog de rgyab bā ling bdun cu rtsa bdun rtsang nyer brgyad kyi rtsa bar/ shrī sha hūṃ snyi sto snyi sto tu sta na mā ra ya phaṭa rked paraḥ aparatsit+ta'i〈sudzaya zhes dang rtse mo la tsan+t+rasarbaduṣ+ṭha mdzasahūṃphaṭaḥ zhes rtsang rgyan gsum 'dzoms par bya/ rtse mo la 'dab chags khrag byugs rtsa ba la gcan gzan gyi khrag sbyar nas ling ga re re'i snying gar 'dzugasked par phag dang sprel gyi spu sbyar gtor thags sngo dmar gdugs me ri ru dar mtshe dug mda' mdung ral gri zhags pa rdo sgong thun yung dkar khrag sna dug sna lcags phye zangs phye ske tshe shing tshe yung nag sogs kyis brgyan la shin tu rngams par bya'o g.yas su dgra bla'i gtor ma lcags mkhar sum rim 3 steng du rdo rje byed pas brgyan dpal gtor bcu gsum gyis bskor/ 'dod rdzas sna tshogs bkrams/ g.yon du wer mas gtor ma 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rtsibs bzhi rtsibs lnga brtsegs pa'i khar/ dpal bshos nor bu'i mtshan pa g.yang bshos bcu gsum gyis bskor la bkra shis dzos rtagasabakrams/ gzhan yang tshogasachad brtan dpal bshosagrangasamang dza gad khrag skyems ja phud 'bru sna bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs/ bsang shug bya mda' dar phye mar g.yang
kaiḥ rten dgra bla'i dpa' chas thams cad bkod par bya'oX ces pa'ang shī tri'i ngoranus ldan pas brjed tho dran gso tsam du phul bas ma zin pa yod thang lags/

rkaḥ bka' rgya gnas kyi lde mig lasaḥ khams gsum dbang sdud dgra bla'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bsdus pa pad+ma'i lcags kyu bzhugasaḥrkaḥ na ma gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ zang1414/ thugs mthun bsgrub rja sa yo byad bsags phyi na gsang ba'i dam/ rgya bsdams snye gsal ti 'dzan bstan po yisaX mdun bskyed sru ma bsgom — ni hūṃ hrīḥ sna grags dran rig dag mnyam chen po'i ngangaX rang byung lhun grub 'od lnga'i gzhal med dbusaḥ bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i khri yi kharaX rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug thod phreng rtsalaḥ che ba'i yon tan ma 'dres lhun rdzogs pa'iX mdun dudagra d+malirgyal po seng chen ni bco lnga'i zla zhal 'char ga'i mdangs kyis 'byudaḥ khrab rmog ber klubs dgra bla'i dpa' chas bskoraX la klu gnyan dmag bu yug 'tshubs ltar 'gyedaḥ rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rkyang cherd chabs su bcibasaḥ gser rga g.yu srab sme ba'i gling rdzogs stanaḥrin chen dar chas nor bu du mas sngadaḥ 'ja' khyim g.yu sbang me rlang 'tshubs ma'i dbusaḥ dung sman lha mo'i tshogs rnams 'dud cing bstodaḥ che brjid khams gsum dbang stud

srid gsum 'daraḥ dgra bla lam lha wer ma sku las 'tshubasaḥ dpa' 'bum rgya tsha tshangs pa'i bu yag dngaḥ bdud gcod shan pa 'dan ma rin chen dpalaḥ 'bri ba chos skyongs khra tsha glog 'khyugs rgyalaX dung skyong stag dkar g.yu lha zog rgod 'baraḥ rnal 'byor khro thung g.yang bdag rgu ru ste phyogs bcu'i don 'grub grub brtes rig 'dzin bcuḥ dgra bla'i dpa' chas rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan bskyedaḥ thar ba rgyal mtshan a nu dpa' seng dang ༷ ma ṇi ka ra dmu spyang dkar po dngaX g.yu 'od 'bum me a stag klu mo rnamasaḥ bstan la snying nye rnal 'byor yongs kyi grogasaḥ mthu rtsal thogs med dpa' rtags che brjed ldan phyin drug mdzad pas 'gro drug yul sa 'drenaX zhal dkar ldem pa rat+na bsam 'grub dang rnal 'byor dar li lha rgod 'bum me yisaḥ tshad med rnam bzhis phyag rgyas yongs la 'debs phrin las bzhi yi stobs su khams gsum 'dren0 bdud bzhi'i dpung pham phyogs bzhi'i dmag bzlog pa0 dpa' bo bdud las rgyal ba'i phyag brnyan paḥ sbyor sgrol las la mthu rtsal ldan par bskyedaḥ dgra lha rtse rgyal ga dar spyang sngon dngaḥ mi thung khro

kaiḥ rgyal dpa' bo lhun grub rnamasaḥ g.yang sgo bsrung ba'i lde'u mig phyag na bsnamasaḥ nad mug 'khrugs rtsod dus kyi rgud pa bsalaḥ g.yang rta nor bu'i rwa can re re bcibasaX khams gsum chos la 'god pa'i phrin las 'gyedaḥ g.yin yang dpa' btul dam pa sum cu dang grub thob brgyad bcu sprul pa'i las dmag tshogasaḥ bstan dgra dam sri 'dul ba'i gnyen por bskyedaḥ thugs srog 'od kyis rnga yab dpal ri dang gar bzhugs gnas nas rang 'dra dpag med paḥ kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin spyan drangs bstims 31 kwa ma tha la ra tsa na phe phernyi 'bod sngags chu bo'i gzhu ltar bzla oṃ kwa ma tha la ra tsa na sa ma ya phe thoX sdang ba'i dgra bo la rbad rbadaḥ rbad sngags me yi 'khor lo bskor sa kwa ma tha la ra la tsa na cho cho rgyug rgyugs dgra snying tshal bar gtubasaḥ bsad sngags spu gri' 'khor lo bskor ga la gzas tshad rdul brlag 'gyur skabs 'dir gsol mchod 'khrugs bskang da za ru grangs ldan bskyal bar bya de nas sngags kyis mchod byas te snyan pa'i dbya sa bcas bstod pa ni hūṃ trīḥ khams gsum dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po'i 'dzumaḥ srid gsum dam 'dogs 'khor lo'i brgyur rgyal

tshulaḥ don du sangs rgyas mdzad brin mngon spyod ston ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po khyod la bstod tsherab kun tu lhag pa'i lha khyod kyisaḥ rjes bzungs sa lam nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed don gnyis lhun grub pad+ma thod phreng gi: thugs kyi bzhed don 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cigaḥ 'di lta ra dgra bla'i rgyal po nyid brten sgrub bskang gsol byas pa na phran las rnams bzhi thog med 'grub phya g.yang 'dod dgu'i dpal gyis phur don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za bka' 'di dam can rgya mtsho'i srungs skal med lag tu ma shor cigaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha zhes pa'ang slob bu 'gyur med mtshan can gya bkra shis la reg dkar yol gyi skyes bcas bskul ro ra/ kho bo nusaldan 'du pa rtsal lam gas sngags mi bskyod gling pas o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las brgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni zhing po pa d+ma bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

rka bon gter las dbang wa khro rgyal chen po'i sgrub pa bzhugasaḥ ༄rngo6 1 tsan+d+ra dgyes pa ra rol pa'i gar nye ru ka la bdag phyag 'tshal de yi sgrub la sus gzhol kya ཿ byad phur g.yul ro kun las rgyal sa ma yāḥbadag snang rig pa trīḥyig las rjes chags brtse pa'i 'dzum zhal garaḥ khro thung sngags kyi he ru daḥ ral pa bkra shis mdud rgya bdunaḥ smra ra dpal be kha spu zungasaḥ ra yi mdud rgya lug mdud bcingaḥ og tshom 'khor lo'i rnam par bkraX spug nag zhi ma khro 'dzum sgegasaX ber chung mthing shams seng lcags sprasaḥ dbang gi lcags kyu bharnya bsnamasaX sāg s+t+waṃ 'ja' ris dbang ber klubasaḥ sku las sna tshogs 'od zer rtseraḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i 'gyedaX ging dang lang ga bu yug 'tshubs: rgyal po rol pa'i bstabs su bzhugs bde dang stong pa'i gzi byin 'baraX sgog gis bskul te 'og min nasaḥ dbang lha rta mgrin rgyal po yangasaX khro chen rnam par spyan drangs bsdimasaḥ thugasakar srog gi yi ge laX sngags kyi phreng bas stor bar dmigasaḥ bzlas pa sa mngo na spyod lhun grub cing bde stong ye shes rtsal 'bar dmigs tsasapodha h+ya nig nal byad phur

gtad mnan —1la ste la swā hā deltarabazlas pas grin las 'grub gdug pa bdud kya g.yul las rgyal rnam mangs phrin las lhun grub cing daro sa grub dam pa thob par 'gyuraḥ sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thamaḥlhaḥ zhes pa'ang nam mkha' mdzod kyi brda ris las nus ldan pas bsgyur bas sbyan bdag g.yu drung 'bum yag rgyal gyis 'phral rkyen zhi ba'i rgyur gyur cig

rkaḥ bon gter lasaḥ sngags mkhan khro rgyal chen po'i gsol mchod rigs sngags phyir bzlog bzhugs so nyi ma tri sa ma yuḥ stenas/8) sha chang gtor ma g.yag lug ra 'bru sna 'bras chan sna tshogs bsags sngags kyi byin rlabs zad med spel rol mo' sgra bcas 'di skad do h+ya sbyo wa hrīX bdechen dbang gi pho brang nasaḥ rjes chags 'dzum zhal he ru gaX khro rgyal chen po gshegs su gsolaḥ dam tshig dag pa'i gdan la bzhugasaḥ ngan sngags tshar gcod khyod phyag 'tshalaḥ dug gsum gnas stong sha khrag rusaḥ bde stong dga' bzhi'i rol ston gyisaḥ gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskangasaX phyi dpon khro rgyal rabs dgyes nasaḥ phyu dang g.yang gi dngos grub dngaḥ bde stong dga' bzhi'i dngos grub stsolaḥ rigs sngags rbod gtong byad phur rkyenaḥ rang gshed rang la dbab pa dngaX rgol ba ngan pa tshar chod cigaX lus dang grib bzhin 'bral med 'grogaḥ bde legs phun tshogs phrin las bsgrubs dam las ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ gra sa bsogs snyi nye phrin las 'grub sngags kyis mchod cing bstod pa ni snye hi ra wi ra maṇ+ḍi tha( sarba rū pa shabha gharnye ra sa spar she āḥ(ཿ pañtsa a dṛ

ta rak+ta bā lirnyi khā hiḥ sa hrīḥ bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs 'jom mdzad cingaḥ rdzong khag bco brgyad lde mig mchog bde stong a nu'i rnal 'byor ba sngags mkhan khro thung rgyal la bstodaḥ mi mthun 'jigs pa'i phyogs rnams dngaḥ byad phur rbod gtong bzlog par mdzodaX de ltar grangs bsogs phrin las bcol 'bad med yad bzhin 'grub par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgyaḥzhes pa 'di'ang mgon tshangs g.yung dru 'bum yag rgyal gyis 'phral rkyen byad phur bzlog phyer nubadaldan pabasasbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba masko lo/

rluḥ dag snang las 'dzam gling skyes bu chen po'igasol sgrub gdugs pa tshar gcod bzhugs soḥsum̐ḥ na sna gu ru yaḥ /mdzam3111sko thugs mthun mchod rdzas sna tshogs bsags sngags da phyag rgyas zad med spel lhar gsal ti 'dzin brtan po yis srung ma mngon gsum gsal btab ste trīḥ rang mdun ting 'dzin las 'khrungs gzhal med khangaḥ 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs 'ja' 'od gur 'khrigs 1ngaḥ rta mchog rkyang dmar rdzu 'phrul 'phur gshog ldanaḥ rin chen gser gyi sga srab dar stan mdzesaḥ de ste dpa' bo 'dzam gling seng chen rgyalaḥ nya gang zla ltar bkrag mdangs gzi 'od 'baraḥ rin chen khrab rmog dar ber sag s+t+waṃ mdzesaḥ shes rab ral gri thab shes mda' gzhu brten rno ngar mtshon chen mdung dmar g.yas pas phyaraḥ dgra sde 'chor med zhags pa gru la bskoraḥ dad ldan dpal bskyed gter bum g.yon pas bsnamasaḥ dar mda' rgod 'phru ru dar dam rtags mdzesaḥ thugs byonadung sman phu nu sum cu dngaḥ dgra bla wer ma lha gla gnyan dmag tshogasaḥ mtsho la

gza' skar bkra ltar lam mer gsalaḥ kun gyi thugs sgog las spros 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra spyan drangs bstimasaX snyan gsan dbab pa niḥhoḥ dgongs su gsol loḥ gsan du gsol loḥ spros pa med pa'i dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba dgongs brgyudaX rig 'jin brda brgyud gang zag snyan brgyudaX gzhan yang drug ldan brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad 'dus pa' ngo bo o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis bstan 'gro'i rgud pa srung mkhan mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad thal bar brlag pa'i byed po skyes mchog seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal du bzhengs ba de nyid rnga yab kyi gling na bzhugs sam0 rig ldan sham bha la na bzhugs samaḥdaga' ldan lha yul na bzhugs samaḥ 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing khams dam pa gang na bzhugs kyang: rang snang rnam par dag pa bsgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir bshegs shig: byon cig: badz+ra sa ma yā dza dzaX lan gsum rjes su spyon 'dren niḥtrī rnga yab gling dbus zangs mdog dpal ri nasaḥ 'gro ba'i 'dren ston pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal: phrin

sum̐ḥ las rol rtsed 'dzam gling seng chen rgyalaḥ gtso 'khor sprul bcas gnas 'dir da tshur byon badz+ra sa ma yā dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol ni hrīḥ pho brang 'od 'bar dgra bdud bsnol ba'i kharaX drag rtsal dpal bskyed me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbusaḥ rnam dag dam tshig rten rdzas bkod pa la gtso 'khor sprul dang bcas te bzhugs su gsolaḥs ma yā tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ phyag 'tshal na na mo ga'agags 'gyur med ga ga ma'i sangs rgyas zhal phrin las mi nub 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byungaḥ bstan dgra'i zil sbyor zil gnon gdong brgya ba ge sar dgra bla'i tshogs la phyag bgyi'oḥ na mo na ma yā hoḥ mchod pa ni hrīḥ dngos bsham taing 'jin yid sprul las byung ba'iX phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka bha ling ta glu gar rol mo bkra shis rdzas rtags dngaḥ rgyal srid nor sna 'dod yon sprin phung poḥ gesar dgra bla'i tshogs la 'bul gyis bzhesaḥ phyu dang g.yang gi dngos grub char ltar phobasaḥ sa ma hā pañtsa pu tsa hoḥ mnga' gsol niḥb33 gzod nas dribral gnas lugs chos kyi dbyingasaḥ yod med khas len mdud dam dbyings su bor thams cad mnyam nyad

gnyug ma'i ye shes zhalaX gdod ma'i sangs rgyas nyid du mnga' gsol loḥ brtan pa'i rdo rje ye nas 'dus ma byas bsdus pa'i rdo rje 'khor 'das 'ub chub klong rtogs pa'i rdo rje kun bzang dgongs pa'i gdangasaḥ don dam byang chub sems dpar mnga' gsol loḥ snying rje'i 'gal zlar rang snang gshed por ngomaḥ zhen med 'gal phyogs chang bcing bde stong sbyoraḥ a 'thas nyon drug sgyu las kha lo bsgyuraX stobs ldan sbyor sgrol byed por mnga' gsol loX ma rig bdud la gtum rngams gar dgus gziraḥ nyon 'khrul zhing bcu'i don snying lkog mar 'byinaX bshad sgrub gzhi la phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyedaX legs nyes khrims kyi bdag po mnga' gsol lo: skal ldan bu la sa lam mdzub mos ston sgyu lus phung po dwangs ma'i 'od lngar sbyoraḥ brgyud gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs gral skyolaḥ dam ldan yongs kyi grogs po smon pa'i re 'bras zhal bzhes mi bslu b.raḥ dam tshig zhi la rdo rje'i sgog gnas shingaḥ dge mtshan phan bde'i dpal yon char ltar phobasaḥ rdzogs ldan gsar du tshes pa'i bkra shis stsolaḥ bskang ba niḥhri stong

sum̐ḥ dbyejis nam mkhalirgyan gyur dga' ston rigasaḥ lha klu mi yi nor sna yod do cog ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul ltad mo las byung dkor ma lusasaro chen dgra blami tshogs la 'bulaX sku yi thugs dam nyin ltar 'od 'bar zhingaḥ gsung gi thugs dam tshang pa'i dbyangs ltar snyanaḥ thugs kyi thugs dam mi g.yo mkha' ltar bskang yon tan phrin las mi zad gter du bskangaX rnal 'byor nyams pa gso ba'i slad du bskang 'dod don phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub phyir bskangaXphyu dang g.yang gedangos grub 'phel phyir bskangaḥ bskang gyur tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ gnyer bcol phrin las ma lus yongs grub mdzodaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: gsol mchod ni kye 'dod pa/ don 'grub 'dzam gling seng chen rgyalaḥ pho nya dgra bla wer ma'i tshogs dang bcas gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol dbu 'phang bstodaḥ rnam mang phrin las rab 'byams myur 'grub mdzodaḥ grangs bsog snyi nye phrin las myur bstod pa na /sngi rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rkyang dmar 'phur shes bcibs bdud dgra'i rgol 'joms mdung zhags rno mtshon 'dzinaḥ

dam tshig gnyer skyong phyu g.yang char ba 'bebs ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod bdag nyid pad+ma rngod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i thugs srog las 'od zer 'phrosaḥge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po rjes su dran nas gang bcol phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs med du 'khru1ra par bsam laḥ ((ka ma tha la ra tsa na sa ma yā pho dza dzaX bzlas pa dbug gi rta la drangs bdun zhag gsum du sgrub pa na grub rtags mtshan ma 'byung bar 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma yuḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥsnyi zhes pa 'di'ang slob bu sher tho zhes byas rasno sher gyi bum pa bcas te bskul ngor khobo nusaldan rdo rjesaspel ba maṅga le/gsol mchod ni bsgo kun khyab dgongs pa chos sku'i klong yangs nasaX sgyu 'phrul gsal snang ge sar dgra bla'i rje las mdzad pho nya nyi rdul ltar mnyam la gsol lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstodaX rnam bzhi'i phrin las thog med yid bzhin sgrubasaḥ chos dang mthun pa'i dge mtshan dpal yon spelaḥ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro tshogs pa'i dpal
